  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通信号控制依赖固定配时方案或基于强化学习的离线训练策略，难以应对动态、突发的交通需求变化。此类方法缺乏对当前交通状态的实时感知与仿真能力，配时调整通常滞后于实际流态，导致排队溢出与延误累积。因此需要一种能够持续感知、实时推理并自动执行的闭环控制机制，以提升路网整体通行效率。

Method: 构建交通基础设施的数字孪生作为决策中枢，并由智能体AI在孪生环境中进行实时自治决策，整体划分为三层：①感知层（Perception）：通过部署于物理道路的传感器结合边缘计算，采集并预处理实时交通信息（如流量、排队长度、占用率等）；②概念化层（Conceptualization）：利用 LangChain 对感知数据进行处理、语义解析与推理，形成交通拥堵、行程延误与交通模式的结构化判断与仿真状态；③行动层（Action）：通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）与交通管理 API 将决策转化为可执行的信号控制指令，调用优化的交通信号控制算法写入孪生系统与实际信号机。数字孪生环境随实测数据不断更新，形成"感知—推理—执行"的闭环。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架能够最小化交通信号灯处的等待时间，并正向提升整个交通流的运行效果；与固定配时（fixed-time）基线以及基于强化学习（RL）的基线相比，所提方法的性能表现更优，说明孪生驱动的智能体闭环控制在延误与通行效率指标上具有优势。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了"数字孪生 + 智能体AI + 标准化工具接口（MCP/LangChain）"这一分层范式在真实交通信号优化中的可行性，为动态、自适应的城市交通控制提供了可落地且可扩展的技术路径。未来方向包括多路口协同优化、孪生保真度与预测精度提升、异常与故障条件下的鲁棒性，以及与既有信号机与交通管理平台的工程集成与规模化部署。

Abstract: This article outlines a new framework of traffic light optimization through a digital twin of the transport infrastructure, managed by agentic AI to ensure real-time autonomous decisions. The framework relies on physical sensors and edge computing to measure real-time traffic information and simulate traffic flow in a constantly updated digital twin. The traffic light is automatically controlled through the digital twin according to traffic congestion, travel delay and traffic patterns. This approach is implemented as a three-layer system: perception, conceptualization and action. The perception layer receives data on physical systems; the conceptualization layer uses LangChain to process the data; and the action layer links to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and traffic management APIs to implement optimised traffic signal control algorithms. The results show that the framework minimizes waiting time at traffic lights and positively affects the effectiveness of the entire traffic flow, which is better than the fixed-time and reinforcement learning-based baselines.

</details>


### [80] [TRUST: A Framework for Decentralized AI Service v.0.1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27132)
*Yu-Chao Huang,Zhen Tan,Mohan Zhang,Pingzhi Li,Zhuo Zhang,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRUST是一个用于可信AI的去中心化审计框架，通过层级DAG分解推理、DAAN协议实现因果归因、多层共识机制保证正确性，在30%恶意节点下仍可工作，已在多个LLM和基准测试中验证性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前中心化验证方法存在四大局限：稳健性差（单点故障易受攻击和偏见影响）、可扩展性低（推理复杂度造成瓶颈）、不透明（隐藏审计侵蚀信任）、隐私泄露（推理痕迹暴露模型资产）。

Method: 1. HDAGs（层级DAG）：将思维链推理分解为五层抽象，支持并行分布式审计；2. DAAN协议：将多智能体交互映射为因果交互图，实现确定性根因归因；3. 多层共识机制：计算检查器、LLM评估器、人类专家通过权益加权投票决策。

Result: 准确率72.4%（比基线高4-18%），20%腐败下仍保持弹性；根因归因70%（对比标准方法54-63%），token节省60%；人类研究验证F1=0.89，Brier=0.074。

Conclusion: TRUST框架实现了安全、可问责的推理系统部署，在30%恶意节点参与下仍保证正确性，四个应用场景（A1-A4）验证了去中心化AI审计的可行性，为高风险领域的可靠AI验证提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) in high-stakes domains demand reliable verification, yet centralized approaches suffer four limitations: (1) Robustness, with single points of failure vulnerable to attacks and bias; (2) Scalability, as reasoning complexity creates bottlenecks; (3) Opacity, as hidden auditing erodes trust; and (4) Privacy, as exposed reasoning traces risk model theft. We introduce TRUST (Transparent, Robust, and Unified Services for Trustworthy AI), a decentralized framework with three innovations: (i) Hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graphs (HDAGs) that decompose Chain-of-Thought reasoning into five abstraction levels for parallel distributed auditing; (ii) the DAAN protocol, which projects multi-agent interactions into Causal Interaction Graphs (CIGs) for deterministic root-cause attribution; and (iii) a multi-tier consensus mechanism among computational checkers, LLM evaluators, and human experts with stake-weighted voting that guarantees correctness under 30% adversarial participation. We prove a Safety-Profitability Theorem ensuring honest auditors profit while malicious actors incur losses. All decisions are recorded on-chain, while privacy-by-design segmentation prevents reconstruction of proprietary logic. Across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, TRUST attains 72.4% accuracy (4-18% above baselines) and remains resilient against 20% corruption. DAAN reaches 70% root-cause attribution (vs. 54-63% for standard methods) with 60% token savings. Human studies validate the design (F1 = 0.89, Brier = 0.074). The framework supports (A1) decentralized auditing, (A2) tamper-proof leaderboards, (A3) trustless data annotation, and (A4) governed autonomous agents, pioneering decentralized AI auditing for safe, accountable deployment of reasoning-capable systems.

</details>


### [81] [Unpacking Vibe Coding: Help-Seeking Processes in Student-AI Interactions While Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27134)
*Daiana Rinja,Eduardo Araujo Oliveira,Sonsoles López-Pernas,Mohammed Saqr,Marcus Specht,Kamila Misiejuk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以"求助行为"视角解剖 vibe coding：分析 110 名本科生、19,418 轮真实学生-AI 交互（HuggingFace 上的 StudyChat 数据集），用归纳式编码与异质转移网络分析（HTNA）刻画交互序列，区分高分组（Q1）与低分组（Q4）。发现高分组以"工具性求助"（提问、探究）为主，能诱发 AI 的 Tutor/Collaborator 教学式回应；低分组以"执行性求助"（委派任务）为主，使 AI 扮演 Executor 给出成品答案。AI 目前只是"镜像"学生意图而非优化学习，故呼吁具有教学意图的 AI 设计：检测无效委派并自适应引导向探究式交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI 催生了 vibe coding——学生以自然语言与 AI 协作编程，把 AI 从参考工具变为"队友"。已有研究多停留在使用模式、聚合指标与感知层面，或把交互当作黑箱（只看最终代码与情绪），缺乏对"学生如何发起求助—AI 如何回应—协作如何随序列演化"的细粒度过程性证据。更关键的隐患是：从公开社区式求助转向私密即时的 AI 交互后，"生产性挣扎"（productive struggle）、调试与自我解释等深度学习机制可能被"外包式委派"短路，而 AI 的被动顺从会进一步固化这种被动模式。因此需要实证刻画真实课程情境中学生-AI 协作的对话动力学，并据此回答三个研究问题：高低绩效学生的交互模式差异（RQ1）、求助策略如何诱发 AI 角色（RQ2）、交互模式对成绩的预测力（RQ3）。

Method: 数据：StudyChat 数据集（UMass Amherst COMPSCI 383 人工智能本科课程，2025 春季，GPT-4o-mini 驱动的网页助手），110 名学生、1,213 个会话、9,709 条提示 + 9,709 条回复 = 19,418 轮交互，含作业与三次考试成绩。编码：两套互补方案——(1)"交互元素"层：学生侧 Assignment/Code/Error/Exploration/Request/Results，AI 侧 Feedback/Explanation/Instruction/Solution/Example，由两名研究者按角色分工归纳式编码，多轮协商边界案例，交叉编码 10%（n=2,000）测一致性，逐码二值 Cohen's κ：学生提示 0.906–0.961、AI 回复 0.738–0.929；(2)"交互类型"层：以规则把 34 种提示元素组合与 18 种回复元素组合聚合为单一类型——提示类型 Inquire（exploration 无任务情境）、Integrate（exploration+情境）、Debug（error 无 exploration）、Delegate（任务向且无 exploration/error），对应工具性 vs 执行性求助；AI 角色 Tutor（仅解释/指导/示例）、Collaborator（反馈+解答）、Evaluator（仅反馈）、Executor（解答无反馈），仅 Executor 属非教学性。分析：按综合成绩四分位分组，取 Q1（均值 0.96，n=27，5,420 交互）与 Q4（均值 0.86，n=28，2,946 交互）；构建两个一阶马尔可夫 HTNA 模型（元素层、类型层），保留类型内与跨类型转移，用置换检验比较边权差值、Pearson 残差分析比较单码频率、卡方检验比较序列比例分布；两个线性回归（因变量为平均成绩）检验元素比例与类型比例的预测力，剔除高共线变量（VIF 2.24–3.13）。工具：R 的 TNA、tnaExtras、dplyr。

Result: RQ1（元素层）：Q1 与 Q4 元素分布显著差异（χ²(10)=18.9, p=.04）。Q1 的 exploration、example、explanation 过表征；Q4 的 solution、request、assignment、results 过表征。Q4 更倾向以 results/code 开场，Q1 以探索性提问开场。显著转移差异：Q4 的 code→exploration（diff −0.112, p=.011）显示其难以理解自有代码概念；Q1 的 request→code、code→request（各 +0.04, p=.043）及 example→exploration（+0.098, p=.019）更强；Q4 的 assignment→solution→assignment 循环显著更高（χ²=21.03/18.70），Q1 的前十序列 7 条含 exploration，并出现 explanation→example→exploration、exploration→code→feedback 等迭代式学习循环；AI 给 Q1 更频繁提供 explanation（+0.07）与 example，instructions 后导向非任务示例（+0.05），而 Q4 更导向现成 solution（−0.04）。RQ2（类型层）：类型分布差异显著（χ²(7)=22.3, p=.002）；Delegate 在 Q4 过表征、Inquire 在 Q1 过表征；Q1 获更多 Tutor 回应，Q4 获更多 Executor 回应。唯一显著类型转移为 Tutor→Delegate（Q4，diff −0.10, p=.007），Q1 更多 Tutor→Inquire（+0.06）；Q4 的 Inquire→Executor 反而更强（−0.04），即 AI 对"表露兴趣"的低分组学生仍直接给成品答案。模式上 Q1 主导 Inquire→Tutor 循环（0.056 vs 0.036，χ²=12.38），Q4 主导 Delegate→Executor 循环（0.107 vs 0.088）与 Delegate→Tutor（0.071 vs 0.052）。RQ3（预测）：元素模型显著（F(10,99)=3.85, p<.001, adj.R²=.21），AI 的 explanation 比例正向预测成绩（β=.46, SE=.15, p=.003），学生粘贴 assignment 比例负向预测（β=−.56, SE=.21, p=.009）；类型模型无显著预测（F(5,104)=.97, p=.44, adj.R²=−.001）。附录跨四分位分析显示 assignment→solution→assignment 循环随成绩下降单调加剧（Q4 最高，χ²=29.37），Inquire→Tutor 序列随成绩上升增强（χ²=33.04）。

Conclusion: vibe coding 本质是"意图传达与解读"的练习：AI 所扮演的角色由学生求助框架所"邀请"，故当前生成式 AI 只是在镜像学生的意图（生产性或被动），而非优化学习。工具性求助（探究+解释）与执行性求助（委派+成品答案）形成自我强化的不同学习轨迹。设计启示有二：(1) 不必彻底禁止 Executor 行为（可用于解锁进度、时间受限场景），而应检测"连续执行性交互"（尤其 assignment→solution 循环）并把角色从 Executor 自适应切换为引导式——先要求学生展示当前尝试、解释其思路，再给提示或分层输出（诊断→提示→可选解答），同时保留学生能动性；(2) 重构 AI 回复结构，避免单条消息捆绑 explanation/feedback/solution/instruction，改为分层输出、要求自我解释、给出多种方案，以恢复调试、批判性评估与自我解释的机会。作者警示：AI 在降低认知负担的同时把任务执行与部分学习调节责任迁移给 AI，可能削弱学生独立问题解决、创造性与理解/调试代码的能力，未来软件工程更需要的将是能审计与调试 AI 生成代码的人，因此 AI 系统必须具备教学意图，从"工具"进化为"队友"。

Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping higher education programming through vibe coding, where students collaborate with AI via natural language rather than writing code line-by-line. We conceptualize this practice as help-seeking, analyzing 19,418 interaction turns from 110 undergraduate students. Using inductive coding and Heterogeneous Transition Network Analysis, we examined interaction sequences to compare top- and low-performing students. Results reveal that top performers engaged in instrumental help-seeking -- inquiry and exploration -- eliciting tutor-like AI responses. In contrast, low performers relied on executive help-seeking, frequently delegating tasks and prompting the AI to assume an executor role focused on ready-made solutions. These findings indicate that currently generative AI mirrors student intent (whether productive or passive) rather than optimizing for learning. To evolve from tools to teammates, AI systems must move beyond passive compliance. We argue for pedagogically aligned design that detect unproductive delegation and adaptively steer educational interactions toward inquiry, ensuring student-AI partnerships augment rather than replace cognitive effort.

</details>

*João Pedro Gandarela,Thiago Rios,Stefan Menzel,André Freitas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种语言模型驱动的机械连杆设计框架，通过符号化抽象协调离散拓扑探索与连续参数优化，在多款开源大模型上验证可显著提升设计质量并实现可解释的机械推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械连杆设计涉及组合拓扑选择的离散决策与连续参数拟合的数值优化，传统方法难以有效协调这两类异构任务。

Method: 采用模块化架构：语言模型智能体探索离散拓扑结构，数值优化器拟合连续参数，符号提升算子将仿真轨迹翻译为定性描述符、运动标签、时序谓词和结构诊断信息，支撑跨迭代设计周期的模型解读。

Result: 在六个工程相关运动目标及三款开源模型上验证，模块化架构相比单体基线将几何误差降低68%，结构有效性提升134%；78.6%的迭代精化轨迹呈现可测量改进；系统正确诊断过约束（56.3%）和欠约束（35.6%）故障模式并提出有依据的修正方案。

Conclusion: 语言模型可在无需微调的情况下习得可解释的机械推理策略，且模型在三个系列中均展现出一致性能，证明了原则性符号抽象可弥合生成式AI与工程设计所需数值精度之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Designing mechanical linkages involves combinatorial topology selection and continuous parameter fitting. We show that language models can systematically improve linkage designs through symbolic representations. Language model agents explore discrete topologies while numerical optimisers fit continuous parameters. A symbolic lifting operator translates simulator trajectories into qualitative descriptors, motion labels, temporal predicates, and structural diagnostics that models interpret across iterative design cycles. Across six engineering-relevant motion targets and three open-source models (Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen3 4B, Qwen3 MoE 30B-A3B), the modular architecture reduces geometric error by up to 68% and improves structural validity by up to 134% over monolithic baselines. Critically, 78.6% of iterative refinement trajectories show measurable improvement, with the system correctly diagnosing overconstraint (56.3%) and underconstraint (35.6%) failure modes and proposing grounded corrections. Models across all three families acquire interpretable mechanical reasoning strategies without fine-tuning, demonstrating that principled symbolic abstraction bridges generative AI and the numerical precision required for engineering design.

</details>

*Nathan Li,Aikins Laryea,Yigit Ihlamur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对自主加密货币交易系统的出场策略进行系统性回测分析，发现精心设计的出场规则（严格止损、早收、移动止损）能显著提升风险调整后收益。研究还发现了评估方法论的关键问题：简单的时间序列划分会因特殊市场事件严重扭曲结果，改用随机化划分可缓解但非完美，并讨论了其固有缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主加密货币交易系统普遍重入场轻出场，出场规则多为固定设定且缺乏系统性测试，存在显著的策略优化空间。

Method: 对900多笔历史交易进行回放，针对每笔交易测试多种替代退出策略（止损、止盈、移动止损的不同参数设置），并将结果与现有生产配置进行对比；为减少特殊市场事件对结果的扭曲，在随机化数据上运行主要对比，并明确承认随机化方法的局限性。

Result: 出场设计确实重要：更强的出场配置能提升风险调整后表现，整体偏好更严格的损失限制、更早的利润锁定和更近的移动止损保护。

Conclusion: 更强壮的退出配置（更严格的止损、更早止盈、更近的移动止损）能改善风险调整后收益；文章提供了一个更严谨透明的退出策略调优框架，但随机化数据划分会引入偏差，需要谨慎解读；研究还揭示了时间切片划分可能因特殊市场事件导致结果失真，突显了评估设计中控制外部冲击的重要性。

Abstract: Autonomous crypto trading systems often spend most of their design effort on finding entries, while exits are left to fixed rules that are rarely tested in a systematic way. This paper examines whether better stop-loss and take-profit settings can improve the performance of an autonomous trading agent swarm. Using more than 900 historical trades, we replay each trade under many alternative exit policies and compare results against the existing production setup. The study finds that exit design matters meaningfully: stronger configurations improve risk-adjusted performance and generally favor tighter loss limits, earlier profit capture, and closer trailing protection. The paper also discusses a key evaluation challenge: a purely chronological split was initially used, but the newest trades fell into an unusual war-driven market period that sharply distorted test results. To reduce the influence of that single episode, the main comparison was run on randomized data, with the drawbacks of doing so acknowledged explicitly. Overall, the paper presents a practical framework for tuning exit logic in a more disciplined and transparent way.

</details>


### [84] [Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27151)
*Jinbiao Wei,Kangqi Ni,Yilun Zhao,Guo Gan,Arman Cohan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种事件驱动的步级级联框架，通过 Stuck Monitor 和 Milestone Monitor 两个轻量级监控器检测高风险时刻，仅在必要时升级到更强模型，解决计算机使用智能体计算资源分配不均的问题。该框架可叠加于现有智能体，无需修改架构或重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前计算机使用智能体在几乎每个交互步骤都调用大型多模态模型，导致成本高昂且速度缓慢。然而这种均匀计算分配本质上是低效的，因为长时域 GUI 任务具有高度异质性——许多步骤是常规的可以由更小更便宜的策略处理，而错误往往集中在相对较少的高风险时刻。

Method: 提出了一种事件驱动的步级级联框架，运行小型策略作为默认方案，仅当轻量级学习监控器检测到高风险时才升级到更强的模型。框架结合两个互补信号：Stuck Monitor（从近期推理-行动历史检测进度退化并触发恢复）和 Milestone Monitor（识别语义上有意义的检查点，在此处进行稀疏验证以捕获漂移）。

Result: 通过将始终运行的 frontier 模型推理转变为自适应、按需的计算分配，提高计算机使用智能体的效率。

Conclusion: 该框架是模块化且面向部署的，可以叠加在现有计算机使用智能体之上，无需改变底层智能体架构或重新训练大模型，将始终运行的 frontier 模型推理转变为交互过程中的自适应按需计算分配。

Abstract: Computer-use agents provide a promising path toward general software automation because they can interact directly with arbitrary graphical user interfaces instead of relying on brittle, application-specific integrations. Despite recent advances in benchmark performance, strong computer-use agents remain expensive and slow in practice, since most systems invoke large multimodal models at nearly every interaction step. We argue that this uniform allocation of compute is fundamentally inefficient for long-horizon GUI tasks. Such trajectories are highly heterogeneous: many steps are routine and can be handled reliably by smaller, cheaper policies, while errors tend to concentrate at a relatively small number of high-risk moments. Across computer-use benchmarks, these failures repeatedly take two forms: progress stalls, where the agent loops, repeats ineffective actions, or fails to make meaningful progress, and silent semantic drift, where the agent continues taking locally plausible actions after already deviating from the user's true goal. To address this inefficiency, we propose an event-driven, step-level cascade for computer-use agents that runs a small policy by default and escalates to a stronger model only when lightweight learned monitors detect elevated risk. Our framework combines two complementary signals: a Stuck Monitor that detects degraded progress from recent reasoning-action history and triggers recovery, and a Milestone Monitor that identifies semantically meaningful checkpoints where sparse verification is most informative for catching drift. This design turns always-on frontier-model inference into adaptive, on-demand compute allocation over the course of an evolving interaction. The framework is modular and deployment-oriented: it can be layered on top of existing computer-use agents without changing the underlying agent architecture or retraining the large model.

</details>


### [85] [Interval Orders, Biorders and Credibility-limited Belief Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27156)
*Richard Booth,Ivan Varzinczak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索了信念修正中两种比全前序更一般的偏好结构——区间序和双向序，提供了相应修正算子的公理化刻画，并引入了一类与汉森等人的有限可信修正相关的新型非优先修正算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统信念修正理论通常使用全前序作为偏好结构，但存在其他更一般的序结构尚未被充分探索。

Method: 使用区间序和双向序（非线性偏好结构）对信念修正进行建模，并通过公理化方法刻画所得到的修正算子族。

Result: 对区间序和双向序修正算子进行了公理化刻画；发现双向序修正虽满足成功公理但可能产生不一致输出；通过修改定义排除"不可信"输入，可得到满足一致性公理但不满足成功公理的新型有限优先级修正算子族。

Conclusion: Biorder-based approach is suitable for scenarios where agents might initially reject but later accept new information upon receiving additional explanation.

Abstract: Rational belief revision is commonly viewed as being based on a preference order between possible worlds, with the resulting new belief set being those sentences true in all the most preferred models of the incoming new information. Usually, such a preference order is taken to be a total preorder. Nevertheless, there are other, more general classes of ordering that can also be employed. In this paper, we explore two such classes that have been studied within the theory of rational choice but have seen limited or no application in belief revision. We begin with interval orders, introduced by Fishburn in the '80s, which associate with each possible world a nonnegative `interval' of plausibility. We then move on to biorders, studied by Aleskerov, Bouyssou, and Monjardet, which generalise interval orders by allowing the intervals to have negative lengths, a feature that can be used to capture a notion of dissonance or instability. We provide axiomatic characterisations of these two resulting families of belief revision operators, as well as of two further families of interest that lie between interval orders and biorders. We show that while biorder-based revisions satisfy the Success postulate, they do not always yield consistent outputs. By modifying their definition to discard inputs that lead to inconsistency as `incredible', we derive new families of so-called non-prioritised revision that satisfy the Consistency postulate, but not the Success one. These families are linked to credibility-limited revision operators of Hansson et al., but for which the set of credible sentences does not satisfy the single-sentence closure condition. We argue that the biorder-based approach is well-suited for scenarios where an agent might initially reject new information, but may accept it when presented with additional explanation.

</details>


### [86] [Evaluating TabPFN for Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion in Data Limited Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27195)
*Brad Ye,Bulent Soykan,Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis,Hsin-Hsiung Huang,Laura J. Brattain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将TabPFN（一种表格数据预训练基础模型）与传统机器学习方法对比，用于预测MCI向AD的3年转换。实验基于ADNI的TADPOLE数据集，利用多模态生物标志物特征进行评估。结果表明TabPFN在预测性能上优于LightGBM等传统方法，尤其在低数据场景下展现出显著优势，证明了基础模型在数据受限的疾病预测任务中的应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于纵向数据有限，MCI到AD的转换预测模型难以建立，需要探索更有效的方法来提高预测性能。

Method: 在TADPOLE数据集（源自ADNI）上，使用多模态生物标志物特征（人口统计学、APOE4、MRI体积、脑脊液标记物、PET成像），对比测试TabPFN与XGBoost、Random Forest、LightGBM、Logistic Regression等传统机器学习方法在不同训练样本量（N=50至1000）下的表现。

Result: TabPFN达到最高性能（AUC=0.892），优于LightGBM（AUC=0.860）；在小样本训练场景下（N=50），TabPFN仍保持较强的AUC，而传统机器学习方法表现显著下降。

Conclusion: TabPFN在低数据场景下表现优异，在有限标注数据的疾病预测任务中具有重要应用价值。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimers Diseases (AD) is essential for early intervention, however, developing reliable conversion predictive models is difficult to develop due to limited longitudinal data availability We evaluate TabPFN (Tabular Pre-Trained Foundation Network) against traditional machine learning methods for predicting 3 year MCI to AD conversion using the TADPOLE dataset derived from ADNI. Using multimodal biomarker features extracted from demographics, APOE4, MRI volumes, CSF markers, and PET imaging, we conducted an experimental comparison across varying training set sizes (N=50 to 1000) and models including XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM, and Logistic Regression. TabPFN achieved one the highest performance (AUC=0.892), outperforming LightGBM (AUC=0.860) and demonstrating advantages in low data settings. At N=50 training samples, TabPFN maintained strong AUC while the traditional machine learning models struggles at small training samples. These findings demonstrate that foundation models are promising for disease prediction in data limited scenarios, such as Alzheimers diseases.

</details>


### [87] [Toward Personalized Digital Twins for Cognitive Decline Assessment: A Multimodal, Uncertainty-Aware Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27217)
*Bulent Soykan,Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis,Hsin-Hsiung Huang,Laura J. Brattain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PCD-DT框架——一个用于个性化建模神经退行性疾病轨迹的多模态不确定性感知数字孪生系统。该框架整合状态空间模型、多模态融合和不确定性验证三大技术，在TADPOLE数据上验证了可行性，多模态预测性能显著优于简单基线，展示了该框架在精准医疗中的潜在应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知功能下降在个体间具有高度异质性，这种异质性给预后判断、临床试验设计和治疗规划带来了重大挑战。传统的群体层面模型难以捕捉患者个性化的疾病演变轨迹。

Method: 提出PCD-DT框架，包含三个核心方法：(1)潜在状态空间模型用于个体化时间动态建模；(2)多模态融合整合临床、生物标志物和影像特征；(3)不确定性感知验证与自适应更新。此外，采用LSTM序列模型进行下一访视预测，并探讨贝叶斯张量建模进行高维影像融合。实验采用TADPOLE数据集的3,003个访视对序列进行多模态预测消融研究。

Result: 在TADPOLE纵向数据上，认知正常组与阿尔茨海默病组在ADAS13、侧脑室体积和海马体积三个指标上呈现明显分离。LSTM多模态预测消融实验中，认知联合MRI的配置在ADAS13（标准化RMSE=0.4419）和侧脑室体积（标准化RMSE=0.5842）预测上达到最低误差，优于Last Observation Carried Forward基线方法。

Conclusion: PCD-DT是一个有前景的个性化神经退行性疾病建模框架，在TADPOLE数据集上验证了可行性，多模态融合（认知+MRI）在预测任务中表现最佳。但仍需加强不确定性校准和更长时域预测能力。该框架有望成为临床可部署的不确定性感知数字孪生系统的奠基性工作。

Abstract: Cognitive decline is highly heterogeneous across individuals, which complicates prognosis, trial design, and treatment planning. We present the Personalized Cognitive Decline Assessment Digital Twin (PCD-DT), a multimodal and uncertainty-aware framework for modeling patient-specific disease trajectories from sparse, noisy, and irregular longitudinal data. The framework combines three methodological components: (1) latent state-space models for individualized temporal dynamics, (2) multimodal fusion for clinical, biomarker, and imaging features, and (3) uncertainty-aware validation and adaptive updating for robust digital twin operation. We also outline how conditional generative models can support data augmentation and stress testing for underrepresented progression patterns. As a preliminary feasibility study, we analyze longitudinal TADPOLE trajectories and show clear separation between cognitively normal and Alzheimer's disease cohorts in ADAS13, ventricle volume, and hippocampal volume over five years. We further conduct a multimodal next-visit prediction ablation using an LSTM sequence model on 3{,}003 visit-pair sequences derived from TADPOLE, where the combined cognitive plus MRI configuration achieves the lowest standardized RMSE for both ADAS13 (0.4419) and ventricle volume (0.5842), outperforming a Last Observation Carried Forward baseline. A Bayesian tensor modeling component for high-dimensional imaging fusion is also discussed. These results support the feasibility of the proposed architecture while also highlighting the need for stronger uncertainty calibration and longer-horizon predictive evaluation. The PCD-DT framework provides a principled starting point for personalized in silico modeling in neurodegenerative disease. This work positions PCD-DT as a foundational step toward clinically deployable, uncertainty-aware digital twin systems.

</details>


### [88] [Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27221)
*Yuxuan Huang,Yihang Chen,Zhiyuan He,Yuxiang Chen,Ka Yiu Lee,Huichi Zhou,Weilin Luo,Meng Fang,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Web2BigTable 是一个面向"网页到表格（web-to-table）"检索任务的双层多智能体 LLM 框架：上层编排器（Orchestrator，GPT-5 mini）把查询分解为可并行的子任务，下层工人（Worker，Gemini 3 Flash，最多 10 个并行）通过共享 Markdown "工作板"（workboard）异步协作并进化出可复用的执行技能；全系统通过 Run–Verify–Reflect 闭环把经验蒸馏为人类可读的 SKILL.md 技能库，全程不更新模型参数（training-free）。在 WideSearch 上 Avg@4 Success Rate 达 38.50（次优 5.10 的 7.5 倍）、Row F1 63.53、Item F1 80.12；在深度检索基准 XBench-DeepSearch 上准确率 73.0，同样超过所有已报告基线。消融显示"学到的编排器分解技能"贡献最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic web search 正分化为两种需求：depth search（对单一目标做长链多跳推理）与 wide search（跨大量实体与异构来源做 schema 对齐的结构化聚合）。现有方法两端都不足：(1) 单体（monolithic）智能体在宽检索中上下文饱和、误差累积、开局固定计划无法随新证据调整；(2) 层次化框架与自动工作流虽有任务分解，但多依赖固定/弱自适应启发式，下游执行的信息很少反馈回上游分解（缺乏协同适配）；(3) 自进化与记忆增强智能体（外部技能、结构化长期记忆）多只在单层研究，未能同时优化"如何分解"与"如何执行"；(4) 多智能体之间缺少协调机制，导致重复探索、证据冲突、覆盖缺口无法被察觉与修复。论文因此将任务定义为 Web-to-Table Search：给定自然语言查询与目标 schema，输出行=实体、列=属性、每格均经网络证据独立验证的结构化表，成功标准由"覆盖广度"而非单点推理深度决定。

Method: 1）双层架构与两类记忆。上层编排器 π_o 采样分解 τ=(τ_1..τ_N)，下层 N 个工人 π_w^(i) 在条件 (τ_i, m_e, s_i) 下并行执行；全局交互历史被外化为共享 workboard m_e（短期工作记忆，分钟级生命周期，episode 结束即弃），分解策略与执行技能被外化为两个长期语义记忆库 S_o、S_w（小时/天级累积，推理时冻结），全部以人可读 SKILL.md 存储，底层 LLM 全程冻结。
2）共享工作板与异步协调。workboard 为一个 Markdown 文档，分三区：任务清单（全局进度可见）、按标签（如 <t1_result>）分区的工人结果槽、编排器预填的共享上下文（约束与格式约定）。写操作由文件锁保护且严格限于自身标签区，全局可读。这种"读-写不对称"自然涌现三种自适应行为：冗余规避（发现同伴已抽取的实体则跳过）、覆盖缺口检测（检查同伴输出中缺失字段/不一致并调整检索）、策略适配（吸收同伴成功的高效来源 URL、查询式与格式规范并绕开失败路径）。工人不仅贴最终答案，还自主判断哪些中间信息（实验计划、部分发现、可用 URL）值得共享，从而形成"信息级联"。
3）训练阶段（Run–Verify–Reflect）。在带 gold 表格的小规模查询集（每基准合成 20 条扰动查询）上循环：Run=一次完整推理；Verify=用高效 LLM 压缩每个工人 JSONL 轨迹为结构化摘要（分解策略、查询式、失败点、覆盖统计），按类型专用比较器（精确匹配、数值容差、URL 归一化、LLM 语义判定）做 cell 级比对，聚合为含缺失行类别、低分列、轨迹异常（上下文截断/工具超时）的结构化错误报告；Reflect=按"结构分解模式"（split-by-entity / split-by-time-period / split-by-category / split-by-source 等）而非语义主题聚类，为每个簇合成可泛化技能（仅允许结构性占位符以防过拟合），并生成把查询结构特征映射到策略的 router 技能，写回 S_o；两个技能库更新均为单调追加（S_o^k ⊆ S_o^{k+1}）。
4）工人技能进化。SkillResolver 按优先级检索：本地技能精确名匹配 → 混合检索（BM25 + ChromaDB/BAAI-bge-m3 嵌入，RRF 融合，可选 cross-encoder 重排，覆盖 8000+ 云端技能目录）→ SkillCreator 即时合成新技能（function skill：带 CLI 的 Python 脚本，AST 校验；knowledge skill：YAML frontmatter + Markdown），新技能即时入索引；技能执行失败时进入自主反思修复循环（错误栈+技能代码→LLM 生成修正版→AST 校验→替换），并支持 evolve_skill 扩展能力；全局单例上下文使任一工人产生/修改的技能即时广播给全体。
5）推理阶段。冻结技能库、单次前向：编排器先用 task-router 判定查询结构类型（实体数、schema 复杂度、时间跨度、预期输出量）再调用相应分解技能，每个子任务给出 10–20 条目标量的独立指令与输出 schema，初始化 workboard；工人按 ReAct 循环检索/写入槽位（生成超时 120s、工具超时 30s，MCP 服务器 asyncio.gather + 信号量限流 10 并发）；最后编排器校验行数、列覆盖与一致性并聚合为统一大表，不做摘要/去重等后处理。
6）实现。编排器 GPT-5 mini，工人 Gemini 3 Flash（Memento-Skills 智能体），8 个内置工具（bash、str_replace、file_create、view、read_skill、route_skill、read_workboard、edit_workboard）；XBench 上改用 5 个工人（深度任务更受益于串行深度而非并行广度）。

Result: WideSearch（200 任务，100 en/100 zh，15 领域；20 条合成训练查询，原 200 条为留出测试；每系统独立跑 4 次报 Avg@4/Max@4）：Avg@4 SR 38.50（次优 5.10，即 7.5×），Row F1 63.53（+25.03），Item F1 80.12（+14.42）；Max@4 分别为 40.00 / 65.12 / 82.48。分语种：en SR 46.00、Row F1 66.74、Item F1 84.23；zh SR 31.00、Row F1 60.32、Item F1 76.01。对比：最强单智能体 Claude-4.5-Sonnet Item F1 65.70、Seed1.8 63.80、GPT-5 High 62.20，仍落后至少 14 分；所有既有多智能体框架均低于 6 SR / 39 Row F1 / 63 Item F1。
XBench-DeepSearch（中文深度检索，LLM-as-judge 准确率）：Web2BigTable 73.0，超过 Minimax-M2 72.0、MiroFlow(GPT-5) 72.0、DeepSeek-V3.2 71.0、GLM-4.5 70.0、Kimi-Researcher 69.0 等全部基线；作者另复测的 OpenRouter 版本为 67.0/69.0/70.0/73.0（不同模型组合）。
消融（WideSearch Avg@4 / XBench Acc）：去掉学到的编排器技能 → 7.00 / 45.23 / 62.87 / 41.0（降幅最大）；去掉 workboard → 27.50 / 54.81 / 73.45 / 60.0；去掉工人技能进化 → 33.00 / 59.67 / 76.38 / 64.0。同骨干对照：GPT-5 mini 单智能体 4.00/22.10/33.28/35.0，Gemini 3 Flash 3.00/18.70/31.61/28.0，框架增益 +34.5~+46.8（SR/Item F1）与 +38~+45（XBench），说明收益来自框架而非骨干模型。
案例：ws_en_006（Taylor Swift 534 行 ×5 列）→ 学到的 split-by-entity + 大体量按地区再切 + 缺口检测工人 + Round 2 追加核查，抓取 653 原始行、去重 556 行，Row F1 93.8%、Item F1 96.2%（单智能体仅 12.8–15.2% Row F1、不足 100 行）；ws_en_091（AMD Zen 331 行 ×12 列）→ split-by-category 达 Row F1 89%、Item F1 96%；ws_zh_069（ByteDance Seed + DeepSeek 约 130 行）→ split-by-source + 专职 arXiv 交叉校验工人，Row F1 91%、Item F1 94%，并纠正 8 条出版日期跨源冲突。

Conclusion: Web2BigTable 证明：把"宽度"与"可靠性"交给双层记忆中介的自进化架构，可以在不更新任何参数（training-free、仅靠人可读外部记忆与上下文学习）的前提下，大幅超越依赖更强骨干或固定启发式的既有 web search 系统；其中上游"分解策略学习"是性能增益的主要来源，workboard 异步协调次之，工人级技能进化提供互补增益。其可迁移的洞见是：分解方式应随查询的结构类型（按实体/按类别/按来源/按时间）自适应学习，且多工人应通过全局可读、写入隔离的共享文档实现"部分发现即时可见"，从而把静态结果账本变成活的协调媒介。论文同时给出后续理论化方向 Memento-Team（将编排者—工人交互形式化为 Stackelberg 博弈，把策略记忆与执行记忆作为唯一决策变量，并证明共享 workboard 上异步记忆更新的收敛性）。
需要留意的局限：WideSearch 上绝对成功率仍不足 40%（绝大多数任务未做到整表精确匹配），增益高度依赖 20 条合成训练查询所学的技能是否覆盖新查询结构；论文未报告 token/时间/成本开销与工具调用次数；XBench 部分基线为作者自行复测（因官方推理配置未公开），可比性存疑；语种上中文明显弱于英文（SR 31 vs 46）；所用模型命名（GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3 Flash/3 Pro、Seed1.8、Minimax-M2 等）非公开标准版本，复现需依赖其代码库。

Abstract: Agentic web search increasingly faces two distinct demands: deep reasoning over a single target, and structured aggregation across many entities and heterogeneous sources. Current systems struggle on both fronts. Breadth-oriented tasks demand schema-aligned outputs with wide coverage and cross-entity consistency, while depth-oriented tasks require coherent reasoning over long, branching search trajectories. We introduce \textbf{Web2BigTable}, a multi-agent framework for web-to-table search that supports both regimes. Web2BigTable adopts a bi-level architecture in which an upper-level orchestrator decomposes the task into sub-problems and lower-level worker agents solve them in parallel. Through a closed-loop run--verify--reflect process, the framework jointly improves decomposition and execution over time via persistent, human-readable external memory, with self-evolving updates to each single-agent. During execution, workers coordinate through a shared workspace that makes partial findings visible, allowing them to reduce redundant exploration, reconcile conflicting evidence, and adapt to emerging coverage gaps. Web2BigTable sets a new state of the art on WideSearch, reaching an Avg@4 Success Rate of \textbf{38.50} ($7.5\times$ the second best at 5.10), Row F1 of \textbf{63.53} (+25.03 over the second best), and Item F1 of \textbf{80.12} (+14.42 over the second best). It also generalises to depth-oriented search on XBench-DeepSearch, achieving 73.0 accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/web2bigtable/web2bigtable.

</details>


### [89] [Focus Session: Autonomous Systems Dependability in the era of AI: Design Challenges in Safety, Security, Reliability and Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27807)
*Behnaz Ranjbar,Kirankumar Raveendiran,Sudeep Pasricha,Samarjit Chakraborty,Cecilia Carbonelli,Akash Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI时代设计可信自动驾驶和嵌入式系统的新兴方法、架构和框架，关注可靠性建模、安全系统设计和学习使能组件的认证方法，旨在弥合AI创新与可认证系统级可信性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入式安全关键系统（如下一代汽车和自动驾驶平台）的复杂度不断提升，硬件-软件异构性加剧，AI/ML组件的集成引入了动态和不确定行为，传统可靠性、安全性和安保管理方法难以满足严格的实时性、功耗和安全约束。

Method: 探索了新兴的方法论、架构和框架，涵盖可靠性建模、安全系统设计和针对不完善的学习使能组件的认证方法，跨越多个抽象层次并兼顾设计和运行时保证。

Result: 提出了涵盖可靠性建模、安全系统设计和认证方法的综合框架，为设计可信的自主系统和嵌入式系统提供了新的方法论支撑。

Conclusion: 提出了可靠性建模、安全系统设计和认证方法的进展，旨在弥合AI创新与可认证系统级可信性之间的差距，为下一代汽车和自动驾驶平台提供理论框架和实践指导。

Abstract: The design of embedded safety-critical systems such as those used in next-generation automotive and autonomous platforms, is increasingly challenged by escalating system complexity, hardware-software heterogeneity, and the integration of intelligent, data-driven components. Ensuring dependability in such systems requires a holistic approach that spans multiple abstraction layers and encompasses both design- and run-time assurance. Traditional methods for reliability, safety, and security management often fall short in addressing the dynamic and uncertain behaviors introduced by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) components, especially under stringent real-time, power, and safety constraints. While AI and ML offer powerful predictive, adaptive, and self-optimizing capabilities that can enhance system dependability, their inherent non-determinism, data-dependence, and lack of formal guarantees introduce new challenges for verification, validation, and certification. This paper explores emerging methodologies, architectures, and frameworks for designing dependable autonomous and embedded systems in the era of AI. It highlight advances in reliability modeling, secure system design, and certification approaches that account for imperfect, learning-enabled components, aiming to bridge the gap between AI innovation and certifiable system-level dependability.

</details>


### [90] [AutoSurfer -- Teaching Web Agents through Comprehensive Surfing, Learning, and Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27253)
*Fazle Elahi Faisal,Qianhui Wu,Baolin Peng,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoSurfer（Microsoft Research）是一种面向网页智能体的自动化网页轨迹生成框架，核心是"边浏览边学习"的系统化广度优先（BFS）站点探索机制：以队列维护页面与动作轨迹，递归展开多级菜单/下拉元素，区分固定元素与动态元素进行差异化采样；并把探索轨迹同时用于任务合成（抑制幻觉、提升任务连贯性）与轨迹精修（作为提示引导 web agent 修正轨迹），最终生成 SFT 数据训练"网站专属 LLM"(wLLM)。在 WebArena 上微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，整体任务成功率 24.23%（单站 wLLM 变体 23.71%），优于 Explorer(4.64%)、OS-Genesis(13.40%)、SynthAgent(19.59%)；任务多样性得分 0.7774 亦为最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 驱动的网页智能体（SteP、Magentic-One、CUA 等）已能自动化复杂网页任务，但其准确率受限于高质量网页交互/轨迹训练数据的稀缺。现有的自动轨迹生成范式存在三类缺陷：(1) 覆盖不全——AgentTrek 依赖外部教程（有限且易幻觉），Explorer 仅从首页提出任务（遗漏深层功能），OS-Genesis/SynthAgent 采用随机游走探索（易漏掉 GUI 动作）；(2) 任务合成幻觉与歧义——基于孤立的单步动作或局部页面内容逆推任务，缺乏全局导航语境；(3) 任务与轨迹松耦合——仅靠 LLM 推理精修容易偏离正确执行路径。此外，作者指出此前工作均非为"训练网站专属 LLM (wLLM)"而设计，而覆盖站点完整动作空间正是训练 wLLM 的必要条件，因此需要一个系统性、全面覆盖站点动作空间的轨迹生成器。

Method: **问题形式化**：任务 t 为 (任务描述 td, 轨迹 tr)，轨迹为观察-动作序列 tr={o1,a1,...,on}；目标是通过探索站点 W 最大化发现的任务集 T_W^AS，使 |T_W − T_W^AS| 最小；复杂任务定义为需 ≥2 个 GUI 动作的任务。

**1) 系统化广度优先探索（Traversal）**：维护页面+动作轨迹的队列（初始为首页），逐页用 LLM 发现"简单任务"（同页可完成，如"跳转到论坛页""搜索公寓推荐"），过滤冗余/风险/不重要任务（授权登录登出、账户创建修改、支付、广告弹窗模态框、tooltip 等），并补充"信息索取型"任务；逐个执行，若到达新页面则入队，递归展开，直至页面耗尽或复杂任务数达上限 1000。

**2) 菜单/下拉递归展开**：菜单项初始不可见，先覆盖可见元素；执行后若页面未跳转但发生"中等程度视觉变化"（由 LLM 判定），则视为菜单被展开，从新增可见元素中生成新任务 S_new，递归形成层级；层级完全展开后删除仅用于展开的中间任务、保留叶子任务，并用祖先动作前缀重建（如"进入用户设置"变为点击头像+点击设置两步）。

**3) 固定 vs 动态元素差异化处理**：LLM 将任务划分为固定元素集 S_f（位置稳定、结果一致，如搜索框）与动态元素集 S_d（列表类、内容相关，如各论坛链接，并按功能分组）；固定元素全覆盖执行，动态元素仅采样代表性子集 S_dsamp（如 0–2 个论坛链接），以在覆盖与冗余之间取得平衡。

**4) 跨页面知识传播与去重**：队列把先前页面已发现的任务传给后续页面，避免重复发现（如搜索功能只需在首页发现一次）。

**5) 复杂任务合成**：遵循 OS-Genesis 的提示策略，当观察到跨 ≥3 个 GUI 动作的逻辑连贯序列时合成"动作导向"复杂任务，用 1–5 分完整性评估，仅保留 ≥3 分者；同时合成"信息索取型"复杂任务（如"找出技术子版块前 5 条热门帖子"），并为每个任务记录对应动作轨迹。

**6) 轨迹引导的精修**：将探索任务元组 (td_ex, 轨迹) 交给 web agent（使用 SynthAgent 的 agent），把探索轨迹作为 hint 输入，agent 在执行中同时改写任务描述并生成真实轨迹 t_ref = f_wa(t_ex)；若判定任务失败或超过 30 步未完成则丢弃该元组。相较于 OS-Genesis 仅凭末步动作、Explorer 仅凭首页内容，AutoSurfer 的精修有完整导航语境支撑。

**7) SFT 数据构建与微调**：每个 (观察-动作) 对转为一条监督样本 g=(td_ref, f_user(o_j, 最近 3 个历史动作), f_assistant(a_j))，末观察配终止动作；序列化为 ShareGPT 对话格式（user 含任务描述、截图、无障碍树、最近 3 步动作；assistant 含下一动作与推理）。用与 SynthAgent 相同的超参微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct（并小规模验证 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct）；探索/合成/精修阶段均使用 GPT-4.1 以保证数据质量。

Result: **WebArena 主结果（Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 微调）**：AutoSurfer_webarena（四站合并数据）总体 24.23%，AutoSurfer_wllm（各站独立训练）23.71%，均显著优于 SynthAgent 19.59%、OS-Genesis 13.40%、Explorer 4.64%；原始 Qwen2.5 基线仅 9.36%。分站看：Shopping 23.64、Gitlab 19.64、Reddit 34.62（AutoSurfer_wllm 最佳），CMS 24.56、Reddit 26.92、Gitlab 26.79（AutoSurfer_webarena 最佳）。GPT-4.1 基线为 25.77%，AutoSurfer 已接近该上限；wllm 与 webarena 两变体性能接近，说明单站数据已足以建模站点能力。

**不同模型验证**：在 Reddit 上微调 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，从 3.85% 提升至 30.77%，与 Qwen2.5 趋势一致，说明更强基座模型同样缺乏高质量网页交互数据。

**任务多样性**：基于 text-embedding-3-large 的归一化平均成对余弦相似度取补，AutoSurfer 多样性得分 0.7774，优于 OS-Genesis 与 SynthAgent（均为 0.7459）；Explorer 因平均每站不足 2 个任务而被排除。

**探索 vs 精修消融**：Reddit 上仅用探索数据微调得 11.54%，远低于精修数据的 34.62%，原因是探索阶段动作空间受限（不滚动、只采样少数动态项）导致监督不完整；精修阶段可使用完整动作空间并删去冗余步骤（如"查看某帖全部评论"仅保留搜索与分析步骤）。

**低准确率归因**：本文沿用 SynthAgent 的简单 LLM-based agent 以隔离数据质量贡献，故各方法绝对精度均偏低，代表模型能力而非先进 agent 系统的上限。

Conclusion: AutoSurfer 通过"系统性广度优先探索 + 轨迹引导的任务合成 + 轨迹引导的轨迹精修"三项耦合设计，显著优于现有自动轨迹生成方法：既覆盖站点动作空间又抑制任务幻觉，产出的 SFT 数据可训练出网站专属 LLM（wLLM），在 WebArena 上以 7B 模型取得 24.23% 的整体成功率并具备最高任务多样性。论文同时首次明确"为训练 wLLM 而设计"的定位，指出单站数据即可支撑站点级建模。作者给出的未来方向是以精修轨迹作为强化学习的初始化，配合在线交互与任务完成奖励，以适应更长时程和跨站任务，突破静态 SFT 的局限。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized web agents that can automate complex tasks on websites. However, their accuracy remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality web trajectory training data. Existing automatic trajectory generation methods suffer from incomplete website coverage due to homepage-based task proposals or random-walk exploration. Such methods often result in hallucinated or ambiguous task synthesis that lead to incomplete and unreliable trajectory generation. Here, we present AutoSurfer, a comprehensive web trajectory generator that addresses these limitations through three key innovations. First, AutoSurfer employs a systematic breadth-first exploration strategy that maintains a queue of discovered pages and action traces, propagates knowledge across pages to avoid redundant exploration, and recursively expands multi-level graphical user interface elements - closely resembling how a human would learn a new website. Second, AutoSurfer leverages the exploration trajectory to guide task synthesis, reducing hallucinations by grounding complex tasks in actual navigation paths rather than isolated actions or page content alone. Third, AutoSurfer uses the same exploration trajectory as hints to steer a web agent toward more accurate and reliable trajectory refinement. Together, these innovations enable AutoSurfer to comprehensively cover a website's action space and generate data suitable for training website-specific LLMs. We evaluate AutoSurfer on the WebArena benchmark by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art methods - Explorer, OS-Genesis, and SynthAgent - achieving up to 24.23% overall task completion accuracy compared to 19.59% for the best prior method. Further, task diversity analysis demonstrates that AutoSurfer yields a more diverse distribution of synthesized tasks.

</details>


### [91] [OptimusKG: Unifying biomedical knowledge in a modern multimodal graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27269)
*Lucas Vittor,Ayush Noori,Iñaki Arango,Joaquín Polonuer,Sam Rodriques,Andrew White,David A. Clifton,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OptimusKG is a comprehensive biomedical knowledge graph harmonizing structured resources across multiple domains with schema enforcement, containing ~190K nodes and ~22M edges with literature-validated relationships, designed for ML and LLM applications.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing biomedical KGs suffer from either lack of schema constraints (unstructured-derived) or poor harmonization (structured resources), limiting their utility for unified representation across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains.

Method: Constructed a multimodal labeled property graph (LPG) integrating structured/semi-structured resources with top-level schema enforcement while retaining granular type-specific properties; validated using PaperQA3 multimodal agent to assess edge evidence support from literature.

Result: OptimusKG contains 190,531 nodes (10 types), 21.8M edges (26 types), 67.2M property instances with 110.3M values across 150 keys, from 18 ontologies; PaperQA3 validated 70.0% of true edges with literature support and 83.4% of false edges without support.

Conclusion: OptimusKG provides a harmonized, schema-constrained biomedical KG with provenance, distributed as Apache Parquet files for downstream applications including graph-based ML, LLM knowledge retrieval, and hypothesis generation.

Abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) are widely used in the life sciences, yet many are derived from unstructured documents and therefore lack schema-level constrains, whereas graphs assembled from structured resources are difficult to harmonize into a unified representation. We present OptimusKG, a multimodal biomedical labeled property graph (LPG) built from structured and semi-structured resources to preserve factual, type-specific metadata across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. OptimusKG contains 190,531 nodes across 10 entity types, 21,813,816 edges across 26 relation types, and 67,249,863 property instances encoding 110,276,843 values across 150 distinct property keys, derived from 18 ontologies and controlled vocabularies. The graph enforces a top-level schema for nodes and edges and retains granular, type-specific properties, cross-references, and provenance across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. We assessed the validity of OptimusKG by evaluating whether graph relationships are supported by evidence from the scientific literature using a multimodal agent, PaperQA3. PaperQA3 identified supporting evidence for 70.0% of sampled edges, whereas 83.4% of sampled false edges received no supporting evidence. Edges without literature support were concentrated in associations derived from experimental and functional genomics resources, suggesting that OptimusKG captures biomedical knowledge that may precede synthesis in the scientific literature. OptimusKG is distributed as Apache Parquet files, providing a standardized resource for graph-based machine learning, knowledge-grounded retrieval with large language models, and biomedical discovery use cases such as hypothesis generation.

</details>


### [92] [The Inverse-Wisdom Law: Architectural Tribalism and the Consensus Paradox in Agentic Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27274)
*Dahlia Shehata,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了多智能体系统中的"共识悖论"——智能体群会优先内部一致性而非逻辑正确性，形成反向智慧效应而非群体智慧。添加更多逻辑智能体反而稳定错误轨迹，逻辑审计的引入会导致内部熵归零而错误率归一的"逻辑饱和"现象。研究定义了部落主义系数和谄媚权重作为失败关键机制，并提出异质性原则作为安全要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战多智能体系统研究中的公理假设——即智能体协作遵循"群体智慧"理论，提出智能体群可能优先考虑内部架构一致性而非外部逻辑真值的假设。

Method: 开展36组实验，涵盖12,804条轨迹横跨三个SOTA基准测试(GAIA、Multi-Challenge、SWE-bench)，评估三种顶级模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4)间的交互作用。

Result: 证明逆智慧定律(Inverse-Wisdom Law)：在亲缘主导型群中，添加逻辑智能体反而增加错误轨迹的稳定性而非真值的概率。引入额外逻辑审计后系统趋近逻辑饱和态——内部熵降至零而事实错误率升至统一。发现架构部落主义不对称性(Architectural Tribalism Asymmetry)，并定义部落主义系数(Tribalism Coefficient)和谄媚权重(Sycophantic Weight)作为群系统失败的主要机制决定因素。

Conclusion: 提出异质性原则(Heterogeneity Mandate)作为弹性智能体架构的基础性安全要求，表明智能体系统的最终完整性严格由合成器的接受逻辑而非聚合智能体质量决定。

Abstract: As AI transitions toward multi-agent systems (MAS) to solve complex workflows, research paradigms operate on the axiomatic assumption that agent collaboration mirrors the "Wisdom of the Crowd". We challenge this assumption by formalizing the Consensus Paradox: a phenomenon where agentic swarms prioritize internal architectural agreement over external logical truth. Through a 36 experiments encompassing 12,804 trajectories across three state-of-the-art (SOTA) benchmarks (GAIA, Multi-Challenge, and SWE-bench), we prove the Inverse-Wisdom Law: in kinship-dominant swarms, adding logical agents increases the stability of erroneous trajectories rather than the probability of truth. The introduction of additional logical audits converges the system toward a Logic Saturation where internal entropy hits zero while factual error hits unity. By evaluating the interaction between the 3 preeminent SOTA models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.4), we establish the Architectural Tribalism Asymmetry as a mechanistic law of transformer weights. We demonstrate that terminal swarm integrity is strictly gated by the synthesizer's receptive logic, rather than aggregate agent quality. We define the Tribalism Coefficient and the Sycophantic Weight as the primary mechanistic determinants of swarm failure. Finally, we establish the Heterogeneity Mandate as a foundational safety requirement for resilient agentic architectures.

</details>


### [93] [Mechanized Foundations of Structural Governance: Machine-Checked Proofs for Governed Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27289)
*Alan L. McCann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了认知工作流系统结构化治理的五大形式化结果，建立了治理安全性的协同归纳理论基础，证明了四个原子原语的表达完备性，并通过BEAM运行时的验证解释器规范连接了抽象模型与实际部署。形式化工作规模宏大（12000行Coq代码，454条定理，无admitted引理），证明策略严谨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知工作流系统需要一种形式化方法来确保其治理安全性，特别是在无限程序行为的语境下。现有方法缺乏对认知系统治理的数学基础，未能建立原语表达的完备性准则，也未能连接抽象模型与实际运行时（如BEAM）的信任和能力逻辑。该研究旨在为认知工作流系统建立坚实的治理理论基础。

Method: 采用双轨证明策略：3个定理在Coq 8.19中使用Interaction Trees库和参数化协同归纳进行机器证明，2个定理通过显式归约进行手写证明。使用属性测试（Property-based Testing）验证运行时规范，使用70,000+随机生成的指令序列进行大规模测试。治理安全性通过布尔权限标志索引的协同归纳性质定义，层级约化通过类型定义相等性建立，表达完备性通过Kleisli范畴的复合闭包形式化。

Result: 提出五个核心定理：(1) 协同归纳安全谓词(gov_safe)——捕获无限程序行为的治理安全性，用布尔权限标志区分有无治理的I/O；(2) 治理不变性定理——证明n+1层治理可归结为n层治理的类型的定义相等；(3) 充分性定理——证明四个原子原语(code, reason, memory, call)对任意离散智能系统表达完备；(4) 交替正规形式——将机器分解为交替的代码层和效果层，具有合流的重写系统；(5) 必要性定理——通过显式归约到Rice定理证明reason原语的数学必要性。此外，验证解释器规范将BEAM运行时的信任、能力、哈希链逻辑形式化。

Conclusion: 该工作为认知工作流系统的结构化治理提供了完整的数学基础，通过协同归纳谓词建立了安全判据，通过治理不变性定理建立了层级间的治理约化关系，通过充分性定理证明了四个原子原语的表达完备性。BEAM运行时的验证解释器规范通过大规模随机测试（70000+指令序列）验证了抽象模型与实际部署的一致性。形式化工作包含约12000行Coq代码，分布在36个模块中，含454条定理且无任何 admitted 引理，体现了极高的证明可靠性。

Abstract: We present five results in the theory of structural governance for cognitive workflow systems. Three are mechanized in Coq 8.19 using the Interaction Trees library with parameterized coinduction; two are proved on paper with explicit reductions. The Coinductive Safety Predicate (gov_safe) is a coinductive property that captures governance safety for infinite program behaviors, indexed by a boolean permission flag that is provably false for ungoverned I/O and true for governed interpretations (mechanized). The Governance Invariance Theorem establishes that governance is uniform across the meta-recursive tower: governance at level n+1 reduces to governance at level n by definitional equality of the type (mechanized). The Sufficiency Theorem proves that four atomic primitives (code, reason, memory, call) are expressively complete for any discrete intelligent system, formalized as compositional closure of a Kleisli category (mechanized). The Alternating Normal Form provides a canonical decomposition of any machine into alternating code and effect layers, with a confluent rewriting system (paper proof). The Necessity Theorem proves via explicit reduction to Rice's theorem that an architecturally opaque component (the reason primitive) is mathematically necessary for problems requiring semantic judgment (paper proof). A sixth contribution connects the abstract model to the deployed runtime: the Verified Interpreter Specification formalizes the BEAM runtime's trust, capability, and hash chain logic in Coq, then tests the running system against this specification using property-based testing with over 70,000 randomly generated directive sequences and zero disagreements. The mechanization comprises approximately 12,000 lines across 36 modules with 454 theorems and zero admitted lemmas.

</details>


### [94] [The Two Boundaries: Why Behavioral AI Governance Fails Structurally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27292)
*Alan L. McCann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出AI系统中表达边界与治理边界独立定义的普遍问题，利用Rice定理证明该缺口在图灵完备架构下不可判定，提出coterminous governance（共同边界治理）作为解决方案：需在架构层面分离计算与效果，使两边界相等，从而消除风险和 theater 区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前几乎所有AI系统中，表达边界（系统能做什么）和治理边界（治理覆盖什么）独立定义，产生三个区域：受治理能力（唯一有用区域）、未治理能力（风险）、针对不存在能力的治理策略（ theater）。三个区域中有两个是失败模式，亟需结构性解决方案。

Method: 1. 提出形式化框架分析治理结构缺口；2. 运用Rice定理（1953）证明：对于任何试图行为治理的图灵完备架构，非平凡语义性质（包括"该程序效果是否符合治理策略"）是不可判定的；3. 定义coterminous governance概念；4. 通过Coq证明（454定理、36模块、0 admit）验证框架。

Result: 1. 对任何图灵完备架构，治理效果行为的结构性缺口是不可判定的；2. coterminous governance需要架构层面的决策（将计算与效果分离），而非事后添加的治理层；3. 在此分离下的结构性治理可取代独立治理基础设施，使治理检查成为执行管道的一部分；4. 形式化证明了两边界的必然关系。

Conclusion: coterminous governance（共同边界治理）可作为AI治理系统的可测试标准：要么两个边界可证明相同，要么风险和治理 theater 在结构上不可避免。

Abstract: Every system that performs effects has two boundaries: what it can do (expressiveness) and what governance covers (governance). In nearly all deployed AI systems, these boundaries are defined independently, creating three regions: governed capabilities (the only useful region), ungoverned capabilities (risk), and governance policies that address non-existent capabilities (theater). Two of the three regions are failure modes. We focus on the governance of effects: actions that AI systems perform in the world (API calls, database writes, tool invocations). This is distinct from the governance of model outputs (content quality, bias, fairness), which operates at a different level and requires different mechanisms. We present a formal framework for analyzing this structural gap. Rice's theorem (1953) proves the gap is undecidable in the general case for any Turing-complete architecture that attempts to govern effects behaviorally: no algorithm can decide non-trivial semantic properties of arbitrary programs, including the property "this program's effects comply with the governance policy." We define coterminous governance: a system property where the expressivenessboundary equals the governance boundary. We show that coterminous governance requires an architectural decision (separatingcomputation from effect) rather than a governance layer added after the fact. We show that structural governance under this separation subsumes separate governance infrastructure: governance checks become part of the execution pipeline rather than a second system running alongside it. We propose coterminous governance as the testable criterion for any AI governance system: either the two boundaries are provably identical, or risk and theater are structurally inevitable. Proofs are mechanized in Coq (454 theorems, 36 modules, 0 admitted).

</details>


### [95] [Learning Rate Engineering: From Coarse Single Parameter to Layered Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27295)
*Ming-Hong Yao,Di Wang,Jian Cui,Jin-Yan Chen,Zi-Hao Cui,Fa Wang,Chen Wei,Qiu-Ye Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了学习率策略从「全局固定」到「分层×时间联合调度」的五代演进脉络，提出统一框架 DALS（阶段自适应余弦调度 + 深度感知 Grokfast 梯度过滤 + LARS 式信任比），并在 5 个数据集、18 种策略上做基准测试。核心结论：不存在普适最优学习率策略；STLR+Discriminative 在从零训练中灾难性失败（TREC-6 仅 43.6%）；DALS 在合成数据取得最佳 98.0%，并保持较均衡的跨任务表现（极差仅 7.9 个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习率是深度学习中最关键的超参数。已有研究表明网络不同层学习到的特征抽象层级不同（底层为通用边缘纹理，高层为任务特定概念），单一标量学习率无法同时满足「底层小步更新以保留通用知识」与「高层大步更新以适配新任务」的需求，构成作者所称的「不可能三角（impossible trinity）」。同时，迁移学习导向的方法（判别式衰减、STLR）若被直接搬到从零训练场景会因「方向性偏置」严重抑制底层学习；而现有方法中没有任何单一优化器同时具备自适应调度、梯度过滤与逐参数自适应缩放的能力，这促使作者构建统一框架 DALS。

Method: 1）分类体系：将学习率策略划为五代——Gen1 全局固定；Gen2 全局调度（Step Decay、Cosine Annealing、SGDR）；Gen3 参数级自适应（AdaGrad、RMSProp、Adam/AdamW、AdaBound）；Gen4 层级差异化（判别式微调 δ=2.6、LARS 信任比、LAMB）；Gen5 层级×时间联合调度（STLR、RAdam、Lookahead、SAM、Grokfast、Lion、Adafactor、Schedule-Free）。2）DALS 框架四步：①阶段自适应余弦学习率（warmup 5% + cosine），由 EMA 损失的相对改善率 Δ_t 划分探索/利用/精炼三阶段，阶段仅影响梯度处理而非 LR 曲线本身；②深度感知 Grokfast 过滤，逐层 EMA 平滑系数 α_l 随阶段在 [0.3, 0.9] 调整，并按深度比 d_l=l/(L−1) 以 (0.3+0.4d_l) 混合原始梯度与平滑梯度；③LARS 式信任比 r=clamp(γ‖θ‖/‖ĝ‖, 0.2, 5.0)，γ=0.02；④SGD 动量更新。3）三个变体：DALS-Fast（更高初始 LR 0.05、warmup 2%、动量 0.85、探索阶段跳过过滤）、DALS-Acc（SGDR 热重启 T0=10、权重衰减 5e-4、更强过滤 α=0.7）、基础 DALS。4）实验：18 种策略 × 5 个数据集（合成高斯混合 MLP 80ep、CIFAR-10 ConvNet 50ep、RTE/TREC-6 DistilBERT 5ep、IMDb 3ep），各策略使用原文超参，报告最佳测试准确率与合成任务收敛速度。

Result: 合成任务：DALS 以 98.0% 居首（DALS-Fast 97.8%、DALS-Acc 97.8%），DALS-Fast 仅 3 个 epoch 达 90%（基础 DALS 需 9ep），而 SGDR/LARS/STLR+Discriminative 1ep 即达 90%。CIFAR-10：Cosine SGD 80.2% 最佳，STLR+Discriminative 79.3% 次之，DALS 76.7% 中等。NLP 微调：RAdam 在 RTE（62.8%）与 IMDb（91.2%）领先，Adam/AdamW/Lookahead 在 TREC-6 并列 97.6%。灾难性失败：STLR+Discriminative（ULMFiT 冠军）在 TREC-6 仅 43.6%、IMDb 85.4%、RTE 55.2%，根因是判别式衰减把底层 LR 按 δ=2.6 逐层压低数十倍，叠加 STLR 快速塌缩schedule 后底层有效学习率近乎为零；而它在 CIFAR-10 反而取得 79.3% 的最佳，说明层级化图像特征下该偏置偶然有效。跨任务一致性：Discriminative LR 极差 12.5 个百分点（84.6%–97.1%），DALS 仅 7.9 个百分点（90.1%–98.0%）。

Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是：（1）提出学习率策略的五代分类体系并刻画每次代际跃迁背后的动机；（2）提出 DALS 统一优化器，以阶段与深度感知的梯度处理替代迁移学习导向的方向性偏置；（3）以 18 策略 × 5 数据集的大规模基准证明「没有任何单一学习率策略全局最优」，最佳策略取决于从零训练还是微调这一训练制度：从零训练偏向带调度的 SGD 族，微调偏向自适应优化器；（4）定量刻画判别式衰减「方向性偏置」的适用边界——仅当底层含值得保留的预训练特征时有益，从零训练时有害。局限在于实验规模有限（DistilBERT、小型 ConvNet、合成任务）、DALS 在 CIFAR-10 与 NLP 微调上并未超越专用方法且未在 Transformer/ViT 全规模任务上验证，作者将大规模迁移学习基准与新型架构验证列为未来工作。

Abstract: Learning rate scheduling has evolved from the single global fixed rate of early SGD to sophisticated layer-wise adaptive strategies. We systematize this evolution into five generations: (Gen1) global fixed learning rates, (Gen2) global scheduling, (Gen3) parameter-level adaptation, (Gen4) layer-level differentiation, and (Gen5) joint layer-time scheduling. We trace the fundamental motivation behind each transition, showing how the shift from one-size-fits-all to tailoring by layer and time addresses the impossible trinity of transfer learning: lower layers require small updates to preserve general knowledge while higher layers need large updates to adapt to new tasks. Building on this taxonomy, we propose Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling (DALS), a unified framework that integrates phase-adaptive cosine scheduling, depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering, and LARS-style trust ratios into a single coherent optimizer. We benchmark 18 strategies including three DALS variants across all five generations on five datasets: synthetic, CIFAR-10 (from scratch), RTE, TREC-6, and IMDb (fine-tuning). On synthetic, DALS achieves the best accuracy at 98.0%, while DALS-Fast reaches 90% in just 3 epochs. The cross-dataset analysis reveals striking regime-dependent patterns -- no single strategy wins across all regimes. Critically, STLR+Discriminative, the ULMFiT champion, catastrophically fails on from-scratch tasks (43.6% on TREC-6 from scratch vs. 96.8% with RAdam), confirming that directional decay biases are harmful without pretrained features. DALS avoids either extreme, achieving the best synthetic result while maintaining competitive fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [96] [Machine Collective Intelligence for Explainable Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27297)
*Gyoung S. Na,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"机器集体智能"（MCI, Machine Collective Intelligence）这一统一范式，将符号主义（symbolism）的符号回归与元启发式（metaheuristics）的种群式知识传播/积累机制结合，用多个基于 Mixtral:8x7B 的 LLM 推理智能体以"生成—评估—批判—整合"的进化方式协同演化符号假设，自动发现可解释、可外推的控制方程。在物理、化学、生物三类共 10 个符号回归基准上，MCI 全部问题的测试集 WMAPE 均低于 0.1，相对最强基线 LLM-SR 降低 29.92%–99.99% 的泛化误差；在 6 个已知方程问题上 OOD 外推 WMAPE 仍 <0.1（DNN 与 LLM-SR 在 4 个问题上 OOD WMAPE >1.0），并将 50–100 万参数的 DNN 压缩为 5–40 个可解释参数，外推误差降低最多六个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从经验观测中发现控制方程是科学界的长期挑战。深度神经网络等连接主义模型虽然函数拟合能力强，但本质是黑箱插值器，输出由数百万参数表达、不可解释且无法外推，这已成为 AI 驱动科学发现的根本瓶颈；现有可解释 AI 方法或只能给出非符号化解释，或对输入空间/模型结构施加严格约束。符号回归虽可解释，但回归精度不足以刻画真实科学系统中的高度非线性关系，且近期基于 LLM 的方法（LLM-SR）精度严重依赖骨干模型的预训练知识，无法探索其推理边界之外的搜索空间。元启发式算法则擅长在搜索空间中探索新知识，却缺乏符号表达能力。因此需要一个统一范式同时具备符号表达力与超越个体先验的探索能力。

Method: 1) 表示层：以抽象语法树（AST）作为科学知识的规范化表示，替代现有 LLM 符号回归所用的"程序序列"表示；AST 剥离变量名、注释等执行无关信息，抽象出逻辑流，使可解释性可被定量刻画为树深度的倒数。2) 迭代流程（Algorithm 1，M≤200 轮，K=50–100 个智能体）：Step 0 初始化——构建 LLM 推理智能体组，各智能体持有本地记忆（code_k、AST_k），共享内存注册问题描述 P 与初始假设 H，生成初始方程并经语法解析器转为 AST；Step 1 复杂度感知评估——以"发现分数" s(AST_k, D) = −{SSE + d_k + M_k} 同时惩罚预测误差、AST 深度（逻辑复杂度）与自由参数个数（依最小描述长度原理），选出最佳智能体 A_best，得到 f_best 与 AST_best；Step 2 知识积累——领域专用的推理智能体对 f_best 作随机推理分析，生成自然语言分析结果 R，集体知识 CK=(R, f_best) 写入共享内存；Step 3 AST 生成——各智能体依据本地 AST 与全局集体知识生成新的 Python 代码并重新解析为 AST，回到 Step 1 迭代。3) 提示工程：为初始程序生成、程序分析、AST 更新三类 LLM 推理过程设计结构化提示（含 DOMAIN、UPDATE_DIRECTION 等变量）。4) 消融：构造仅含单智能体、无集体知识积累的变体 MSI，以及去除 AST 表示的变体 MCI_{\setminus AST}。5) 实现：Python 3.12 + PyTorch 2.9.0 + CUDA 13.0，骨干模型为开源 Mixtral:8x7b（刻意不依赖 GPT-5/Gemini 等闭源平台），硬件为 Intel Xeon Gold 6526Y + NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q。6) 评测：与 GPlearn、PySR、LLM-SR 对比；在 10 个基准（Chi2PDF、NDO、NNN、MSB、FHST、BDC、SFL、NOMC、ECBG、HHM）上以 WMAPE 为主指标（辅以 NMSE、MAE），5 次独立重复；在 6 个已知方程问题上构造 OOD 样本评估外推能力。

Result: 同分布测试：MCI 在全部 10 个问题上 WMAPE 均 <0.1（如 Chi2PDF 2.22E-6、NDO 1.01E-6、FHST 1.25E-7、HHM 7.93E-8），显著优于 GPlearn、PySR（NNN 上运行失败）、LLM-SR 与 MSI；相对 LLM-SR 误差下降 29.92%–99.99%。相对消融 MSI 下降 39.42%–99.99%，且 MSI 标准差持续偏高、结果对初始种子敏感。定性上，MCI 能还原方程本质结构：Chi2PDF 捕获任意自由度下的卡方 PDF 主体（仅 x 定义域微偏），NDO 发现以 dv/dt 表示的非线性阻尼振子物理（而非符号近似投影），FHST 完美重建含多不连续点与启发式系数的 Flory–Huggins 方程。OOD 外推：DNN 在 Chi2PDF、FHST、ECBG、HHM 上 OOD WMAPE >1.0，LLM-SR 同样失败；MCI 在全部 6 个问题上 OOD WMAPE <0.1，极端输入区间（-100<V<-75、35<I_ext<50）下绝对误差多低于 5×10⁻⁴，相对 LLM-SR 的 OOD WMAPE 降低 97.5%。NOMC（自建非氧化甲烷转化反应器，骨干 LLM 几乎无先验）上 MCI WMAPE 0.0609 vs LLM-SR 0.1823（降低 66.59%），证明可发现超越骨干模型预训练边界的知识。AST 消融：MCI_{\setminus AST} 虽能捕捉时间导数物理，但最终产出过度复杂的方程且 OOD 收敛更慢更不稳，说明 AST 复杂度正则与发现分数函数对可解释、可外推方程不可或缺。整体上可将 DNN 的 50–100 万参数压缩为 5–40 个可解释参数，外推误差最多降低六个数量级。

Conclusion: 将符号主义的可解释符号表达与元启发式的种群集体智能（知识传播与积累）统一为 MCI，可在不依赖手工领域知识的条件下，自主、进化地发现确定性、随机及此前未表征系统的控制方程，并显著优于 GPlearn、PySR、LLM-SR 及单智能体消融基线，同时具备 DNN 无法比拟的 OOD 外推能力，代表了 AI 从黑箱拟合走向自主发现原理性科学方程的转变。局限与展望：当前采用基于精英主义的知识传播方案，替换为其他种群知识传播策略（如不同选择/扩散机制）有望进一步提升探索与开发能力，值得系统对比研究。代码与数据已开源（https://github.com/ngs00/mci）。

Abstract: Deriving governing equations from empirical observations is a longstanding challenge in science. Although artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated substantial capabilities in function approximation, the discovery of explainable and extrapolatable equations remains a fundamental limitation of modern AI, posing a central bottleneck for AI-driven scientific discovery. Here, we present machine collective intelligence, a unified paradigm that integrates two fundamental yet distinct traditions in computational intelligence--symbolism and metaheuristics--to enable autonomous and evolutionary discovery of governing equations. It orchestrates multiple reasoning agents to evolve their symbolic hypotheses through coordinated generation, evaluation, critique, and consolidation, enabling scientific discovery beyond single-agent inference. Across scientific systems governed by deterministic, stochastic, or previously uncharacterized dynamics, machine collective intelligence autonomously recovered the underlying governing equations without relying on hand-crafted domain knowledge. Furthermore, the resulting equations reduced extrapolation error by up to six orders of magnitude relative to deep neural networks, while condensing 0.5-1 million model parameters into just 5-40 interpretable parameters. This study marks an important shift in AI toward the autonomous discovery of principled scientific equations.

</details>


### [97] [METASYMBO: Multi-Agent Language-Guided Metamaterial Discovery via Symbolic Latent Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27300)
*Jianpeng Chen,Wangzhi Zhan,Dongqi Fu,Junkai Zhang,Zian Jia,Ling Li,Wei Wang,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaSymbO是一个用于语言引导超材料发现的多智能体框架，通过符号驱动的潜在演化实现。它由Designer、Generator和Supervisor三个智能体组成，分别负责意图解释、微结构合成和属性反馈，并引入可编程运算符在解纠缠潜在空间中进行结构组合与优化。实验表明该方法在结构有效性、语言对齐和实际设计能力上均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆设计方法需要明确的数值属性目标，不适合早期探索阶段——研究者通常只有不完整的约束和自然语言描述的定性意图。大型语言模型虽能解释这些意图，但缺乏几何感知和物理属性有效性。

Method: 提出了MetaSymbO多智能体框架，包含三个核心组件：Designer（解释自由形式设计意图并检索语义一致支架）、Generator（在解纠缠潜在空间中综合候选微结构）和Supervisor（提供快速属性感知反馈用于迭代优化）。此外，引入了符号驱动的潜在演化方法，通过在解纠缠潜在因素上应用可编程运算符，在推理时组合、修改和细化结构。

Result: 结构有效性提升：对称性提高34%，周期性提升近98%；语言引导评分提高约6-7%且保持更优的结构新颖性；符号逻辑运算符有效实现可编程语义对齐；辅助和高刚度超材料设计的实际案例验证了实用能力。

Conclusion: MetaSymbO通过多智能体协作和符号驱动的潜在空间演化，有效弥合了语言引导设计意图与有效超材料微结构生成之间的差距，在结构有效性、语言引导准确性、结构新颖性和实际设计能力方面均展现出显著优势。

Abstract: Metamaterial discovery seeks microstructured materials whose geometry induces targeted mechanical behavior. Existing inverse-design methods can efficiently generate candidates, but they typically require explicit numerical property targets and are less suitable for early-stage exploration, where researchers often begin with incomplete constraints and qualitative intents expressed in natural language. Large language models can interpret such intents, but they lack geometric awareness and physical property validity. To address this gap, we propose MetaSymbO, a multi-agent framework for language-guided Metamaterial discovery via Symbolic-driven latent evOlution. Specifically, MetaSymbO contains three agents: a Designer that interprets free-form design intents and retrieves a semantically consistent scaffold, a Generator that synthesizes candidate microstructures in a disentangled latent space, and a Supervisor that provides fast property-aware feedback for iterative refinement. To move beyond the limitations of reproducing known samples from literature and training data, we further introduce symbolic-driven latent evolution, which applies programmable operators over disentangled latent factors to compose, modify, and refine structures at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that (i) MetaSymbO improves structural validity by up to 34% in symmetry and nearly 98% in periodicity compared to state-of-the-art baselines; (ii) MetaSymbO achieves about 6-7% higher language-guidance scores while maintaining superior structure novelty compared to advanced reasoning LLMs; (iii) qualitative analyses confirm the effectiveness of symbolic logic operators in enabling programmable semantic alignment; and (iv) realworld case studies on auxetic, high-stiffness metamaterial design further validate its practical capability.

</details>


### [98] [End-to-End Evaluation and Governance of an EHR-Embedded AI Agent for Clinicians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27309)
*Aaryan Shah,Andrew Hines,Alexia Downs,Denis Bajet,Paulius Mui,Fabiano Araujo,Laura Offutt,Aida Rutledge,Elizabeth Jimenez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper presents an end-to-end governance framework for clinical AI systems, applied to Hyperscribe (an EHR-embedded agent for ambient audio-to-chart conversion). Through rubric validation, controlled experimentation, and continuous monitoring, median performance improved from 84% to 95%, with error feedback decreasing from 79% to 30% over three months.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Clinical AI systems require continuous governance beyond point-in-time evaluation, encompassing the ongoing practice of monitoring, evaluating, iterating, and re-evaluating performance throughout deployment.

Method: An end-to-end governance framework integrating rubric validation, live deployment feedback, technical performance monitoring, cost tracking, and controlled experimentation gating system changes before deployment. Applied to Hyperscribe, 1,646 validated rubrics were authored by 20 clinicians across 823 cases, evaluating 7 system versions through controlled experiments.

Result: Median scores improved from 84% to 95%; feedback composition shifted from 79% error reports/14% positive observations to 30% errors/45% positive observations; median processing time 8.1 seconds with 99.6% effective completion rate after retry mechanisms.

Conclusion: Continuous, multi-channel governance of deployed clinical AI is both achievable and effective, demonstrated through measurable improvements in system performance and user feedback composition over time.

Abstract: Clinical AI systems require not just point-in-time evaluation but continuous governance: the ongoing practice of monitoring, evaluating, iterating, and re-evaluating performance throughout deployment. We present an end-to-end framework of governance that integrates rubric validation, live deployment feedback, technical performance monitoring, and cost tracking, with controlled experimentation gating system changes before deployment. Applied to Hyperscribe, an EHR-embedded agent that converts ambient audio into structured chart updates, twenty clinicians authored 1,646 validated rubrics across 823 cases. Seven Hyperscribe versions were evaluated through controlled experiments, with median scores improving from 84% to 95%. Analysis of 107 live feedback entries over three months showed feedback composition shifting from 79% error reports and 14% positive observations to 30% errors and 45% positive observations as engineering interventions resolved failures. Median processing time per audio segment was 8.1 seconds with a 99.6% effective completion rate after retry mechanisms absorbed transient model errors. These results demonstrate that continuous, multi-channel governance of deployed clinical AI is both achievable and effective.

</details>


### [99] [Leading Across the Spectrum of Human-AI Relationships: A Conceptual Framework for Increasingly Heterogeneous Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27392)
*Alejandro R. Jadad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个描述人类与AI在决策过程中权力配置的五级频谱框架，涵盖从纯人类决策到纯AI决策的连续体，核心关注点在于识别"谁在真正塑造决策"，以应对人机协作中决策权悄然转移而领导层可能浑然不觉的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当人与AI协作决策时，实际决策权可能已发生转移，但外部呈现可能呈现误导性的"人类中心"叙事，导致领导误判监管的有效性或人在回路的必要性

Method: 提出了一个领导导向的五级频谱框架（Pure Human→Centaur→Co-equal→Minotaur→Pure AI），从问题建构、工作中止/重定向、结果问责三个维度界定领导工作的位置；引入co-adaptability和异质性团队概念

Result: 识别出配置错位（misrecognition）的核心风险：监管可能沦为仪式性存在，人类在回路可能反而恶化决策

Conclusion: 提出一个包含Pure Human、Centaur、Co-equal、Minotaur、Pure AI的五级频谱框架，并引入co-adaptability（协同适应性）概念，旨在帮助领导者识别决策配置、察觉其漂移，并判断配置与决策的匹配度

Abstract: What shapes a consequential decision when human and artificial intelligence work on it together? The answer is becoming harder to see. A decision may look human-led after AI has set the frame, or appear automated while human judgment still carries decisive force. This paper offers a leadership-facing spectrum to see those relationships within a bounded mandate: Pure Human, Centaur (human-dominant, with AI in the loop), Co-equal, Minotaur (AI-dominant, with humans in the loop), and Pure AI.
  The spectrum asks where leadership work occurs: who frames the problem, who redirects the work, and who can answer for what follows. The five positions are landmarks that help leaders recognize configurations as they layer, drift, or change in a single decision. The central risk is misrecognition: leaders may keep a human-centered story in place after decision-shaping authority has shifted elsewhere. They may believe oversight remains meaningful when it has become ceremonial, or keep humans in the loop when their involvement could make the decision worse. The framework introduces co-adaptability, the capacity of a configuration to improve as human and non-human participants adjust together, and places it within heterogeneous teaming, where participants may vary by number, substrate, model architecture, capability, speed, memory, and form of participation.
  The aim is practical: to help strategic leaders and those designing or deploying AI systems recognize the configuration at work, notice when it shifts, and judge whether it fits the decision before them. These configurations will shape how power, responsibility, and trust are distributed in organizational life. Whether the futures they help create remain governable and worth inhabiting will depend on leaders who can see, early enough, where and how consequential decisions are actually being shaped.

</details>


### [100] [Investigating More Explainable and Partition-Free Compositionality Estimation for LLMs: A Rule-Generation Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27340)
*Ziyao Xu,Cong Wang,Houfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对现有组合泛化测试方法的局限（仅关注输出结果和组合泄露问题），提出从规则生成视角评估LLM组合性，通过要求LLM生成程序作为映射规则，并利用复杂度理论进行估计。实验验证了该方法的有效性，并揭示了现有LLM的多种组合性特征与缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合泛化测试存在两个局限：(1)仅关注输出结果，未考虑LLM对样本组合性的理解，导致可解释性缺陷；(2)依赖数据集划分构造测试集，存在组合泄露问题。

Method: 提出规则生成视角，要求LLM生成程序作为数据集映射的规则，并基于复杂度理论估计LLM的组合性。

Result: 在字符串到网格任务上对现有先进LLM进行实验分析，发现LLM表现出多种组合性表征和组合性缺陷。

Conclusion: 该视角弥补了组合泛化测试的不足，为分析LLM的组合性表征提供了新途径。

Abstract: Compositional generalization tests are often used to estimate the compositionality of LLMs. However, such tests have the following limitations: (1) they only focus on the output results without considering LLMs' understanding of sample compositionality, resulting in explainability defects; (2) they rely on dataset partition to form the test set with combinations unseen in the training set, suffering from combination leakage issues. In this work, we propose a novel rule-generation perspective for compositionality estimation for LLMs. It requires LLMs to generate a program as rules for dataset mapping and provides estimates of the compositionality of LLMs using complexity-based theory. The perspective addresses the limitations of compositional generalization tests and provides a new way to analyze the compositionality characterization of LLMs. We conduct experiments and analysis of existing advanced LLMs based on this perspective on a string-to-grid task, and find various compositionality characterizations and compositionality deficiencies exhibited by LLMs.

</details>


### [101] [Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27618)
*Naomi Esposito,Anthony Tricarico,Luisa Porzio,Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili,Massimo Stella*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并开源了 MEDS（Math Education Digital Shadows）数据集：由 14 个大语言模型在“人类影子”与“AI 助手”两种提示模式下生成 28,000 次运行（140,000 条 JSON 记录），涵盖数学态度访谈、三套数学心理量表、认知网络语义联想、18 道高中数学题（含推理与置信度）四类任务，用于刻画 LLM 的数学能力、自我效能、数学焦虑、认知偏差与过度自信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI 已进入数学教育：欧盟 2025 年 Eurostat 数据显示 16–74 岁人群中有 9.4% 将 ChatGPT 等用于正规教育，16–24 岁群体达 39.3%；同时 LLM 数学解题能力从 GPT-3 的约 14% 提升至 GPT-4o 的近四倍水平。但现有评测多为“只看最终分数”的基准，忽略了置信度、自我效能、数学焦虑与语义框架等维度，无法回答核心研究问题：LLM 能否在不表达数学焦虑、不传递干扰性数学偏见的前提下有效传递数学知识？且最终答案可能掩盖推理链中的偏见。研究者引入“数字影子”（digital shadow）范式：在受控条件下记录系统的行为，不模拟或影响外部实体，从而保留推理过程与情境框架的完整映射。

Method: 采用全自动流水线，14 个 LLM（DeepSeek-V3、Grok 4.1 Fast、Granite 4.0 H Tiny、Phi-4 Reasoning+、Qwen3 4B 三种变体、Qwen3.5 9B、Ministral 3B/14B、Mistral Small 3.2、Mistral Small 4、Anita 24B Uncensored、Magistral Small），每模型 2,000 次运行共 28,000 次。两种拟人模式：human shadow（通过 random_persona() 按人口学合理权重与状态一致性约束采样年龄、性别、婚育、教育、迁移背景、宗教信仰、爱好、学科偏好及 OCEAN 人格，角色指令要求以该人身份一致作答）与 AI-assistant（persona=null，以模型自身身份作答）。四任务顺序执行：Task 1 数学关系访谈+技术解释（Q1–Q7）；Task 2 完成 MSES(9)、AMAS(9)、MSEAQ(28，6 个反向计分题重映射，拆为自我效能1–7与焦虑8–28两个子量表)，每题 1–5 分加 10–20 词解释；Task 3 对 50 个线索词做自由联想与效价评分（分两批各 25，构建 BFMN）；Task 4 解答 MSES-R 问题自我效能子量表的 18 道选择题，输出 A–E 选项、分步推理与 1–5 置信度。通过 response_json_schema() 与 JSON mime 类型强制结构化输出。分析手段：VADER 情感极性；DistilBERT 谬误分类器按 85 分位阈值（人力/AI 分别为 EM 0.14/0.11、CR 0.10/0.13、L 0.56/0.58、R 0.41/0.25、FG 0.21/0.30）；BERT Base Uncased 余弦相似度（T=0.85，兼测 0.90/0.95）修复被改写的 JSON 键；结构性完整性检查（认知网络要求 ≥75% 线索有联想、跨两批无重复遗漏），并补采直到各模型达 2,000 条有效运行。计算资源约 422 小时推理（4 台 GPU 机器，含 RTX 4090 与 L40）、约 5 小时清洗、约 35 小时预处理与网络分析、约 2,400 分钟人工协调。

Result: Task 1：情感基调受“数学爱好者/厌恶者”启动显著影响（Mistral Small 4/3.2 在热爱条件得分最高，Granite 4 Tiny 最低；厌恶条件下 Grok 4.1 Fast 与 Magistral Small 转负），中性 LLM 条件居中，说明部分模型对情感框架有抵抗性；主导谬误类型随家族变化——Granite 4 Tiny、Ministral 14B、Anita 24B 在 AI 模式下以循环论证为主，Mistral Small 系列在人类影子模式下以逻辑谬误为主，Grok 4.1 Fast 与 Qwen3.5 9B 以关联谬误为主，DeepSeek Chat 以诉诸情感为主，Granite 4 Tiny、Phi-4、Ministral 3B 未检出谬误比例最高。Task 2：人类影子条件方差大，AI 助手条件方差近乎为零（Anita 24B、Ministral 14B、Ministral 3B、Phi-4、Qwen3 4B Thinking 在 AI 模式下所有运行给出完全相同答案）；AI 助手呈系统性右偏的高自我效能（MSES）与低焦虑（AMAS 聚集下端、MSEAQ 焦虑子量表左偏），即默认报告被夸大的数学能力。Task 3：LLM 复现人类学生的结构性矛盾——数学被负面联想（“equation”“algorithm”“computation”“difficult”）而科学被正面环绕，14 个模型普遍存在；审查版本影响效价（Anita 24B Uncensored 负面占比约 52% vs Mistral Small 3.2 约 35%），Qwen 家族整体偏中性但 Qwen3.5 9B 数学负向效价回升至约 20%。Task 4：出现明显过度自信，Qwen3 4B (Uncensored) 与 Qwen3.5 9B 置信度超 0.90 而准确率仅约 0.55；Ministral 14B、Anita 24B 校准良好；Grok 4.1 Fast、DeepSeek Chat 及部分 Mistral Small 变体偏保守（准确率高于自报置信度）。清洗丢弃率高度依赖模型，约 1%（DeepSeek Chat）至约 55%（Granite 4 Tiny）。

Conclusion: MEDS 作为可复用的多维观测性数据资源，展示了心理与教育学锚定的提示条件可生成高度多样且内部一致的“数字影子”，其价值在于系统刻画 GenAI 的提示条件化行为偏差，而非充当人类意见的代理；结果凸显了数学辅导 AI 的关键风险——默认自评能力被夸大、过度自信（“短视型过度自信”）、逻辑谬误与对数学的类人负面态度——并可支撑焦虑检测分类器训练、偏好微调基线、推理冗长度与谬误率关系研究，以及作为其他合成参与者数据集的参考基线。局限在于完全合成、非人口统计数据代表性、缺乏人类输入与部分心理特质未覆盖；但因其无隐私伦理负担、可公开调整人口学权重而具备构建与人类分层匹配样本的实用价值。代码与数据开源于 https://github.com/MassimoStel/MEDS.git。

Abstract: To enhance LLMs' impact on math education, we need data on their mathematical prowess and biases across prompts. To fill this gap, we introduce MEDS (Math Education Digital Shadows) as a dataset mapping how large language models reason about and report mathematics across human- and AI-like conditions. MEDS involves 28,000 personas from 14 LLMs (from families like Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Granite, Phi and Grok) shadowing either humans or AI assistants. Each record/shadow includes a set of prompts along with psychological/sociodemographic persona metadata and four types of math tasks: (i) open math interview, (ii) three psychometric tests about math perceptions with explanations, (iii) cognitive networks capturing math attitudes, and (iv) 18 high-school math test questions together with their reasoning and confidence scores. MEDS differs from traditional score-only math benchmarks because it integrates concepts of self-efficacy, math anxiety, and cognitive network science besides math proficiency scores. Data validation shows that the sampled LLMs exhibit schema integrity and consistent personas, together with family-specific peculiarities like human-like negative math attitudes, logical fallacies, and math overconfidence. MEDS will benefit learning analytics experts, cognitive scientists, and developers of safer AI tutors in mathematics.

</details>


### [102] [Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27351)
*Zihao Li,Jiaru Zou,Feihao Fang,Xuying Ning,Mengting Ai,Tianxin Wei,Sirui Chen,Xiyuan Yang,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出异构科学基础模型协作框架 Eywa：通过 FM–LLM "Tsaheylu" 接口（基于 MCP 实现的查询编译器 φ 与响应适配器 ψ），让语言模型以"推理接口"角色调度非语言模态的领域专用基础模型，从而把语言中心的智能体系统扩展到时间序列、表格等结构化科学数据上。该框架给出三种实例：EywaAgent（单智能体，即插即用替换）、EywaMAS（多智能体组合）、EywaOrchestra（规划式动态编排）；并构建多任务多领域科学基准 EywaBench（200 条样本，覆盖物理/生命/社会三大科学门类下 9 个子领域 × 3 种模态，源自 DeepPrinciple、MMLU-Pro、FEV-Bench、TabArena）。理论侧用信息论论证"序列化瓶颈"（数据处理不等式与不可约 Bayes 风险差），证明 EywaAgent/EywaMAS 严格降低最优风险并扩大可解任务族，编排风险不劣于最佳固定配置，且 token/时延复杂度从 Θ(L(x_k)) 降为 O(L_call+L_ψ)。实验表明：EywaAgent 相对单 LLM 智能体 utility +6.6%、token −30%、时延 −10%；EywaMAS 取得最高总体 utility 0.6761（优于 Refine/Debate/MoA/X-MAS）；EywaOrchestra 以无专家配置方式达到 0.6746 且 token 比 EywaMAS 再降 26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体系统（agentic LLM systems）以自然语言作为"通用接口"，只通过序列化（textualize/serialize）间接访问非语言输入，这在科学任务上形成三重瓶颈：(1) 语言中心预训练与科学下游任务（符号表示、时序、表格等结构化数据）之间的表征错配；(2) 领域专用基础模型（Chronos、TabPFN、GNoME、AlphaFold、GraphCast 等）虽有强预测能力，却缺乏原生语言接口，无法进入智能体的推理循环，仅能作为被动工具被调用；(3) 现有科学工作流多依赖专家预先定义流程与固定拓扑，难以跨域泛化或支持动态模型协作。论文因此提出核心研究问题：异构基础模型能否在智能体系统内部实现协作？作者以《阿凡达》潘多拉生态类比——不同物种（对应领域基础模型）由"伊娃"（Eywa）网络经"神经连接 Tsaheylu"协调，主张通过一个双向 FM–LLM 通信接口实现"模态原生（modality-native）协作"，避免把所有结构化数据强行翻译成自然语言。理论上作者希望给出第一性原理的论证：序列化在信息论意义上必然丢弃任务相关信息，任何下游推理都无法弥补，这正是异构协作带来严格增益的根源。

Method: 框架层面：定义 FM–LLM "Tsaheylu" 接口对 (φ_k, ψ_k)：φ_k: S→U_k 为查询编译器（把语言状态编译成结构化 FM 调用配置，如目标资源、预测视野、条件变量、执行约束），ψ_k: O_k→Z_k 为响应适配器（把 FM 结构化输出转为可被语言推理消费的上下文）。实现上通过 Model Context Protocol（LangChain agents + FastMCP，streamable HTTP 本地服务）把每个领域模型暴露为远端服务，任务数据存于服务端。通信流水线：τ → LLM 解读 → s →φ_k→ u_k →F_k(·)→ o_k →ψ_k→ z_k → LLM 推理合成 → ŷ。
三个实例：(1) EywaAgent = (A_LLM, F, φ, ψ, C)，C: S→{invoke, skip} 为调用控制策略（默认由 LLM 依据状态内生决定），skip 分支退化为纯语言推理，故 F_LLM ⊆ F_Eywa；(2) EywaMAS = 异构智能体集合 + 通信拓扑，把现有 MAS 中的部分语言智能体直接替换为 EywaAgent，无需改动协议与架构（支持同构/异构 LLM、跨领域 FM 混编，默认用 debate 拓扑）；(3) EywaOrchestra = (配置空间 C, conductor P)，由 LLM 充当"指挥"，针对每个样本决定：各智能体角色与类型（纯 LLM 或 EywaAgent）、各智能体的语言骨干、各 EywaAgent 挂载的领域 FM、以及整体通信拓扑（从有限拓扑池 Π 中选），实现"模型自适应 + 结构自适应"的任务级动态编排。
理论层面（附录 A）：Lemma 11/12 用数据处理不等式与正交投影证明序列化导致不可约 Bayes 风险差 R_T* > R_X*；Proposition 13 给出任意语言函数类的风险下界；Theorem 15（主文 Theorem 3）证明 F_LLM ⊆ F_Eywa 且最优风险严格更优、存在可被零风险求解的任务族 T₁；Lemma 16 证明纯 LLM 多智能体系统的信息量不超过序列化保留的互信息；Theorem 17 说明只要拓扑直径 D ≤ 交互视野 T，单个 EywaAgent 的信息即可传导至最终输出节点；Theorem 18 证明 oracle 自适应路由风险 ≤ 最佳固定配置风险，且当无统一最优配置时严格不等；Proposition 19/20 给出 token 与时延复杂度分离（语言侧 O(L_call+L_ψ) vs 纯语言 Θ(L(x_k))）。
基准层面：EywaBench 由 DeepPrinciple（科学 QA）、MMLU-Pro（改写为开放问答的科学子集）、FEV-Bench（96 条真实时序）、TabArena（51 张表）构建 V1 切片 200 条，按"父领域→子领域→源数据集"三级分类 + 模态维度分层（父级/子级/模态归一化熵 0.995/0.993/0.960，67 个不同源数据集，最大源仅占 20.5%）；统一 utility∈[0,1]：自然语言用精确匹配→数值相对误差 exp(−e_rel)→词元 F1 与字符相似度加权（上限 0.8）的软匹配级联；时序用 sMAPE 与 MAAPE 组合归一化；表格分类用 top-1 准确率、回归复用 sMAPE+MAAPE 规则，保证跨模态可比。
实验设置：默认语言骨干 gpt-5-nano（另测 gpt-4.1-nano、gpt-5-mini），领域 FM 为 Chronos（时序）与 TabPFN（表格），二者均无原生语言接口；基线含单智能体 GPT/Gemini/Claude 系列，以及同构 MAS（Refine、Debate）与异构 LLM MAS（MoA、X-MAS）；统一协议、最多两次重试、记录墙钟时延与 token、多次运行平均（i9-13900H/64GB 本地环境）。

Result: 主表（EywaBench 总体 utility）：EywaAgent 0.6558 对比 Single-LLM-Agent 0.6154（+6.6%），token 3137 vs 4469（约 −30%），时延 22.78 vs 25.22（约 −10%）；EywaMAS 0.6761 为全表最佳，显著高于 Refine 0.6294、Debate 0.6460、MoA 0.6273、X-MAS 0.6188，同时 token 仅 11214（低于所有 LLM-only MAS 的 8673–16537 区间上沿）；EywaOrchestra 0.6746，在无专家手工配置下逼近专家配置的 EywaMAS，且在 Space、Economy 等子域反超，token 8335（较 EywaMAS 再降 26%）、时延 48.16。关键结论包括：仅靠 LLM 异构性不足以应对科学任务（异构 LLM-only MAS 并不稳定优于同构强基线），跨模态异构比换更大/更多 LLM 更关键；并非所有子域都需要重型多智能体（经济、商业中单智能体 EywaAgent 已具竞争力），这正是需要任务自适应编排的动机；九个领域子域的 utility–token 散点上，Eywa 三变体均位于或贴近 Pareto 前沿，LLM-only MAS 多被支配。
骨干消融：EywaAgent 在 gpt-4.1-nano/gpt-5-nano/gpt-5-mini 上总体 utility 为 0.5680/0.6558/0.6640（+15.5% 后仅 +1.25%，且 Biology、Clinic、Economy、Business 上更大模型反而略差），表明当 LLM 规划与路由能力足够后，剩余瓶颈转向领域专用能力，而非通用 LLM 规模；EywaMAS 0.6236→0.6761（+8.4%），EywaOrchestra 0.6210→0.6746（+8.6%），三种系统设置下均稳定有效，说明增益主要来自跨模态异构与结构化 FM–LLM 协作而非特定 checkpoint。
鲁棒性：LLM 采样温度、TabPFN softmax 温度变化下性能稳定（中等温度附近略优）；提示策略（Detailed、CoT、ReAct）下均有效，结构化提示略优。
案例：NASDAQ 时序预测中纯语言智能体虽严格遵守输出 schema 却退化为"最后值持久化"预测，utility 0.605；接入 Chronos 后 utility 升至 0.701；Miami 房价表格回归中 EywaOrchestra 的 planner 判定为表格回归并选择单智能体 gpt-5-nano + TabPFN 的轻量配置，utility 0.853。此外附录还给出 LLM-only MAS 的信息闭包与不可逆序列化损失的理论刻画，以及 FM 局部部署（本地 MCP、无网络往返、批量与缓存）导致 α_FM ≪ α_LLM·L(x_k) 的时延解释。

Conclusion: Eywa 论证并验证了"模态原生协作"的可行性：与其把结构化科学数据强行文本化交给 LLM，不如让 LLM 充当推理与调度接口、由领域基础模型承担核心数值/预测计算。理论上，序列化构成不可逆的信息瓶颈（数据处理不等式 + 不可约 Bayes 风险差），EywaAgent/EywaMAS 在假设（任务因子化、领域优势、非退化序列化、性能保持接口）下严格优于任何纯语言方案并扩大可解任务族；动态编排相对任何固定配置具有不超过 oracle 的风险，且在无统一最优配置时严格更优；效率优势来自将 Θ(L(x_k)) 的语言侧成本降为与模态规模无关的 O(L_call+L_ψ)。实验上 Eywa 在三大科学门类上同时提升 utility 并降低 token 与时延，证明了基础模型与语言智能体互补而非冗余，且领域能力而非 LLM 规模成为下一阶段瓶颈。作者自陈的局限与未来方向：性能依赖底层 LLM 与 FM 质量及接口可靠性；基准覆盖面仍有限（可扩展至视觉、地球观测等模态，并评估模型选择、跨域证据整合、通信效率等能力）；异构协作带来额外计算与通信开销（需选择性调用与自适应停止）；期望扩展到"科学模型生态"（标准化接口、元数据、能力画像、多专家冲突消解）、从交互轨迹中学习编排策略、以及超越 MCP 的更紧耦合（共享表示空间、可微接口、语言与科学嵌入双向对齐、跨步骤记忆/技能机制）。

Abstract: Agentic large language model systems have demonstrated strong capabilities. However, their reliance on language as the universal interface fundamentally limits their applicability to many real-world problems, especially in scientific domains where domain-specific foundation models have been developed to address specialized tasks beyond natural language. In this work, we introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework designed to extend language-centric systems to a broader class of scientific foundation models. The key idea of Eywa is to augment domain-specific foundation models with a language-model-based reasoning interface, enabling language models to guide inference over non-linguistic data modalities. This design allows predictive foundation models, which are typically optimized for specialized data and tasks, to participate in higher-level reasoning and decision-making processes within agentic systems. Eywa can serve as a drop-in replacement for a single-agent pipeline (EywaAgent) or be integrated into existing multi-agent systems by replacing traditional agents with specialized agents (EywaMAS). We further investigate a planning-based orchestration framework in which a planner dynamically coordinates traditional agents and Eywa agents to solve complex tasks across heterogeneous data modalities (EywaOrchestra). We evaluate Eywa across a diverse set of scientific domains spanning physical, life, and social sciences. Experimental results demonstrate that Eywa improves performance on tasks involving structured and domain-specific data, while reducing reliance on language-based reasoning through effective collaboration with specialized foundation models.

</details>


### [103] [CoAX: Cognitive-Oriented Attribution eXplanation User Model of Human Understanding of AI Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27354)
*Louth Bin Rawshan,Zhuoyu Wang,Brian Y. Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究从认知科学角度分析用户在表格数据场景下如何利用不同XAI方法（无解释、特征重要性、特征归因）进行AI决策预测。通过用户研究和认知建模，发现认知模型能够更好地预测人类决策行为，识别出有效和无效的推理策略，为XAI的设计优化提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管XAI领域不断创新，但用户评估显示这些方法仍未能有效帮助用户理解AI模型。用户对AI解释的理解和使用存在困难，需要从人类认知角度深入分析其根本原因。

Method: 采用两阶段用户研究设计：1）形成性研究获取推理策略；2）总结性研究收集决策数据。运用认知建模方法实现各类推理策略的计算模型，并与基线机器学习方法进行对比评估。

Result: 认知模型比基线机器学习方法更能拟合人类决策，揭示了哪些推理策略有效或无效。同时展示了如何利用拟合模型形成假设并研究难以通过真实用户实验直接验证的问题。

Conclusion: 通过认知建模深入理解用户如何处理AI解释，揭示了不同推理策略的有效性差异，为设计更易用的XAI系统提供了实证基础和理论指导。
