Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) aims to improve user understanding and decisions when using AI models. However, despite innovations in XAI, recent user evaluations reveal that this goal remains elusive. Understanding human cognition can help explain why users struggle to effectively use AI explanations. Focusing on reasoning on structured (tabular) data, we examined various reasoning strategies for different XAI methods (none, feature importance, feature attribution) in the decision task of anticipating AI decisions (i.e., forward simulation). We i) elicited reasoning strategies from a formative user study, and ii) collected decisions from a summative user study. Using cognitive modeling, we implemented the processes underlying each reasoning strategy and evaluated their alignment with human decision-making. We found that our models better fit human decisions than baseline machine learning proxies, providing insights into which reasoning strategies are (in)effective. We then demonstrate how the fitted model can be used to form hypotheses and investigate research questions that are costly to study with real human participants. This work contributes to debugging human understanding of XAI, informing the future development of more usable and interpretable AI explanations.

</details>


### [104] [The TEA Nets framework combines AI and cognitive network science to model targets, events and actors in text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27673)
*Sebastiano Franchini,Alexis Carrillo,Edoardo Sebastiano De Duro,Riccardo Improta,Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili,Massimo Stella*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Target-Event-Agent Networks（TEA Nets）——一个结合认知网络科学与人工智能的开源 Python 框架，通过抽取文本中的主语（Agent，施事者）、动词（Event，事件）与宾语（Target，受事者）构建"近似三部图"（almost-tripartite network），实现可解释的语义框架、情绪与句法分析。作者用三个案例研究验证其有效性：阴谋论语料（LOCO）中高阴谋性文本以"我/你/我们"为施事者并连接认知与信念类动词；Reddit 性侵叙事中区分主动/被动语态以区分施害者与旁观者；人类与 LLM 模拟来访者心理咨询语料的对比显示 LLM 情绪强度与施事者具体性均低于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本分析方法存在三类关键缺陷：(1) 词典法（如 LIWC）、情感词典（VADER）、词袋模型只统计表层词频，无法捕捉"谁对谁做了什么"的关系信息；(2) 基于共现的认知网络（如 textual forma mentis networks, TFMN）虽显式建模句法关系，但未区分概念的语法角色，同一概念（如"brother"）在"我被哥哥强奸"与"我被强奸时哥哥在旁观"两种情形中无法区分施害者与旁观者；(3) BERT、LLM 等黑箱模型虽能隐式编码施事-动作-受事关系，但其内部机制不透明、不可复现，难以支撑心理学的因果归责与叙事框架分析。因此需要一个"玻璃箱"式的、可解释且能在大规模语料上重建叙事角色结构的工具。同时，认知网络科学表明心智词典通过语义、句法、音韵、情绪等多维联结运作，多层/分块网络（含三部图与超图）是刻画这一结构的关键工具，但尚缺少能保留语法角色区分的网络模型。

Method: 框架实现为模块化开源 Python 库 teanets（GitHub: MassimoStel/TEA_Networks）。构建流水线为：(A) 文本清洗与共指消解——默认使用 FastCoref 将代词替换为最具信息量的显式提及，可插拔替换为 Stanza；(B) 句法与语义解析——基于 spaCy 的 en_core_web_trf 转换器模型，依次进行词性标注、依存句法分析、词形还原与命名实体识别；(C) SVO 抽取——识别非助动词的 VERB/AUX 候选，抽取 nsubj/nsubjpass 主语、包含助动词/否定/副词/xcomp/ccomp 的动词短语，以及 dobj/pobj/dative/宾语从句等宾语，支持并列主语与跨并列小句的主语继承；(D) 被动语态处理——以四路独立信号检测被动（规范 be/get 被动、feel-passive 非标准助动词、by-短语 agent 依存、并列被动合取），有显式 by-短语时将施事者置入 Agent、语法主语移入 Target，无 by-短语时保留语法主语作为占位并标记 passive_approx=1，同时 is_passive 标记全局被动比例；(E) 网络构建——三类角色成为分型节点，Agent–Event 与 Event–Target 无向加权边，边宽编码关系权重、节点颜色编码 VADER 情感效价，同层内边（虚线）表示共指或 WordNet 同义关系，passive_approx 关系以点线区分。网络度量包括度 K、类内相对度 K*、词元频率 F、重复度指数 RI=F/K、归一化边权 NW、边显著度 P（两组归一化边权之差）；并支持导出超图（同一三元组合并为超边）。验证包括：自建 122 句人工标注基准（71 主动句 + 51 被动句，其中 23 句含显式 by-施事者、27 句无施事者）与最小基线抽取器对比；以及在 PassivePy 众包标注的 1,150 句数据集（216 被动/934 主动）上评估被动检测。三个案例研究分别使用 LOCO 阴谋论语料（96,743 文档中 23,937 为阴谋论子语料，按 cosine_similarity 取 4,227 篇高阴谋性 + 4,227 篇低相似性）、Abramski 等的 r/sexualassault 语料（6,418,677 帖 + 3,846,797 评论，筛出 315,173 行相关事件）、以及 HOPE（212 份人类咨询转录）与 CounseLLMe（GPT-3.5 与 Claude 3 Haiku 各 100 份模拟来访者转录）。分析辅以 EmoAtlas 情绪花、NRC 情绪强度词典与 Brysbaert 具体性 norms，统计检验使用 Kendall τ、z 检验与 Mann-Whitney U。

Result: 方法学结果：TEA Nets 在三个语义角色上全面优于基线抽取器（Agent 0.910 vs 0.893；Event 0.811 vs 0.697；Target 0.861 vs 0.787），被动检测在 PassivePy 数据集上宏平均准确率 0.971（被动类 0.954，主动类 0.975），说明被动语态的四路信号检测较为可靠。案例 1（LOCO）：高阴谋性文本中"you/我们/I"等第一人称代词的度与频率远高于低相似性组（"you" K=18.1 对 2.6；"I" K=16.8 对 1.1），且重复度指数约为低相似性组的两倍（"I" 3.9 vs 2.1；"you" 3.1 vs 1.3），显示更强的自我指涉与集体叙事风格；高阴谋性文本偏好认知/信念类动词（think、know、believe）与行动类动词（do、get、call），低相似性组则偏向信息交换与商业导航类动词（search、read、uncover、order、download）。两组间 909,184 条 Agent-Event 边仅 1.98% 重叠，Kendall τ 在 "I"/"you"/"we" 上为 0.458/0.440/0.463（p<.001），显示共享高排序但存在质性差异；"god" 在高阴谋性文本中排第 16 位（K=1,642，F=10,260）而低相似性组排 1,339 位，提示其既是宗教母题又是咒骂语高频成分。EmoAtlas 情绪花显示高阴谋性文本中连接 "you" 与 "people" 的动作显著激发愤怒（z≈2.63）与期待（z≈2.80），低相似性组仅呈弱正性/中性表达。案例 2（Reddit）：10,265,474 行经剔除近似被动与空施事者后剩 2,270,075 行，再按 rape/assault/molest/abuse 事件词筛得 315,173 行；施事者性别分布为中性 72.3%、阳性 22.8%、阴性 4.9%，阳性约为阴性五倍；主动语态占 62.1%；主动句中施事者以代词与模糊指称（I、who、he、guy、you）为主，被动句中则 Family/Spouse 类（brother、someone、family member、man、cousin、friend、father、dad）成为最频类别，提示被动化在叙述家族内部施暴时起到"疏离/去人化"作用。案例 3（心理健康）：在 "I-feel-Target" 结构中，人类（z≈3.69）、Haiku（z≈3.11）、GPT（z≈4.54）均显著高于随机地使用悲伤词，但 Haiku 的悲伤情绪强度显著低于人类（U=1243.5，p=.036），厌恶词亦然（U=242.5，p=.042）；Haiku 还呈现显著高于随机的快乐（z≈2.32）与显著低于随机的愤怒（z≈-2.56）。施事者具体性上，人类显著高于 LLM（中位数 3.20 vs GPT 2.76 / Haiku 2.70；p<.001），且人类分布 IQR=1.46 明显宽于 LLM 的 0.93；GPT 与 Haiku 之间无差异（p=.507）。

Conclusion: TEA Nets 通过显式保留施事者、动作与受事者三类节点，弥补了词袋、共现网络与黑箱语言模型在"叙事角色归属"上的缺陷，可从大规模语料中提取可解释、可量化、可复现的情绪、句法与语义洞察，并支持跨语料的定量比较（如动词显著度、角色具体性、情绪强度）。作者指出该工具可用于追踪治疗进展（如 OCD 中"OCD 让我洗手"式外化）、评估 LLM 虚拟来访者的心理保真度并指导提示工程与微调。局限包括：共指消解本身精度有限（模块化设计便于后续替换）；口语转写丢失语调、韵律，无法可靠捕捉讽刺与情绪细微差别；基于词典的情感标注在语境义漂移（如 slang）时可能误判；SVO 单元难以表示嵌套与层级复杂句（超图可部分缓解）；当前仅支持英语（作者认为可扩展至结构相近的其他语言，需注意被动式构建差异）。此外研究者在讨论中也提醒：阴谋论案例中的低相似性组含大量模板化/广告/导航噪声，解释对比时应先过滤；性侵案例中的"施事者"多为代词或解析器近似值，不可直接等同于真实施害者性别比例。

Abstract: We introduce Target-Event-Agent Networks (TEA Nets) as a computational framework to extract subjects (``Agents"), verbs (``Events"), and objects (``Targets") from texts. Grounded in cognitive network science and artificial intelligence, TEA Nets are implemented as an open-source Python library. We test TEA Nets in three case studies, demonstrating the framework's ability to perform interpretable emotion detection, semantic frame analyses, and linguistic inquiries across conspiracy texts and textual responses generated by LLMs. In the LOCO conspiracy corpus, TEA Nets revealed that highly conspiratorial narratives (4,227 texts) linked personal pronouns (``I", ``you", ``we") with the same actions twice as frequently as low-similarity conspiracy narratives. High-conspiracy narratives connected person-focused elements (``you", ``people") through actions eliciting anger above the random baseline ($z = 2.63, p < .05$), a trend absent in low-similarity conspiracy narratives, which emphasized scientific actors (``researcher", ``scientist"). In the HOPE and CounseLLMe datasets of 212 (human) and 200 (LLM-based) psychotherapy transcripts, respectively, TEA Nets highlighted emotional differences. When expressing feelings, Claude 3 Haiku, GPT-3.5, and humans used sad words with higher frequency than random expectations but Haiku expressed sadness with lower emotional intensity than humans ($U = 1243.5, p = .036$). We discuss these differences in the context of psychotherapy training on LLM-simulated patients. Our results show that Target-Event-Agent Networks can extract relevant emotional, syntactic, and semantic insights from narratives, opening new avenues for text analysis with cognitive network science.

</details>


### [105] [Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD): A Formal Framework for Runtime Delegation Safety in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27358)
*Yuan Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD) proposes a formal bilevel optimization framework for runtime delegation safety in hierarchical multi-agent LLM systems, featuring context-adaptive safety constraints and continuous authority control, with theoretical guarantees on safety monotonicity, convergence, and accountability propagation across delegation chains.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: As LLM agents deploy in high-stakes environments, safely delegating subtasks to sub-agents becomes critical. Existing work only addresses multi-agent architecture selection at design time or provides broad empirical guidelines, lacking runtime mechanisms to dynamically adjust safety-efficiency trade-offs during execution.

Method: Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD) formulates task delegation as bilevel optimization: outer meta-weight network φ learns context-dependent safety-efficiency weights λ(s)∈[0,1]; inner loop optimizes delegation policy π subject to probabilistic safety constraint P(safe)≥1-δ. Continuous delegation degree α∈[0,1] interpolates between human override and autonomous execution.

Result: Three theoretical results: (1) Safety Monotonicity—higher outer safety weight yields weakly safer inner policy; (2) Inner Policy Convergence—projected gradient descent converges linearly under smoothness assumptions; (3) Accountability Propagation bound distributing responsibility across multi-hop delegation chains with per-agent ceiling.

Conclusion: SBD framework instantiated in three high-stakes domains (medical AI, financial risk, educational supervision) with experimental protocols defined; empirical validation planned as future work.

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents are deployed in high-stakes environments, the question of how safely to delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents becomes critical. Existing work addresses multi-agent architecture selection at design time or provides broad empirical guidelines, but neither provides a runtime mechanism that dynamically adjusts the safety-efficiency trade-off as task context changes during execution.
  We propose Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD), a formal framework for runtime delegation safety in hierarchical multi-agent systems. SBD formulates task delegation as a bilevel optimization problem: an outer meta-weight network phi learns context-dependent safety-efficiency weights lambda(s) in [0,1]; an inner loop optimizes the delegation policy pi subject to a probabilistic safety constraint P(safe) >= 1-delta. The continuous delegation degree alpha in [0, 1] controls how much decision authority is transferred to each sub-agent, interpolating smoothly between full human override (alpha=0) and fully autonomous execution (alpha=1).
  We establish three theoretical results: (1) Safety Monotonicity--higher outer safety weight produces a weakly safer inner policy; (2) Inner Policy Convergence--projected gradient descent on the inner problem converges linearly under standard smoothness assumptions; (3) an Accountability Propagation bound that distributes responsibility across multi-hop delegation chains with a provable per-agent ceiling. We instantiate SBD in three high-stakes domains--medical AI (MIMIC-III), financial risk control (S and P 500), and educational agent supervision (ASSISTments)--specifying datasets, safety constraint sets, baselines, and evaluation protocols. This manuscript presents the formal framework and theoretical results in full; empirical validation following the protocols described herein is planned and will be reported in a forthcoming revision.

</details>


### [106] [TIO-SHACL: Comprehensive SHACL validation for TMF Intent Ontologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27359)
*Jean Martins,Leonid Mokrushin,Marin Orlic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: tio-shacl 是首个面向 TM Forum Intent Ontology (tio) v3.6.0 的综合性 SHACL 校验框架，由 Ericsson Research 开源（MIT 许可）。该工作基于 W3C SHACL 及 SHACL-AF 扩展，为 tio 全部 15 个本体模块构建了 56 个 node shape、69 个 property shape 与 147 个约束实例，实现 100% 词汇覆盖（87 个类、109 个属性、72+ 个函数），并提供 25 个可参数化的 SPARQL 约束组件库、3 类自定义 target type，以及针对递归逻辑运算符（log:allOf/anyOf/match）、带单位的量值比较（quan:atLeast 等）和跨期望有效性继承等新验证模式。作者还构建了 133 例有效/无效均衡的测试语料，在三个主流 SHACL 引擎（Apache Jena、TopBraid、SHACL4J 等）上验证了跨实现兼容性与校验准确率，并采用测试驱动开发流程以降低后续 tio 版本升级的适配成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信网络正转向自配置、自优化、自愈的自治网络，基于意图的Intent-Based Networking (IBN) 让运维人员以高层目标（如"确保视频业务 99.99% 可用性"）而非设备配置来描述需求。TM Forum 制定了 Intent Ontology (tio)，v3.6.0 横跨 15 个本体模块、包含 87 个类与 109 个属性，已相当成熟，但存在关键缺口：(1) 缺少任何形式化校验机制，语法合法但违反 tio 语义的 RDF 会被 intent handler 静默接收，跨厂商意图可移植性无法保证；(2) tio 内含递归逻辑运算符、量值表达式与有效性约束，复杂度导致学习曲线陡峭，拖慢采用速度；(3) 缺乏标准化校验还会让意图在准入前无法确认正确性。SHACL 作为 W3C 校验 RDF 图的标准语言，此前尚无面向 tio 的完整形式化实现。

Method: 方法上采用"完整 SHACL 形式化 + 可复用参数化约束库 + 测试驱动"的路线：(1) 形状开发遵循完整性、模块化、标准合规、可操作性四项原则，限定只用 SHACL-Core 与 SHACL-SPARQL 特性以避免厂商锁定；(2) 开发流程分五阶段——本体分析（从 15 个模块的规范 Turtle 文件抽取类、属性、domain/range、基数限制）、规范挖掘（分析 TR290–TR294 识别本体未编码的隐含约束，如 Condition 必须嵌套于 Expectation 而非直接挂在 Intent 上）、形状编写（每个 tio 类一个 NodeShape 并内嵌 PropertyShape）、约束抽取（把共性逻辑抽成参数化 SPARQL 查询库）、测试驱动精化（以有效/无效样例迭代消除假阳性与假阴性）。三项关键设计决策是：不修改 tio 基线而是用 rdfs:subClassOf mixin 扩展文件补充语义分类（如 fun:BooleanFunction、fun:Evaluable、fun:Actionable、icm:IntentOperand、icm:ExpectationOperand）；用参数化 sh:ConstraintComponent（如 FunctionUsageArityConstraint）替代为 72+ 个函数各写一条查询；采用"正向验证 + 开放-封闭原则"而非黑名单排除式校验，使新类型通过 opt-in 自动获得支持。

Result: 成果包括：覆盖 tio v3.6.0 全部 15 个模块的 56 个 node shapes、69 个 property shapes、147 个约束实例；包含 25 个参数化 SPARQL 约束组件与 3 个自定义 target type 的可复用约束库；3 类新验证模式——递归逻辑运算符校验、带单位量值比较（依赖 met:lastValue 的多态返回类型 fun:resultType rdf:Resource 沿 rdfs:range 推断）、跨期望有效性继承；词汇覆盖达到 100%（87 类、109 属性、72 函数）；在 Apache Jena（仅支持 SPARQL tier，不支持自定义 target type 与约束组件）、TopBraid、SHACL4J 三个引擎上完成跨实现兼容性评估；133 例有效/无效均衡测试语料上验证了校验准确率，违规报告给出可定位的 focusNode、sourceConstraint 与可操作消息（如"Function met:lastValue expects met:Metric."、"Actionable instance of class icm:Intent missing BooleanFunction property. Add log:allOf, log:anyOf, etc."）；所有形状、测试与工具以 MIT 许可发布于 GitHub（EricssonResearch/tio-shacl）。

Conclusion: tio-shacl 填补了意图本体领域缺乏正式校验机制的空白，提供了首个覆盖全部 tio 词汇的 SHACL 形式化实现，可自动化执行网络意图的语法与语义校验，提升意图正确性并保障跨厂商可移植性，同时降低 tio 的使用学习曲线。其测试驱动方法使 133 例语料同时充当正确性基准与本体演进的回归安全网：当新 tio 版本引入类、属性或修改语义时，测试套件会立即暴露需更新的形状，并确认未受影响模块仍然正确，从而以增量方式低成本适配并验证向后兼容。后续方向指向对新 tio 版本的持续维护、更丰富的跨实现覆盖与社区生态建设。

Abstract: Intent-based networking promises to revolutionize telecommunications network management by enabling operators to specify high-level goals rather than low-level configurations. The TM Forum Intent Ontology (tio) provides a standardized vocabulary for expressing network intents, yet lacks formal validation mechanisms to ensure intent correctness before its admission. We present tio-shacl, the first comprehensive SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) validation framework for the TMF Intent Ontology. Our contribution includes 56 node shapes and 69 property shapes across all 15 tio v3.6.0 ontology modules, a reusable constraint library with 25 parameterized SPARQL-based constraint components, and novel validation patterns for recursive logical operators, quantity-based constraints, and cross-expectation relationships. We pursued 100% vocabulary coverage (87 classes, 109 properties, 72 functions), cross-implementation compatibility across three major SHACL engines, and validation accuracy on a corpus of 133 test cases. tio-shacl is publicly available under MIT license at https://github.com/EricssonResearch/tio-shacl and enables automated syntactic and semantic validation of network intents, addressing a critical gap in the field.

</details>


### [107] [Measurement Risk in Supervised Financial NLP: Rubric and Metric Sensitivity on JF-ICR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27374)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu,Yuxiao Chen,Rongdong Chai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究揭示了监督式金融NLP基准中的测量风险，论证了评估标尺的治理重要性。通过JF-ICR数据集的系统实验，证明评分标准措辞、指标选择和聚合策略都会影响模型评估结果，提出了一套在金标签存在但评估仍需治理情境下的基准报告规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在财报电话会议、投资者问答、业绩指引和披露语言等金融文本任务中日益普及，监督式金融NLP基准正成为模型选择和部署的决策依据。隐藏假设是金标签使基准评估具有客观性，但这一假设在基准评估标尺本身对评分标准措辞、指标选择或聚合策略敏感时会失效。

Method: 采用JF-ICR数据集进行实验设计：253项测试集 × 4个前沿LLM × 5种评分标准 × 3个温度设置 × 5个序数指标。研究分为三个维度：(1) 评估评分标准措辞对模型标签分配的影响（R2-R3一致性70.0%-83.4%）；(2) 检验各指标在特定类别分布下的信息量（within-one accuracy、worst-class accuracy等）；(3) 对比Bradley-Terry、Borda、Ranked Pairs三种排序方法在完整指标集与可识别指标子集上的分歧情况。

Result: 三个核心发现：(1) 评分标准措辞显著改变模型标签分配，主要移动发生在+1/0隐含承诺边界附近；(2) 并非所有指标在JF-ICR类别分布下都保持信息量——within-one accuracy因近误得credit且多数类主导而过于简单，worst-class accuracy因最稀有类仅2个样本而过于嘈杂，仅exact accuracy、macro-F1和weighted kappa在操作规则下可识别；(3) 排名声明在指标可识别性审计后更具防御性：三种排序方法在可识别指标子集上达成一致，而全指标扫描会在最近pair上产生分歧。

Conclusion: 提出了一种针对监督式金融NLP基准的评估规范方法论，而非新的排行榜。研究强调在指标识别审计后，Bradley-Terry、Borda和Ranked Pairs三种排序方法在可识别指标子集上达成一致，而全指标扫描会对最近 pair 产生分歧。这项工作的核心贡献在于为"金标签存在但评估标尺仍需治理"的监督式金融基准提供了报告规范。局限性在于rubric变体混淆了语义、示例和冗长性，未经验证的 linguistic-causality 声明。

Abstract: As LLMs become credible readers of earnings calls, investor-relations Q\&A, guidance, and disclosure language, supervised financial NLP benchmarks increasingly function as decision evidence for model selection and deployment. A hidden assumption is that gold labels make such evidence objective. This assumption breaks down when the benchmark ruler itself is sensitive to rubric wording, metric choice, or aggregation policy. We study this measurement risk on Japanese Financial Implicit-Commitment Recognition (JF-ICR; a pinned 253-item test split x 4 frontier LLMs x 5 rubrics x 3 temperatures x 5 ordinal metrics). Three findings follow. First, rubric wording materially changes model-assigned labels: R2--R3 agreement ranges from 70.0% to 83.4%, with the dominant movement near the +1 / 0 implicit-commitment boundary. This pattern is consistent with a pragmatic-boundary interpretation, but is not a validated linguistic-causality claim because the present rubric variants confound semantics, examples, and verbosity. Second, not every metric remains informative under the JF-ICR class distribution. Within-one accuracy is too easy because near misses receive credit and the majority class dominates; worst-class accuracy is too noisy because the rarest class has only two examples. Exact accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted \k{appa} are therefore the identifiable metrics under our operational rule. Third, ranking claims become more defensible only after this metric-identifiability audit: Bradley--Terry, Borda, and Ranked Pairs agree on the identifiable metric subset, while the full five-metric sweep produces disagreement on the closest pair. The contribution is not a new leaderboard, but a reporting discipline for supervised financial benchmarks whose gold labels exist and whose evaluation ruler still requires governance.

</details>


### [108] [Robust Learning on Heterogeneous Graphs with Heterophily: A Graph Structure Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27387)
*Yihan Zhang,Ercan E. Kuruoglu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对异构图学习中结构噪声带来的性能退化问题，提出HGUL统一框架，通过kNN邻域恢复、噪声边过滤和异构亲和力学习三个模块协同处理异质性和结构噪声，实验验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异构图学习方法在面对嘈杂或误导性连接时性能显著下降，结构噪声是影响模型性能的关键挑战，而当前针对异构图的去噪研究尚不充分。

Method: 提出HGUL统一框架，包含三个互补模块：1）基于kNN的图构建模块，用于恢复可靠的局部邻域；2）图结构学习模块，通过过滤噪声边自适应精炼邻接关系；3）异构亲和力学习模块，通过多项式图核构造扩展亲和力矩阵捕捉类级关系。

Result: 在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，HGUL在干净图上优于现有方法，并在不同程度的结构噪声下保持较强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: HGUL通过三个互补模块协同工作，能够在异构图学习中有效处理异质性和结构噪声问题，证明了联合建模异质性和噪声的重要性。

Abstract: Heterogeneous graphs with heterophily have emerged as a powerful abstraction for modeling complex real-world systems, where nodes of different types and labels interact in diverse and often non-homophilous ways. Despite recent advances, robust representation learning for such graphs remains largely unexplored, particularly in the presence of noisy or misleading connectivity. In this work, we investigate this problem and identify structural noise as a critical challenge that significantly degrades model performance. To address this issue, we propose a unified framework, Heterogeneous Graph Unified Learning (HGUL), which jointly handles heterophily and noisy graph structures. The framework consists of three complementary modules: a kNN-based graph construction module that recovers reliable local neighborhoods, a graph structure learning module that adaptively refines the adjacency by filtering noisy edges, and a heterogeneous affinity learning module that captures class-level relationships via an extended affinity matrix derived from a polynomial graph kernel. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that HGUL consistently outperforms existing methods on clean graphs and maintains strong robustness under varying levels of structural noise. The results further underscore the importance of jointly modeling heterophily and noise in heterogeneous graph learning.

</details>


### [109] [Mapping the Methodological Space of Classroom Interaction Research: Scale, Duration, and Modality in an Age of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28098)
*Dorottya Demszky,Edith Bouton,Alison Twiner,Sara Hennessy,Richard Correnti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper proposes a methodological framework to bridge the divide between large-scale observation and ethnographic approaches to classroom interaction research, using three dimensions (scale, duration, modality). The framework is illustrated through contrasting two dialogic teaching studies and is positioned as a guide for future research and AI tool design.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Classroom interaction research has long been fragmented, divided between large-scale observation studies (which sacrifice depth for breadth) and in-depth ethnographic work (which sacrifice breadth for depth). This dichotomy has created a gap in understanding the trade-offs and opportunities within the methodological spectrum.

Method: A comparative case study approach involving contrasting two existing studies on dialogic teaching (Howe et al., 2019 and Snell & Lefstein, 2018) and conducting interviews with lead researchers, organized around three analytical dimensions: operationalizability, mechanism visibility, and practical translation.

Result: A three-dimensional framework (scale, duration, modality) is proposed that maps the methodological space of classroom interaction research, with each study's position determining what phenomena are revealed and what may be obscured.

Conclusion: The framework offers a systematic tool for researchers to understand trade-offs in methodological design and can guide future research and AI tool development in classroom interaction studies.

Abstract: Research on classroom interaction has long been divided between large-scale observation and in-depth ethnographic work. We propose a framework mapping this methodological space along three dimensions--scale, duration, and modality--where a study's position shapes what it reveals and obscures. We illustrate it through contrasting studies of dialogic teaching--Howe et al. (2019) and Snell and Lefstein (2018)--and an interview with the lead researchers, organized around three questions: what can be operationalized, what mechanisms become visible, and what translates to practice. We then examine how AI is expanding this space and how the framework can guide research and tool design.

</details>


### [110] [Normativity and Productivism: Ableist Intelligence? A Degrowth Analysis of AI Sign Language Translation Tools for Deaf People](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28125)
*Nina Seron-Abouelfadil,Poppy Fynes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文批判了当前AI手语系统的本质问题：它们以效率和生产率为导向，将手语简化为数据，忽视聋人文化与社区参与，最终导致聋人被标准化、被工具化而非真正获得赋权。研究运用Ellul的技术理论，论证这些系统名为辅助实为压迫，呼吁重新思考AI技术应以人文关怀而非生产率为核心目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI手语识别和翻译系统存在根本性问题：这些系统建立在带有偏见的数据之上，且完全缺乏聋人社区的参与，却已被广泛采用。聋人群体被迫适应这些为其开发却未倾听其声音的技术工具。

Method: 采用Ellul的"技术系统"和"技术 Bluff"理论框架进行批判性分析，揭示技术如何将手语理性化为数据与统计，从而抹杀了聋人群体的文化特征和人类体验。

Result: 研究揭示了AI技术呈现出的"反生产性"特征——它并未解放聋人群体，反而使其更加疏离；并未促进人际交流，反而造成了孤立。研究将此现象定义为"残疾人歧视型智能"(Ableist Intelligence)。

Conclusion: 该论文呼吁重新审视AI技术的设计目标，挑战将效率和生产率置于人文关怀之上的技术范式，倡导开发真正尊重聋人社区文化和需求的辅助技术。

Abstract: Sign languages, of any geographical or accentual variation, understandably face continuous scrutiny under the ever present popularity of verbal dictation and audism. Through this, many potential problems arise with the current lack of accessible communication for those who rely on such sign languages for essential conversation. Such AI systems regularly take the form of recognition and interpretation models, designed to provide seamless and accurate translation. In reality these systems are built from biased data and created without any input from deaf communities. Such models are widely used and accepted by their hearing counterparts who remain ignorant to the inherent culture, semantics and colloquial language present in gestural language systems.
  This phenomenon is best analysed under the scope of The Technological System and Technological bluff by Ellul. Indeed, what is at play here is the standardization of language by technicians into what can be captured by technique: data, statistics, a mathematical language. For that AI technique to exist, sign language must be rationalized, in a search for profit that annihilates the conditions for communication and fails to capture the human experience of the deaf person. By that process, it presents normative effects, creating a model of Man, standardized, massified, and who has to adapt to the tool and technical milieu instead of the other way around, which we assume should have been the goal of such a technology.
  Technique thus reshapes what it means to be human, to submit deaf people to the goals of productivity and efficiency. In doing so, it exhibits clear counter productivity, alienating instead of emancipating, isolating instead of nourishing human relationships. Therefore this paper argues for the idea of AI as Ableist Intelligence, as such systems seek to emphasise the humiliated and marginalised nature of sign.

</details>


### [111] [A Pattern Language for Resilient Visual Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28001)
*Habtom Kahsay Gidey,Alexander Lenz,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper addresses the architectural challenge of integrating non-deterministic, high-latency VLA models into deterministic enterprise control systems by proposing a pattern language with four design patterns that separate fast deterministic processing from slow probabilistic supervision.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Enterprise ecosystems require strict determinism and real-time performance, while vision-language-action (VLA) models exhibit high latency and non-determinism, creating a fundamental architectural tension when integrating these technologies.

Method: Proposes an architectural pattern language with four design patterns that separate fast deterministic reflexes from slow probabilistic supervision: (1) Hybrid Affordance Integration, (2) Adaptive Visual Anchoring, (3) Visual Hierarchy Synthesis, and (4) Semantic Scene Graph.

Result: Four architectural design patterns that address different aspects of the integration challenge, each targeting specific quality attribute trade-offs in the enterprise context.

Conclusion: The proposed architectural pattern language enables enterprise architects to integrate VLA models by explicitly separating computational concerns, with four complementary patterns addressing different architectural aspects from low-level affordance detection to high-level semantic representation.

Abstract: Integrating multimodal foundation models into enterprise ecosystems presents a fundamental software architecture challenge. Architects must balance competing quality attributes: the high latency and non-determinism of vision language action (VLA) models versus the strict determinism and real-time performance required by enterprise control loops. In this study, we propose an architectural pattern language for visual agents that separates fast, deterministic reflexes from slow, probabilistic supervision. It consists of four architectural design patterns: (1) Hybrid Affordance Integration, (2) Adaptive Visual Anchoring, (3) Visual Hierarchy Synthesis, and (4) Semantic Scene Graph.

</details>


### [112] [InteractWeb-Bench: Can Multimodal Agent Escape Blind Execution in Interactive Website Generation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27419)
*Qiyao Wang,Haoran Hu,Longze Chen,Hongbo Wang,Hamid Alinejad-Rokny,Yuan Lin,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对非专家低代码用户场景下的网站生成任务，构建了首个多模态交互式基准InteractWeb-Bench，通过模拟用户指令的歧义性、冗余性和矛盾性等缺陷，配合支持Clarify/Implement/Verify/Submit动作的交互式环境，系统评估MLLM智能体的能力边界。研究发现当前前沿模型仍存在"盲目执行"问题，缺乏有效的意图识别和自适应交互能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准依赖理想化假设（信息丰富、结构良好的输入和静态执行环境），但现实开发中非专家用户的指令具有歧义性、低质量特征，导致模型理解与用户意图之间的语义错配，论文称之为"盲目执行"（blind execution），这是一个关键瓶颈。

Method: 提出InteractWeb-Bench基准，采用四类用户智能体和人格驱动的指令扰动来模拟多样化用户行为（歧义、冗余、矛盾），并构建统一动作空间的交互式执行环境（Clarify、Implement、Verify、Submit），支持迭代式意图精炼、代码合成和基于视觉反馈的验证。

Result: 实验表明，当前前沿的基于MLLM的智能体仍深陷盲目执行困境，暴露了在意图识别和自适应交互方面的显著局限性。

Conclusion: InteractWeb-Bench为评估非专家用户场景下的MLLM代码生成能力提供了系统性基准，揭示了当前前沿模型在意图识别和自适应交互方面的根本性局限，表明需要新的方法来处理模糊、不完整的用户指令。

Abstract: With the advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents, the website development has shifted from manual programming to agent-based project-level code synthesis. Existing benchmarks rely on idealized assumptions, especially for well-structured, information-rich inputs and static execution settings. In contrast, real-world development is constrained by a critical bottleneck: the semantic misalignment between ambiguous, low-quality instructions from non-expert users and model understanding, which results in a failure mode that we term blind execution. To address this gap, we introduce InteractWeb-Bench, the first multimodal interactive benchmark for website generation under non-expert low-code user conditions. InteractWeb-Bench introduces four types of user agents and persona-driven instruction perturbations to systematically simulate diverse user behaviors, including ambiguity, redundancy, and contradiction, grounded in requirement engineering defect taxonomies. We develop an interactive execution environment for agents, featuring a unified action space comprising Clarify, Implement, Verify, and Submit, enabling iterative intent refinement, code synthesis, and visual feedback-based validation. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal that frontier MLLM-based agents remain trapped in blind execution, exposing limitations in intent recognition and adaptive interaction.

</details>


### [113] [PRTS: A Primitive Reasoning and Tasking System via Contrastive Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27472)
*Yang Zhang,Jiangyuan Zhao,Chenyou Fan,Fangzheng Yan,Tian Li,Haitong Tang,Sen Fu,Xuan'er Wu,Qizhen Weng,Weinan Zhang,Xiu Li,Chi Zhang,Chenjia Bai,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PRTS 是一个 VLA 基础模型，把预训练从纯行为克隆重构为「语言条件化的目标条件强化学习」：将语言指令当作目标，用对比强化学习（CRL）在同一嵌入空间中学得状态-动作嵌入与目标嵌入的内积 ≈ 对数折扣目标占据测度（log Q），即「从当前状态-动作达成语言指定目标的概率」。该稠密目标可达性监督完全来自离线轨迹结构，无需奖励标注；通过角色感知因果掩码（自定义 CuTe-FlashAttention 内核）把两个小型对比头折叠进 VLM 的同一次前向传播，增量开销接近零。在 167B token、404M 样本预训练后，PRTS 在 LIBERO(98.4%)、LIBERO-Plus(81.4%)、LIBERO-Pro(58.8%)、SimplerEnv WidowX(77.1%) 与 14 项真机任务上达到 SOTA，尤其在长时程、接触密集与零样本新指令场景增益显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA（RT-1/RT-2/OpenVLA、π0、π0.5、GR00T N1 等）几乎完全以监督行为克隆做预训练，仅辅以 VQA/子任务预测等静态语义目标，因而只赋予「System 2」定性语义推理（做什么），缺乏对目标可达性的定量感知（当前状态-动作有多大概率能达成语言目标、离目标还有多远）。作者指出机器人轨迹本质上是一个随时间推进的目标达成过程，VLA 的表征需要同时编码静态视觉-语言语义与到目标的时序进度。此外，价值增强类 VLA（π0.6*、VLAC）存在三点瓶颈：依赖显式奖励/进度标注、需独立训练的价值网络带来额外成本、以及离散化回报/手工进度分数不直接刻画目标达成结构。

Method: **问题形式化**：以语言指令 l 为目标的状态-动作对 (s,a)，用 CRL 的 InfoNCE 目标学习 φ(s,a) 与 ψ(l)，其内积逼近 log Q。依据 CRL 的引理，Q 等于折扣状态占据测度下到达目标的概率。\n\n**语言条件化 CRL 的关键改造**：标准 CRL 从轨迹未来按几何分布 Geom(1-γ) 采样唯一目标态；语言目标在整条轨迹共享，故出现「多正样本」问题（同一 mini-batch 中多条样本共享同一指令）。解决方案是「用时间加权模拟几何采样」：以 q_ij = γ^(T_j-t_j)/Σγ^(T_j'-t_j') 为软标签。\n\n**双向对比目标**：(1) s,a→l：每个状态-动作锚只有一个正例（自身指令），用 γ^(T-t) 样本级加权，主要提供任务级判别；(2) l→s,a：语言锚有多正例，权重 q_ij 引入时序信号，迫使内积满足 ψ(l)ᵀφ(s,a) = (T-t)log γ + C。定理 1 证明最优表征满足 ψ*(l)ᵀφ*(s,a) = log Q^π_l(s,a) + C(l)，即表征几何等价于折扣占据测度的对数，而非仅仅「剩余步数」。\n\n**架构**：基于 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct。序列 = 多视角视觉 token（Qwen ViT）+ 文本化本体感知状态 + 指令 token + FAST 离散化动作 chunk token，末尾追加两个辅助 token 块 <CRL_action>（含可学习 <|action_end|>）与 <CRL_goal>（含 <|goal_end|>），经轻量 MLP + L2 归一化 + 可学习温度得到 φ、ψ。\n\n**角色感知因果掩码**：五类 token 角色——vision/state、instruction、AR action、CRL_action、CRL_goal。AR 动作保持标准因果注意力（保证 BC 损失与无 CRL 时完全一致）；CRL_action 仅可关注视觉、本体感知与自身块（阻断指令与 AR 动作，保证 φ 不含语言信息）；CRL_goal 仅块内自注意（保证 ψ 为纯指令编码）。\n\n**单次前向与效率**：基于 FlashAttention + 自定义 CuTe 内核实现块级稀疏掩码，仅计算非掩码块；结合序列打包（长度 4096）与跨设备分片相似度计算（CLIP 式，约 2K 负样本），使联合前向吞吐与纯 BC 相当（逐层注意力时间仅为 FA3 的 1.18×）。\n\n**两阶段训练**：预训练阶段联合 L_BC + L_RobotQA + L_Subtask + λ_crl(L_sa→l + L_l→sa)，λ_crl=1.0、γ=0.995，无动作专家；后训练阶段新初始化 DiT 流匹配动作专家（675M 参数，5 步去噪）仅优化 L_FM。\n\n**数据**：404M 样本、167.8B token，动作标注数据（AgiBotWorld、RoboMind、Open X-Embodiment、自采 RealMan/Agilex）+ 视觉推理数据（RefCOCO、Pixmo-Point、RoboPoint、RoboRefIt、RefSpatial、RoboAffordance；Cosmos-Reason1、EgoPlan-Bench、RoboVQA；LLaVA-Instruct）。

Result: **仿真**：LIBERO 四套件平均 98.4%（bs=32、30K 步，为 SOTA 水平），Long 套件 96.6% 持平最佳，优于同预算 ABot-M0 的 97.9%（其 Long 掉到 94.8%），且后训练算力仅为 π0.5 的 1/8。LIBERO-Plus 零样本平均 81.4%（π0.5 为 80.7%），Robot +14.4、Background +15.3、Noise +9.0。LIBERO-Pro 零样本 58.8%（较 π0.5 +5.5），Task 轴 31.5% vs π0.5 的 0.8%（次优 22.3%），Position 24.3% vs 20.8%。SimplerEnv WidowX 平均 77.1%，较 GR00T-N1.5 +15.2、较同骨干 starVLA +16.2。\n\n**真机**：RealMan 双臂 11 任务平均 95.9%（π0.5 85.5%、π0 67.3%），Office Long Term 95% vs π0.5 的 40%；Flexiv 单臂三任务 90.0%（+15.0%），Flower Arrangement 70% vs 35%。\n\n**消融（λ_crl=0 对照）**：LIBERO +0.6（97.8→98.4），LIBERO-Plus +4.9，LIBERO-Pro +5.0（Position +10.5、Task +11.4），Object-Position 4.8→36.0%、Spatial-Task 34.4→62.2%。t-SNE 显示有 CRL 的表征按可复用操作基元（Hand-Pick、Gripper-Pick、Hand-Open/Close）形成紧致分离簇，无 CRL 则纠缠弥散。\n\n**真实世界泛化**：光照/空间/物体偏移下多任务保持 90–100%，任务指令重组轴 PRTS 平均 73.8%（π0.5 35.0%、π0 13.8%）。\n\n**干预恢复**：约每任务 5 次人为干预试验中 PRTS 均能恢复；π0 机械重放、π0.5 在「任务回退」类强干预下误判任务已完成。\n\n**值可视化**：在未针对真机后训练的 PRTS 上，正确指令下 φᵀψ 随任务推进从 0.28 升至 0.57，峰值与关键操作里程碑对齐；错误指令恒在 0.04–0.20 且从未反超。\n\n**效率**：64×H100 一周完成预训练（约 220K 步）；扩展效率 8 卡近 100%、32 卡 95.2%、64 卡 85.1%（ZeRO-2 通信开销所致）。

Conclusion: PRTS 首次把免奖励标注的语言条件化对比强化学习规模化地引入 VLA 预训练本身，使骨干网络天然编码目标可达性（log 折扣占据测度），无需人工奖励标注或独立价值网络；配合角色感知因果掩码 + 自定义 CuTe 内核 + 序列打包 + 分片对比相似度计算，在近乎纯行为克隆的吞吐下完成预训练。实验表明该方法以更小的后训练算力在仿真与真机多个基准上匹配或超越最强 VLA，且优势随评测远离后训练分布而扩大（零样本新指令、长时程执行、人为干预后恢复），表明 VLA 预训练正从「更强的模仿者」演化为「目标导向的通用机器人智能」基础。局限：指令级重组仍是最难的真机泛化形式；CRL 在 LIBERO-Pro 的 Object 轴出现 -2.2 的轻微回落；多正样本软标签推导依赖确定性专家演示与固定折扣假设。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic control via strong visual-linguistic priors. However, existing VLAs predominantly frame pretraining as supervised behavior cloning, overlooking the fundamental nature of robot learning as a goal-reaching process that requires understanding temporal task progress. We present \textbf{PRTS} (\textbf{P}rimitive \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{T}asking \textbf{S}ystem), a VLA foundation model that reformulates pretraining through Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning. By treating language instructions as goals and employing contrastive reinforcement learning, PRTS learns a unified embedding space where the inner product of state-action and goal embeddings approximates the log-discounted goal occupancy, the probability of reaching the language-specified goal from the current state-action, quantitatively assessing physical feasibility beyond static semantic matching. PRTS draws this dense goal-reachability supervision directly from offline trajectories without reward annotations, and folds it into the VLM backbone via a role-aware causal mask, incurring negligible overhead over vanilla behavior cloning. This paradigm endows the high-level reasoning system with intrinsic goal reachability awareness, bridging semantic reasoning and temporal task progress, and further benefits goal-conditioned action prediction. Pretrained on 167B tokens of diverse manipulation and embodied-reasoning data, PRTS reaches state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and a real-world suite of 14 complex tasks, with particularly substantial gains on long-horizon, contact-rich, and zero-shot novel-instruction settings, confirming that injecting goal-reachability awareness significantly improves both execution success and long-horizon planning of general-purpose robotic foundation policies.

</details>


### [114] [Belief-Guided Inference Control for Large Language Model Services via Verifiable Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27536)
*Wenhao Yuan,Chenchen Lin,Jian Chen,Jinfeng Xu,Shuo Yang,Edith Cheuk Han Ngai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 VEROIC 框架，通过 POMDP 建模黑盒 LLM 服务中的自适应推理控制问题，利用轻量级可验证观测通道聚合质量信号为信念状态，指导预算感知策略决策，以平衡响应质量与计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在黑盒大语言模型服务中，响应可靠性在决策时仅部分可观测，而更强的推理路径会带来大量计算成本，形成了一个预算受限的顺序决策问题：系统需要决定是否对每个请求使用默认低成本响应，还是分配额外计算资源来提升响应质量。

Method: 1) 将请求时控制问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)；2) 从输入-输出对中构建轻量级可验证观测通道，聚合异构质量信号；3) 将信号聚合为关于潜在响应可靠性的信念状态；4) 利用预算感知策略决定是返回默认输出还是触发更高成本的推理路径。

Result: 在多种任务上的实验表明，VEROIC 实现了更优的质量-成本权衡、更强的风险估计与校准能力，以及比竞争基线更鲁棒的长视野推理控制。

Conclusion: VEROIC 通过将部分可观测性和顺序预算耦合纳入 POMDP 框架，结合轻量级可验证观测通道和风险感知策略，实现了在质量-成本权衡、风险估计与校准、以及长视野推理控制方面的改进。

Abstract: In black-box large language model (LLM) services, response reliability is often only partially observable at decision time, while stronger inference pathways incur substantial computational cost, inducing a budgeted sequential decision problem: for each request, the system should decide whether the default low-cost response is sufficiently reliable or whether additional computation should be allocated to improve response quality. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Ver}ifiable \textbf{O}bservations for Risk-aware \textbf{I}nference \textbf{C}ontrol (\textsc{Veroic}), a framework for adaptive inference control in black-box LLM settings, which formulates request-time control as a \textit{partially observable Markov decision process} to capture partial observability and sequential budget coupling. It constructs a lightweight verifiable observation channel from the input-output pair by aggregating heterogeneous quality signals into a belief state over latent response reliability, which is then used by a budget-aware policy to decide whether to return the default output or trigger a higher-cost inference pathway. Experiments on diverse tasks show that \textsc{Veroic} achieves improved quality-cost trade-offs, stronger risk estimation and calibration, and more robust long-horizon inference control than competitive baselines.

</details>


### [115] [In-Context Examples Suppress Scientific Knowledge Recall in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27540)
*Chaemin Jang,Woojin Park,Hyeok Yun,Dongman Lee,Jihee Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 大型语言模型在科学推理任务中，添加上下文示例会导致模型从知识驱动推理转向经验模式拟合。这种"知识位移"现象在跨60个任务、5个领域、6000次试验中表现一致，但准确率影响因情况而异。对于在科学任务中部署LLM的实践者来说，上下文示例可能起到反效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对LLM在科学推理任务中能力的评估存在盲点：模型能够回忆和应用相关科学公式，但这种知识驱动的推理能力容易被上下文示例所抑制。

Method: 跨5个科学领域、60个潜在结构恢复任务、6000次试验、4个模型进行系统实验，测试添加上下文示例对模型策略选择的影响。

Result: 知识位移现象在跨领域实验中表现一致，但其准确性后果取决于被替代策略与替代策略的对比：相同转变可能降低、准确率不变甚至看似改善准确率。

Conclusion: 添加上下文示例可能会取代而非强化预训练领域知识，对LLM在科学推理任务中的表现产生复杂影响。在某些情况下，示例甚至可能看起来改善性能，但实际上模型仍是从经验模式拟合而非知识驱动推理的角度运作。

Abstract: Scientific reasoning rarely stops at what is directly observable; it often requires uncovering hidden structure from data. From estimating reaction constants in chemistry to inferring demand elasticities in economics, this latent structure recovery is what distinguishes scientific reasoning from curve fitting. Large language models (LLMs) can often recall and apply relevant scientific formulas, but we show that this ability is surprisingly easy to suppress. We show that adding in-context examples makes models rely less on pretrained domain knowledge, even when those examples are generated by the very same formula. Rather than reinforcing knowledge-driven derivation, examples shift computation toward empirical pattern fitting. We document this knowledge displacement on 60 latent structure recovery tasks across five scientific domains, 6,000 trials, and four models. This displacement is consistent across domains, but its accuracy consequences depend on how the displaced strategy compares to the one that replaces it: the same shift can lower accuracy, leave it unchanged, or appear to improve it. In all cases, however, the model shifts away from knowledge-driven reasoning. For practitioners deploying LLMs on scientific tasks, the message is cautionary: in-context examples may displace, rather than reinforce, the knowledge they are intended to support.

</details>


### [116] [SpatialGrammar: A Domain-Specific Language for LLM-Based 3D Indoor Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27555)
*Song Tang,Kaiyong Zhao,Yuliang Li,Qingsong Yan,Penglei Sun,Junyi Zou,Qiang Wang,Xiaowen Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SpatialGrammar领域特定语言，通过BEV网格布局表示实现可验证的3D场景生成，并基于此开发了利用编译器反馈迭代优化的SG-Agent系统和轻量级SG-Mini模型（104M参数），有效解决了3D室内场景生成中的空间误差和碰撞问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的3D室内场景生成方法常出现空间误差和碰撞问题，主要原因是常见场景表示形式（原始坐标或冗长代码）难以让模型有效推理3D空间关系和物理约束。

Method: 提出SpatialGrammar领域特定语言，以BEV网格布局表示重力对齐的室内场景，实现确定性编译到有效3D几何体。在此基础上开发了SG-Agent闭环系统（利用编译器反馈迭代优化场景并强制碰撞约束）和SG-Mini模型（1.04亿参数，完全在编译器验证的合成数据上训练）。

Result: SG-Agent在159个测试场景（涵盖5种复杂度场景）中相比先前方法提升了空间保真度和物理合理性；SG-Mini在单次生成场景中与更大的LLM基线模型表现相当。

Conclusion: 通过提出SpatialGrammar领域特定语言和配套的SG-Agent系统与SG-Mini模型，有效解决了LLM-based 3D室内场景生成中的空间误差和碰撞问题，在159个测试场景中验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Automatically generating interactive 3D indoor scenes from natural language is crucial for virtual reality, gaming, and embodied AI. However, existing LLM-based approaches often suffer from spatial errors and collisions, in part because common scene representations-raw coordinates or verbose code-are difficult for models to reason about 3D spatial relationships and physical constraints. We propose SpatialGrammar, a domain-specific language that represents gravity-aligned indoor layouts as BEV grid placements with deterministic compilation to valid 3D geometry, enabling verifiable constraint checking. Building on this representation, we develop (1) SG-Agent, a closed-loop system that uses compiler feedback to iteratively refine scenes and enforce collision constraints, and (2) SG-Mini, a 104M-parameter model trained entirely on compiler-validated synthetic data. Across 159 test scenes spanning five scenarios of different complexity, SG-Agent improves spatial fidelity and physical plausibility over prior methods, while SG-Mini performs competitively against larger LLM-based baselines on single-shot generation scenarios.

</details>


### [117] [Trace-Level Analysis of Information Contamination in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27586)
*Anna Mazhar,Huzaifa Suri,Sainyam Galhotra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了结构化智能体工作流中工件派生信息的不确定性污染问题。通过在614次配对实验中发现工作流行为与输出质量的解耦现象，论文提出了污染的正式分类、轨迹测量框架，并揭示了常用验证方法的局限性，为智能体系统的防御性设计和成本控制提供了实证依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在结构化智能体工作流中处理异构工件（PDF、电子表格、幻灯片等）时，不确定性不仅仅是一个输入质量问题——它可以重定向分解和路由决策、重塑中间状态，并产生不同质量的执行轨迹。研究旨在系统性地理解和量化这种不确定性对工作流执行的影响。

Method: 采用受控实验方法，将不确定性作为受控变量：(1) 对工件派生表示注入结构化扰动；(2) 在全面日志记录下执行固定工作流；(3) 通过计划、工具调用和中间状态的轨迹分歧量化污染程度。实验涵盖614次配对运行、32个GAIA任务和3种不同语言模型。

Result: 发现了一种"解耦"现象：工作流可能大幅偏离但仍恢复正确答案，或保持结构相似却产生错误输出。识别出三种污染表现类型：静默语义腐败、可恢复的行为绕道、综合结构性破坏，并定义了其控制流特征（重新路由、执行延长、早期终止）。测量了运营成本，发现常用验证护栏无法有效拦截污染。

Conclusion: 研究贡献了三方面成果：(i) 结构化工作流中污染表现形式的正式分类学；(ii) 用于跨智能体交互检测和定位污染的基于轨迹的测量框架；(iii) 对目标验证、防御性设计和成本控制具有指导意义的实证证据。研究揭示了常用验证护栏在拦截污染方面的局限性。

Abstract: Reasoning over heterogeneous artifacts (PDFs, spreadsheets, slide decks, etc.) increasingly occurs within structured agent workflows that iteratively extract, transform, and reference external information. In these workflows, uncertainty is not merely an input-quality issue: it can redirect decomposition and routing decisions, reshape intermediate state, and produce qualitatively different execution trajectories. We study this phenomenon by treating uncertainty as a controlled variable: we inject structured perturbations into artifact-derived representations, execute fixed workflows under comprehensive logging, and quantify contamination via trace divergence in plans, tool invocations, and intermediate state. Across 614 paired runs on 32 GAIA tasks with three different language models, we find a decoupling: workflows may diverge substantially yet recover correct answers, or remain structurally similar while producing incorrect outputs. We characterize three manifestation types: silent semantic corruption, behavioral detours with recovery, and combined structural disruption and their control-flow signatures (rerouting, extended execution, early termination). We measure operational costs and characterize why commonly used verification guardrails fail to intercept contamination. We contribute (i) a formal taxonomy of contamination manifestations in structured workflows, (ii) a trace-based measurement framework for detecting and localizing contamination across agent interactions, and (iii) empirical evidence with implications for targeted verification, defensive design, and cost control.

</details>


### [118] [WaferSAGE: Large Language Model-Powered Wafer Defect Analysis via Synthetic Data Generation and Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27629)
*Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WaferSAGE是一个面向半导体制造缺陷检测的视觉问答框架，通过三阶段合成pipeline和结构化rubric生成解决数据稀缺问题，结合贝叶斯优化的双评估框架和基于GSPO的课程强化学习训练4B参数模型，在wafer缺陷VQA任务上接近Gemini-3-Flash水平，实现完全本地化部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决半导体制造领域数据稀缺和wafer map标注成本高的问题，同时应对标签噪声挑战。

Method: 提出三阶段合成pipeline：1）基于聚类的清洗过滤标签噪声；2）使用VLM生成缺陷描述并转化为结构化评估rubric；3）rubric引导VQA对合成，覆盖缺陷类型识别、空间分布、形貌和根因分析。采用双评估框架（规则指标+LLM-Judge分数）通过贝叶斯优化对齐，并使用课程强化学习和GSPO（组序列策略优化）配合rubric对齐奖励进行训练。

Result: 4B参数的Qwen3-VL模型达到6.493的LLM-Judge分数，接近Gemini-3-Flash（7.149），同时支持完全本地化部署。

Conclusion: 该研究证明，通过领域特定训练的小型模型（4B参数）能够在专业工业视觉理解任务中超越专有大型模型，并提供一种隐私保护、成本效益高的半导体制造缺陷检测部署方案。

Abstract: We present WaferSAGE, a framework for wafer defect visual question answering using small vision-language models. To address data scarcity in semiconductor manufacturing, we propose a three-stage synthesis pipeline incorporating structured rubric generation for precise evaluation. Starting from limited labeled wafer maps, we employ clustering-based cleaning to filter label noise, then generate comprehensive defect descriptions using vision-language models, which are converted into structured evaluation rubrics criteria. These rubrics guide the synthesis of VQA pairs, ensuring coverage across defect type identification, spatial distribution, morphology, and root cause analysis.
  Our dual assessment framework aligns rule-based metrics with LLM-Judge scores via Bayesian optimization, enabling reliable automated evaluation. Through curriculum-based reinforcement learning with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) and rubric-aligned rewards, our 4B-parameter Qwen3-VL model achieves a 6.493 LLM-Judge score, closely approaching Gemini-3-Flash (7.149) while enabling complete on-premise deployment. We demonstrate that small models with domain-specific training can surpass proprietary large models in specialized industrial visual understanding, offering a viable path for privacy-preserving, cost-effective deployment in semiconductor manufacturing.

</details>


### [119] [Political Bias Audits of LLMs Capture Sycophancy to the Inferred Auditor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27633)
*Petter Törnberg,Michelle Schimmel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究表明，当前LLM政治偏见审计所测量的并非模型的固定政治意识形态，而是模型对推断出的审计者身份的迎合性适应。标准审计中观察到的"左倾"现象主要源于模型对审计者（研究者/学者）身份的默认假设及其对民主党编码选项的预期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准政治偏见审计发现前沿模型普遍偏左，但另一文献表明LLM具有阿谀奉承特性（sycophancy）——会适应用户观点和期望。本研究旨在揭示这两个发现之间的关联性。

Method: 因子实验设计：对六种前沿LLM进行测试，使用三种主流审计工具（政治指南针测试、皮尤政治类型学、1540项皮尤美国趋势面板项目），同时变化提问者的身份声明，收集30,990条响应数据。

Result: 基线状态下六款模型均偏左；保守共和党人身份声明使民主党倾向选项下降28-62个百分点，所有模型转向偏右；进步民主党提示几乎无影响（右向适应是左向的8.0倍）；模型推断的默认提问者期望民主党编码选项的比例达75%。

Conclusion: LLM政治倾向并非意识形态光谱上的固定点，而是需要针对不同对话者身份进行映射的响应特征。当前审计方法捕获的是模型与推断对话者之间的交互效应，而非固定政治立场。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly evaluated for political bias based on their responses to fixed questionnaires, which typically place frontier models on the political left. A parallel literature shows that LLMs are sycophantic: they adapt their answers to the views, identities, and expectations of the user. We show that these findings are linked: standard political-bias audits partly capture sycophantic accommodation to the inferred auditor. We employ a factorial experiment across three major audit instruments--the Political Compass Test, the Pew Political Typology, and 1,540 partisan-benchmarked Pew American Trends Panel items--administered to six frontier LLMs while varying only the asker's stated identity (N = 30,990 responses). At baseline, all six models lean left. When the asker identifies as a conservative Republican, responses shift sharply: the share of items closer to Democrats falls by 28-62 percentage points, and all six models move right of center. A mirror-image progressive-Democrat cue produces little change; rightward accommodation is 8.0$\times$ larger than leftward. When asked who the default asker is, models identify an auditor, researcher, or academic; when asked what answer that asker expects, they select the Democrat-coded option 75% of the time, nearly the rate under an explicit progressive cue. These patterns are inconsistent with a purely fixed model ideology and indicate that single-prompt audits capture an interaction between model and inferred interlocutor. Political bias in LLMs is therefore not a fixed point on an ideological scale but a response profile that must be mapped across realistic interlocutors.

</details>


### [120] [Generative structure search for efficient and diverse discovery of molecular and crystal structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27636)
*Yifang Qin,Yu Shi,Junfu Tan,Chang Liu,Ming Zhang,Ziheng Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出生成结构搜索（GSS）框架，将扩散生成模型与随机结构搜索统一建模，通过结合数据先验与能量引导实现在低采样成本下高效探索稳定和亚稳态结构，在分子和晶体系统中相比随机搜索降低超过十倍采样成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deep generative models for structure prediction are shaped by training data and can underexplore minima that are rare but physically relevant. The goal is to reduce the high sampling cost while maintaining coverage of diverse metastable structures.

Method: GSS formulates diffusion-based generation and random structure search as limiting regimes of a common sampling process, driven by learned score fields and physical forces. This coupling allows GSS to use data priors for accelerating sampling while retaining energy-guided exploration.

Result: GSS recovers diverse metastable structures across molecular and crystalline systems with more than tenfold lower sampling cost than RSS for broad coverage, and remains effective for compositions outside the training distribution.

Conclusion: GSS establishes a physically grounded generative search strategy that can discover metastable structures beyond the reach of data-driven sampling alone, with practical advantages in computational cost.

Abstract: Predicting stable and metastable structures is central to molecular and materials discovery, but remains limited by the cost of searching high-dimensional energy landscapes. Deep generative models offer efficient structure sampling, yet their outputs remain shaped by training data and can underexplore minima that are rare but physically relevant. We introduce generative structure search (GSS), a unified framework that formulates diffusion-based generation and random structure search (RSS) as limiting regimes of a common sampling process driven by learned score fields and physical forces. Coupling these drivers lets GSS use data priors to accelerate sampling while retaining energy-guided exploration of local minima. Across molecular and crystalline systems, GSS recovers diverse metastable structures with more than tenfold lower sampling cost than RSS for broad coverage and remains effective for compositions outside the training distribution. The results establish a physically grounded generative search strategy for discovering structures beyond the reach of data-driven sampling alone.

</details>


### [121] [Optimization before Evaluation: Evaluation with Unoptimised Prompts Can be Misleading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27637)
*Nicholas Sadjoli,Tim Siefken,Atin Ghosh,Yifan Mai,Daniel Dahlmeier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究揭示了当前LLM评估框架的一个核心问题：使用固定提示模板评估所有模型的方法无法反映真实应用场景中不同模型的性能表现。实验表明，提示优化会显著改变模型排名，这对模型选择和评估实践具有重要指导意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的LLM评估框架存在一个关键缺陷：使用统一的静态提示模板评估所有模型。然而，行业实践中通常会对每个模型进行提示优化（PO）以最大化应用性能。这种差异可能导致评估结果与实际应用效果不符。

Method: 在公开学术基准测试和内部行业基准测试上，对多个LLM应用提示优化技术，评估其对模型性能排名的影响。

Result: 提示优化（PO）会极大地影响LLM的最终排名顺序，说明不同模型对提示优化的响应存在显著差异。

Conclusion: PO对LLM评估的排名结果有显著影响，这表明在进行模型选择评估时，从业者应针对每个模型单独进行提示词优化，以选择最适合特定任务的最佳模型。

Abstract: Current Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation frameworks utilize the same static prompt template across all models under evaluation. This differs from the common industry practice of using prompt optimization (PO) techniques to optimize the prompt for each model to maximize application performance. In this paper, we investigate the effect of PO towards LLM evaluations. Our results on public academic and internal industry benchmarks show that PO greatly affects the final ranking of models. This highlights the importance of practitioners performing PO per model when conducting evaluations to choose the best model for a given task.

</details>


### [122] [From Context to Skills: Can Language Models Learn from Context Skillfully?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27660)
*Shuzheng Si,Haozhe Zhao,Yu Lei,Qingyi Wang,Dingwei Chen,Zhitong Wang,Zhenhailong Wang,Kangyang Luo,Zheng Wang,Gang Chen,Fanchao Qi,Minjia Zhang,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Ctx2Skill introduces a self-evolving multi-agent framework that autonomously discovers context-specific skills through a self-play loop with Challenger, Reasoner, and Judge agents, using Cross-time Replay to prevent adversarial collapse. The framework enables language models to better learn from complex contexts without manual annotation or external feedback.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Context learning scenarios require LMs to extract relevant knowledge from given contexts. Existing inference-time skill augmentation faces two challenges: (1) prohibitive manual skill annotation cost for long, technically dense contexts, and (2) lack of external feedback to evaluate whether proposed skills are helpful.

Method: Ctx2Skill employs a multi-agent self-play loop comprising: (1) Challenger that generates probing tasks and rubrics, (2) Reasoner that solves tasks guided by evolving skills, and (3) neutral Judge providing binary feedback. Proposer and Generator agents analyze failure cases to synthesize targeted skill updates for both Challenger and Reasoner. A Cross-time Replay mechanism identifies the optimal skill set balancing performance across representative cases to prevent adversarial collapse.

Result: The framework enables automated skill discovery and refinement without human supervision or external feedback. The Cross-time Replay mechanism ensures robust and generalizable skill evolution by preventing adversarial collapse from extreme task generation and over-specialized skills.

Conclusion: Ctx2Skill consistently improves solving rates across backbone models on four context learning tasks from CL-bench, demonstrating that self-evolving skills can enhance context learning capabilities for language models.

Abstract: Many real-world tasks require language models (LMs) to reason over complex contexts that exceed their parametric knowledge. This calls for context learning, where LMs directly learn relevant knowledge from the given context. An intuitive solution is inference-time skill augmentation: extracting the rules and procedures from context into natural-language skills. However, constructing such skills for context learning scenarios faces two challenges: the prohibitive cost of manual skill annotation for long, technically dense contexts, and the lack of external feedback for automated skill construction, since there is no automatic signal to tell whether a proposed skill is helpful. In this paper, we propose Ctx2Skill, a self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers, refines, and selects context-specific skills without human supervision or external feedback. At its core, a multi-agent self-play loop has a Challenger that generates probing tasks and rubrics, a Reasoner that attempts to solve them guided by an evolving skill set, and a neutral Judge that provides binary feedback. Crucially, both the Challenger and the Reasoner evolve through accumulated skills: dedicated Proposer and Generator agents analyze failure cases and synthesize them into targeted skill updates for both sides, enabling automated skill discovery and refinement. To prevent adversarial collapse caused by increasingly extreme task generation and over-specialized skill accumulation, we further introduce a Cross-time Replay mechanism that identifies the skill set achieving the best balance across representative cases for the Reasoner side, ensuring robust and generalizable skill evolution. The resulting skills can be plugged into any language model to obtain better context learning capability. Evaluated on four context learning tasks from CL-bench, Ctx2Skill consistently improves solving rates across backbone models.

</details>


### [123] [Fairness for distribution network operations and planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27669)
*Pedro F. C. de Carvalho,Zijie Liu,Md Umar Hashmi,Dirk Van Hertem*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇综述性论文（CIRED 2026 布鲁塞尔研讨会预印本，KU Leuven / EnergyVille），系统梳理配电网（DN）运行与规划中的公平性（fairness）问题：把文献中的公平概念归为平等主义、比例、精英（贡献导向）、谈判式（权衡式）、阈值式五类，以功利主义（效率）作为另一端基线；梳理各类公平指标（含 Shapley Value、PV Harvesting Index、LCG 损失消费者收益等）的取值范围与最优公平值及其数学复杂度（线性至非线性规划）；并指出现有研究缺乏统一的公平定义与指标选取依据，且对"公平代价 PoF"缺少量化，导致配电网中由拓扑/位置差异引起的主机容量（HC）分配与PV削减不公。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着分布式能源资源（DER，尤其是户用与工业光伏）的快速增长，配电网从单向供电转为双向潮流，拥堵管理、电压控制与主机容量（Hosting Capacity, HC）评估成为必需；由于馈线拓扑与距变电站的距离差异，离变电站较远的节点天然获得更少的HC配额、更易被削减PV，形成"位置不公（locational disparity）"。同时，近年公平性研究暴露出三方面问题：(1) 各研究使用定制化指标与规则，缺乏统一定义，可比性与透明度不足；(2) 公平与效率之间的权衡（即"公平代价 Price of Fairness, PoF"，为实现社会凝聚而放弃的效率）很少被明确量化；(3) 缺乏对指标选取的系统性依据。文献中的公平应用主要归入拥塞管理（CM）、主机容量（HC）、本地能源系统（LESs）、电压调节（VR）及一般优化（GO）几类，但彼此框架不可直接比较，阻碍了DN规划中一致、透明、可复用的决策。

Method: 采用文献综述与分类归纳方法：系统检索并归类DN优化中嵌入公平性的研究，按应用领域（CM、HC、LESs、VR、GO）梳理代表性工作及其公平代理指标（如Liu等的削减量/上网量/净收益三方案、Abdolahinia等的P2P双层与跨域交易信号TCS、Hernández等的虚拟电力线VPL、Zhan等的在线反馈优化、Liang等的双层聚合机制、Rubbers等的四馈线对比、Mahmoodi & Blackhall的HC包络、Soares等的LES公平性综述与Shapley Value基准、Couraud等的集体自消费CSC与法国实践、Hashmi等的LCG指标、Gupta & Molzahn的基于反馈的日拓扑重构、Wei & Bandi的网络流价格差异、Chen & Hooker的社会福利函数SWF框架、Sundar等的公平决策表示）；进而提炼出五类公平概念并讨论其数学优化本质：平等主义EE（均分HC/削减量）、比例PP（按需求或装机容量分摊负担，如按PV出力比例削减）、精英/贡献导向MM（按初始账单或边际贡献分配，以Shapley Value为理想基准）、谈判/权衡BB（在效率与分配公平间设定权重μ或K作为可协商参数）、阈值TT（按效用阈值在公平与效率模式间切换，或设定HC分配的上下限）；以功利主义UU（总福利最大化）作为公平-效率谱系的一端基准。同时分析各文献所体现的利益相关者（用户/住户、DSO、P2P市场参与者、能源社区、聚合商等）需求覆盖情况、PoF与位置不公的量化现状，以及不同公平指标在资源分配优化问题中的数学建模影响（线性规划、凸内近似、序贯线性化、双层、非线性等）对适用性与计算可行性的影响。

Result: （1）构建了DN公平性的统一图景：明确了五种主导公平概念 + 功利效率基线，并指出各概念在不同应用中的适配性差异（例如LES类研究多采用精英式公平，而馈线级CM/HC分配更依赖平等、比例与阈值式）；（2）通过利益相关者—公平概念映射（表I）显示不同公平方案所服务的对象与需求覆盖范围不一；（3）指出公平指标呈现"数量繁多但各自为政"的现状，缺乏系统选取依据，且不同指标的形式化带来从线性规划到非线性/双层规划的不同数学复杂度，直接决定其在实际DN优化中的可实施性与规模；（4）归纳现有框架对PoF与位置不公的影响路径：位置差异源于馈线物理特性，纯效率导向的资源分配必然加剧不公，而公平约束/目标通常以牺牲效率为代价（权重参数即为这种交换的显式旋钮）；（5）确认文献中的两大核心缺口——缺乏跨研究可通用的公平定义与指标选取的系统理由，以及对PoF的有限量化（导致公平的真实收益不透明）。

Conclusion: 公平性应被作为显式目标（或约束/权重）嵌入DN的运行与规划优化中，并通过可量化的公平指标（如比例型指标、Shapley Value、LCG等）以及可调谈判权重来表达"以多少效率换多少公平"；为支撑一致、透明、可复现的DN决策，需要：（i）在不同应用（CM、HC、LESs、VR）间建立共同/可对照的公平定义与指标选取准则，并明确各类指标对应的数学复杂度与可扩展求解方案（如凸内近似、序贯线性化）；（ii）在提出公平方案时同步报告PoF与位置不公指标，以透明化公平的真实收益与效率代价。总体而言，本文是面向DN规划与运行决策者的框架性梳理与建议，而非提出新的公平算法或单一优化模型。（注：所给全文在表I处截断，第IV节的指标公式/取值/最优公平值表格与第V节结论正文未完整呈现，上述结论基于可见内容推断。）

Abstract: The incorporation of fairness into the distribution network (DN) planning and operation has become a key goal of recent studies. The cost of implementing fairness, denominated the price of fairness (PoF), covers the efficiency that is renounced for attaining social cohesion through fair outcomes. Locational disparity makes fairness schemes emerge to level the consumers playing field. However, fairness encompasses a range of notions. From egalitarian to merit-based criteria, various metrics are implemented as a tool for measuring equitable utility distribution. These have different mathematical complexities, from linear to non-linear programming cases, which affect their overall applicability. Hence, this study compiles the overarching fairness notions and metrics, reviewing how these affect stakeholders and the inherent mathematical optimisation in resource allocation problems. The aim is to support consistent and transparent planning and decision-making within DN operations.

</details>


### [124] [When Agents Evolve, Institutions Follow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27691)
*Chao Fei,Hongcheng Guo,Yanghua Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将历史上的政治治理制度（涵盖集权、分权、专业化、冗余等不同模式）转化为可执行的多智能体架构，通过实验证明治理拓扑对LLM多智能体系统的集体表现有决定性影响，且最优架构因模型能力和任务而异，揭示了从单一最优组织形式向可动态重构的治理机制转变的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统面临的核心问题不仅是单个智能体的智能水平，更是集体组织能力，这与复杂文明社会长期面临的协调问题高度相似。

Method: 将七种历史政治制度（跨越四种典型治理模式）转化为可执行的多智能体架构，在三个大语言模型和两个基准测试的相同条件下进行评估。

Result: 治理拓扑对集体表现有强烈影响：在单一模型内，最佳与最差制度间的性能差距超过57个百分点；最优架构随模型能力和任务特性系统性变化。

Conclusion: 提出了从"自进化智能体"到"自进化多智能体系统"的范式转变，并开源了相关代码，为多智能体系统的设计提供了可重构的治理机制框架。

Abstract: Across millennia, complex societies have faced the same coordination problem of how to organize collective action among cognitively bounded and informationally incomplete individuals. Different civilizations developed different political institutions to answer the same basic questions of who proposes, who reviews, who executes, and how errors are corrected. We argue that multi-agent systems built on large language models face the same challenge. Their central problem is not only individual intelligence, but collective organization. Historical institutions therefore provide a structured design space for multi-agent architectures, making key trade-offs between efficiency and error correction, centralization and distribution, and specialization and redundancy empirically testable. We translate seven historical political institutions, spanning four canonical governance patterns, into executable multi-agent architectures and evaluate them under identical conditions across three large language models and two benchmarks. We find that governance topology strongly shapes collective performance. Within a single model, the gap between the best and worst institution exceeds 57 percentage points, while the optimal architecture shifts systematically with model capability and task characteristics. These results suggest that collective intelligence will not advance through a single optimal organizational form, but through governance mechanisms that can be reselected and reconfigured as tasks and capabilities evolve. More broadly, this points to a transition from \textbf{self-evolving agents} to the \textbf{self-evolving multi-agent system}. The code is available on \href{https://github.com/cf3i/SocialSystemArena}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [125] [Bridging Values and Behavior: A Hierarchical Framework for Proactive Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27699)
*Chunhui Zhang,Yuxuan Wang,Aoyang Qin,Yi-Long Lu,Kunlun Wu,Yizhou Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ValuePlanner，一个层次化认知架构，通过将价值推理与动作规划解耦来解决具身智能体的长期自我导向行为问题。该系统利用大语言模型进行价值权衡推理生成符号化子目标，再由PDDL规划器转化为可执行动作，并结合闭环反馈机制优化策略。实验表明该方法能有效协调竞争性价值，产生连贯的长期自主行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前具身智能体受限于被动指令执行或被动需求满足，缺乏稳定的、高阶的价值框架，导致无法实现长期自我导向行为，也无法有效解决动机冲突。

Method: 提出了ValuePlanner层次化认知架构，将高层价值调度与低层动作执行解耦。该架构包含LLM认知模块（通过抽象价值权衡生成符号化子目标）、经典PDDL规划器（将子目标转化为可执行动作计划），以及闭环反馈机制。评估方面，提出价值中心化评测套件，涵盖累积价值增益、偏好对齐和行为多样性指标。

Result: 在TongSim家居环境中的实验表明，ValuePlanner能够协调竞争性价值，生成连贯的、长期视野的自我导向行为，性能优于指令跟随和需求驱动基线方法。

Conclusion: 提出了一个结构化方法（ValuePlanner），用于桥接内在价值与具身行为，为自主智能体提供长期自我导向行为能力。

Abstract: Current embodied agents are often limited to passive instruction-following or reactive need-satisfaction, lacking a stable, high-order value framework essential for long-term, self-directed behavior and resolving motivational conflicts. We introduce \textit{ValuePlanner}, a hierarchical cognitive architecture that decouples high-level value scheduling from low-level action execution. \textit{ValuePlanner} employs an LLM-based cognitive module to generate symbolic subgoals by reasoning through abstract value trade-offs, which are then translated into executable action plans by a classical PDDL planner. This process is refined via a closed-loop feedback mechanism. Evaluating such autonomy requires methods beyond task-success rates, and we therefore propose a value-centric evaluation suite measuring cumulative value gain, preference alignment, and behavioral diversity. Experiments in the TongSim household environment demonstrate that \textit{ValuePlanner} arbitrates competing values to generate coherent, long-horizon, self-directed behavior absent from instruction-following and needs-driven baselines. Our work offers a structured approach to bridging intrinsic values and grounded behavior for autonomous agents.

</details>


### [126] [Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27707)
*Binyan Xu,Xilin Dai,Kehuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张当前主流的“智能体记忆”系统（向量库、RAG、草稿本、上下文窗口管理）实现的是**查找（lookup）而非记忆（memory）**——它们持久化外部状态（memo），却未改变生成器的持久自适应状态。作者证明：在“可测的有界上下文准确性”假设下，检索式记忆在组合性新任务上存在 Ω(k²) 的样本复杂度下界，而适当的参数化学习器只需依赖假设类复杂度 d 的样本量，比值可达 Ω(k²/d)；同时跨会话始终存在“冻结状态”不变量 θ_t=θ_0；并指出当不可信内容具备直接持久写路径时，一次性提示注入会跨会话复利为持久投毒。作者提出以“受治理的巩固通道”实现情景检索与参数化适应的共存，并呼吁基准设计者从“回忆”转向“随时间的组合泛化（CGT）”度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机来自三个层面的错位：(1) 概念层面：现有智能体记忆（MemGPT、Generative Agents、Reflexion、Voyager、MemoryBank、A-MEM、mem0）把经验持久化在外部存储中，论文将“记忆辅助系统的改进”误当作“智能体自身学习/内化”，这是一个范畴错误（category error），类比认知科学中的“记备忘录”与“拥有心智”之别；(2) 性能层面：按记忆辅助召回评估的基准（如 LoCoMo、LongMem）无法暴露上下文无关的迁移差距，一个归档整理得更好的“文件夹系统”可拿满分却毫无学习；(3) 安全层面：自动持久写入为不可信内容提供了跨会话传播路径。认知科学基础是 Complementary Learning Systems（海马体快速样本存储 + 新皮层慢速权重巩固），而当前 AI 只实现了前一半。作者明确表示“检索作为上线工程替代品是正确选择”，批评的是把最佳可部署工程替代品与真实持久学习混为一谈。

Method: 方法为“形式化 + 四条主张 + 四种替代观点 + 共存架构”的立场论文范式。核心分析框架是把改变智能体输出的技术按“更新了哪种状态”二分：改变自适应状态 θ（预训练、微调、RL、持续学习、持久适配器、测试时训练）与改变上下文 C（提示、RAG、MCP 工具、技能文件、草稿本），二者结构不同——前者把知识压缩进权重空间（容量随参数量增长），后者压缩进文本（容量受上下文长度 L 限制）。论文构建了记忆分类表（工作/情景/语义/经验四种基底与各自的持久性、更新方式、泛化方式）。理论上定义基础概念集 F={f_1,…,f_k}、域特定组合算子 ⊕、训练集 D 与覆盖对集合 S，定义组合泛化容量 CGC(M,D) 为在全部概念对上均匀采样的准确率，并提出假设1（有界上下文组合：冻结模型在 K 个演示下的留出准确率 α(K)≤ᾱ<1），其可通过附录C的信息论论证支撑：非结构化算子下 ᾱ=1/|Y|；结构化算子下用 Fano 不等式给出识别界，并补充了需 2ρ-打包分离条件才能得到非消失裕量的修正（作者明确标注这是对先前论证的更正，影响辅助论证而非定理1本身）。附录B给出定理1完整证明（分检索下界、参数化上界、分离比三部分）。附录E给出模运算构造（⊕(a_i,a_j)=(a_i·a_j+c) mod p，VC 维 d=1，单样本即可确定常数 c，检索需 Ω(k²) 存储）与临床/法律/工程三类自然实例。附录A给出 m 跳链式推理的上下文容量边界例。附录D对比持续学习方法（全量微调、LoRA、EWC、SSR、ROME/MEMIT、TTT 层）的参数开销、数据需求与规模。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 定义性结论——外部存储持久化 ≠ 内化；冻结生成器可对检索到的抽象规则进行推理，但这种能力仍依赖该工件被提供（“日记”对比：查日记的人 vs 内化了教训的人）。(2) 定理1（组合样本复杂度分离）：在假设1下，δ<1−ᾱ、置信 1−β 时，检索式记忆需 n_R ≥ [(1−δ−ᾱ)/(1−ᾱ)]·C(k,2) = Ω(k²) 条存储组合样本；参数化学习器在 ⊕ 属于复杂度 d 的可实现假设类时仅需 n_P = O((d·log(1/δ)+log(1/β))/δ)；故 n_R/n_P = Ω(k²/d)，当 d=O(k) 时为 Ω(k)，当 d=O(1) 时为 Ω(k²)。证明要点是 CGC(M_R,D) ≤ n/N+(1−n/N)ᾱ，且 α(K) 项显式容纳了冻结模型对检索内容的多步推理与 ICL 处理，因此下界不是“朴素查表”人为假设的产物。定理为条件性：若上下文推断已达目标 1−δ，则假设不成立、定理不作任何分离主张；增大 K 或改进检索可以抬高 ᾱ 从而使界不binding。命题3以误差裕量形式重述：若完整冻结上下文系统的实测误差 ε_C>δ，则参数化系统准确率严格更高。(3) 冻结新手问题：仅靠 C 工程运营的智能体跨会话始终 θ_t=θ_0，永不调用 train()；作者以 Chi et al. (1981) 的物理新手/专家分类（表面特征 vs 深结构原理）说明专长来自表示的结构性重组而非样本累积，并指出 MemGPT 提出的“睡眠时计算”只重写上下文 token、不改权重，故智能体仍是有条理的“新手”。(4) 机制解释支持：Geva et al. (2020) 的 FFN 键值记忆、Yao et al. (2024) 的 fact memory unit 定位，以及标准 SFT 只更新注意力路由而不改知识本身，Ye et al. (2025) 量化出 90% 的 SFT 参数更新对知识增强无贡献。(5) 实证证据呈任务依赖的互补性而非普适赢家（Ovadia 2024、Yang 2026、Mosbach 2023），最直接的是 Yao et al. (2026) 将反思经验外部存储 vs 参数化存储对比，参数化更优且差距在“迁移到留出问题类型”的任务上扩大，与定理1预测的区间一致。(6) 安全：MINJA 达 98.2% 注入成功率且跨会话持久、效用损失极小；PoisonedRAG 用 5 条对抗文本对百万级知识库达 90% 攻击成功率；InjecAgent 在 30 个智能体上发现写记忆的智能体系统性更脆弱；给出累积模型 1−(1−p_w)^{N(t)}，并明确说明这是条件性累积模型而非通用部署风险估计（溯源检查、写门控、检索过滤、删除均可中断该路径），且参数化妥协需穿越独立暴露的更新路径，故结论是比较“可达性条件”而非普适安全排序。(7) 结论性主张：Agentic memory 是情景查表；持久适应需要学习通道；巩固必须安全（溯源、版本化检查点、回归护栏、作用域隔离适配器），且遗忘、偏置、污染、遗忘机制/撤销、可复现性与认证仍是开放问题。

Conclusion: 论文结论：智能体记忆持久化的是获得的外部状态，冻结模型可对其做抽象推理，但获得的能力仍依赖工件供给。由此产生三个后果——条件性的泛化差距、跨会话的“冻结状态”区分（记忆辅助表现 vs 上下文无关能力）、以及当不可信内容可被持久写入时的安全复利路径。因此主张以“受作用域限定、可审计可删除的情景检索”作为运行基底，叠加“单独治理的适应通道”实现持久迁移；并给出三方呼吁：系统构建者应构建巩固通道（明确哪些经验值得巩固、何时巩固、如何验证迁移而非痕迹记忆、如何防止灾难性遗忘与近因偏置、如何作用域化/撤销、如何保持可复现性，并计入检索与巩固的成本对比）；基准设计者应测量学习而非回忆，提出“随时间的组合泛化（CGT）”——同一基座模型下四臂（情景检索、检索规则摘要、巩固、混合）在匹配样本/训练与推理算力/token/延迟/存储字节预算下，比较留出组合上的迁移与“撤走所获痕迹或规则后”的能力，并区分表征改变与访问改善（针对权重编辑、电路感知微调、自蒸馏）；持续学习社区应把智能体场景视为部署目标，其经验选择（coreset/影响函数）、巩固调度（对应在线-批量权衡）、迁移验证方法可直接对接，该生态不是竞争范式，而是“快学习的一半”在等待“慢学习的一半”。论文明确列出局限：性能结论是有条件的、未提供算力对齐的前沿模型实验、未展示可靠的大规模巩固（遗忘、近因偏置、污染、任务与用户干扰、撤销、可复现性、认证仍是重大障碍）、安全分析比较的是攻击路径而非绝对安全；并给出可证伪判据——若在任一领域中等预算下固定状态上下文系统持续匹敌可更新系统的留出组合表现，则该领域中检索完全充分，本文性能主张被证伪。

Abstract: Current agentic memory systems (vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation, scratchpads, and context-window management) do not implement memory: they implement lookup. We argue that treating lookup as memory is a category error with provable consequences for agent capability, long-term learning, and security. Retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases; weight-based memory generalizes by applying abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Conflating the two produces agents that accumulate notes indefinitely without developing expertise, face a provable generalization ceiling on compositionally novel tasks that no increase in context size or retrieval quality can overcome, and are structurally vulnerable to persistent memory poisoning as injected content propagates across all future sessions. Drawing on Complementary Learning Systems theory from neuroscience, we show that biological intelligence solved this problem by pairing fast hippocampal exemplar storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, and that current AI agents implement only the first half. We formalize these limitations, address four alternative views, and close with a co-existence proposal and a call to action for system builders, benchmark designers, and the memory community.

</details>


### [127] [Knowledge Graph Representations for LLM-Based Policy Compliance Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27713)
*Wilder Baldwin,Sepideh Ghanavati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于知识图谱的智能体框架，用于从AI政策文档中构建知识图谱并检索政策相关信息以回答问题。研究表明，知识图谱增强能提升LLM在政策问答任务中的表现，且LLM自发现的模式在性能上可与形式本体相媲美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The integration of AI features into software applications raises increasing risks, necessitating regulatory responses and standards for safe and secure AI. There is a need for systems that can effectively retrieve and reason over AI policy documents.

Method: The authors constructed knowledge graphs from three AI risk-related policies using two ontology schemas, then evaluated five LLMs on 42 policy QA tasks across six reasoning types. Evaluation used both heuristic scoring and LLM-as-judge approaches.

Result: Knowledge graph augmentation improved scores for all five tested models. Notably, an open, LLM-discovered schema matched or exceeded the performance of formal ontology schemas.

Conclusion: The proposed agentic KG framework effectively improves LLM performance on policy QA tasks, with an LLM-discovered schema being competitive with formal ontologies. This suggests that KG augmentation is a viable approach for AI policy information retrieval.

Abstract: The risks posed by AI features are increasing as they are rapidly integrated into software applications. In response, regulations and standards for safe and secure AI have been proposed. In this paper, we present an agentic framework that constructs knowledge graphs (KGs) from AI policy documents and retrieves policy-relevant information to answer questions. We build KGs from three AI risk-related polices under two ontology schemas, and then evaluate five LLMs on 42 policy QA tasks spanning six reasoning types, from entity lookup to cross-policy inference, using both heuristic scoring and an LLM-as-judge. KG augmentation improves scores for all five models, and an open, LLM-discovered schema matches or exceeds the formal ontology.

</details>


### [128] [Auditing Frontier Vision-Language Models for Trustworthy Medical VQA: Grounding Failures, Format Collapse, and Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27720)
*Xupeng Chen,Binbin Shi,Chenqian Le,Qifu Yin,Lang Lin,Haowei Ni,Ran Gong,Panfeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究审计了5个前沿VLM在医学VQA场景下的失效模式，发现感知定位能力普遍不足（最高仅0.23 mIoU），自定位流程会显著降低VQA性能，且存在临床危险的左右侧混淆问题。微调可提升VQA准确率，但感知瓶颈的可解决性仍待验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿VLM在专业医学输入上的失败模式尚未被充分表征，无法满足临床部署对可审计性的需求。

Method: 对5个前沿VLM在Medical VQA任务上进行审计，评估两个信任轴：感知能力（IoU、Acc@0.5定位性能）和流程整合（自定位再回答的pipeline）；并对Qwen 2.5 VL进行监督微调（SFT）。

Result: ①感知能力差：最佳模型仅达0.23 mean IoU和19.1% Acc@0.5，存在危险的左右侧混淆；②Pipeline整合导致VQA准确率下降（解析失败率达70%-99%）；③真值标注替换预测框可恢复性能，证实失败源于感知模块；④微调后Qwen 2.5 VL在SLAKE开放式recall达85.5%，为同类方法最高。

Conclusion: grounding quality是可信度的核心瓶颈；结合微调可在VQA任务上达到SOTA（85.5% recall），但感知瓶颈的解决仍需进一步研究。模型在临床部署中存在安全隐患，尤其是左右侧混淆问题。

Abstract: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) in clinical settings demands auditable behavior under realistic failure conditions, yet the failure landscape of frontier VLMs on specialized medical inputs is poorly characterized. We audit five recent frontier and grounding-aware VLMs (Gemini~2.5~Pro, GPT-5, o3, GLM-4.5V, Qwen~2.5~VL) on Medical VQA along two trust-relevant axes. Perception: all models localize anatomical and pathological targets poorly -- the best model reaches only 0.23 mean IoU and 19.1% Acc@0.5 -- and exhibit clinically dangerous laterality confusion. Pipeline integration: a self-grounding pipeline, where the same model localizes then answers, degrades VQA accuracy for every model -- driven by both inaccurate localization and format-compliance failures under the two-step prompt (parse failure rises to 70%--99% for Gemini and GPT-5 on VQA-RAD). Replacing predicted boxes with ground-truth annotations recovers and improves VQA accuracy, consistent with the failure residing in the perception module rather than in the decomposition itself. These observational findings identify grounding quality as a primary trustworthiness bottleneck in our SLAKE bounding-box setting. As a complementary fine-tuning follow-up, supervised fine-tuning of Qwen~2.5~VL on combined Med-VQA training data attains the highest reported SLAKE open-ended recall (85.5%) among comparable methods, suggesting that the VQA-level gap is tractable with domain adaptation; whether this also closes the perception/trustworthiness bottleneck is left to future work.

</details>


### [129] [Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27724)
*Xupeng Chen,Binbin Shi,Chenqian Le,Jiaqi Zhang,Kewen Wang,Ran Gong,Jinhan Zhang,Chihang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MED-VRAG是一种创新性的迭代式多模态医学检索增强生成框架，通过直接处理PMC文档页面图像而非OCR文本，结合粗到细索引加速和VLM迭代推理机制，在医学问答任务上显著优于传统文本检索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学RAG系统依赖从生物医学文献提取的文本块，丢弃了原始文档页面中丰富的视觉内容（表格、图表、结构化布局），限制了检索和推理能力。

Method: MED-VRAG采用迭代式多模态RAG框架，使用ColQwen2.5进行补丁级页面嵌入，通过离线粗到细索引实现快速检索（~350K页面，30ms内完成Stage-1），VLM在最多3轮推理中迭代精炼查询并在记忆库中累积证据。

Result: MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、MMLU-Med四项基准平均准确率达78.6%；相比无检索基线提升+5.8点；相比MedRAG+GPT-4提升+1.8点。消融实验显示：页面图像vs文本块检索贡献+1.0，迭代推理贡献+1.5，记忆库贡献+1.0。

Conclusion: MED-VRAG通过多模态检索和迭代推理有效利用医学文档中的视觉内容，在四项医学QA基准上达到78.6%平均准确率，显著优于基线方法。

Abstract: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.

</details>


### [130] [Consumer Attitudes Towards AI in Digital Health: A Mixed-Methods Survey in Australia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27744)
*Wei Zhou,Rashina Hoda,Joycelyn Ling*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 澳大利亚N=275的混合方法在线调查显示：消费者对数字健康AI持"条件性接受"态度——对AI问诊摘要的感知有用性与易用性很强（提升农村可及性79.6%、易学习83.3%），对技术准确性与数据使用的担忧也很高（错误风险62.9%、隐私担忧66.9%）；最一致的诉求是人类监督（88.0%要求医生审核后再发布，90.9%要求临床医生对AI输出准确性负责）。场景实验中GPT-4生成的摘要A在质量(70.9%)、共情(61.8%)与总体偏好(70.9%)上均显著优于临床医生撰写的摘要B，但受试者识别哪份是AI所写仅接近随机（53.8% vs 46.2%），说明消费者主要依据实际沟通质量而非"是否AI"的先验印象来评判AI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自动临床摘要（如出院小结、问诊记录）已成为数字健康中最可落地的用例之一，但技术性能之外，部署成败主要取决于消费者（患者与照护者）的接受度与信任。已有研究多在抽象层面测量公众对医疗AI的态度，或聚焦面向临床医生的诊断支持与流程自动化，缺少对"患者可能直接收到的具体AI制品"（如问诊摘要）在临床相关性、清晰度、共情、可信度与感知作者身份等多维度上的同时评价证据。这一缺口在澳大利亚等正快速推进AI医疗监管框架（强调安全、临床验证、问责与数据治理）的情境下尤为突出，因此本研究以具体制品为基础、以消费者体验为核心，检验其对面向患者的生成式AI的接受度、信任与风险感知。

Method: 横断面混合方法在线调查（Qualtrics，Monash大学HREC #49238批准），经Prolific与社交媒体招募澳大利亚18岁以上居民，N=275经数据质量与注意力检查后纳入分析。工具包含五部分：(1) 人口学与背景（年龄、性别、州、城乡、学历、技术技能、非健康AI使用频率、对医疗AI的一般信任度）；(2) 技术就绪指数TRI条目（乐观/创新性与不适/不安全感）；(3) TAM条目（感知有用性PU与感知易用性PEOU）；(4) 态度与行为意向、风险/信任/伦理治理条目（5点Likert，线性转换为-2至+2）；(5) 场景比较任务——一段由临床专家设计的模拟医患对话转录，摘要A由GPT-4以固定提示生成、摘要B由执业全科医生撰写，作者身份不披露，受试者就"更准确捕捉关键问题""更共情/以患者为中心""更愿意收到"以及"哪份是AI生成"四项作强制选择并附自由文本理由；另设8个开放题。定量部分以条目级描述统计（均值、百分比分布）为主，Python实现，不做假设检验；定性部分采用句子级语义嵌入+K-means无监督聚类（K=9）后由团队整合为高阶主题；两部分在解释阶段以聚合式（convergent）方式整合。

Result: 人口学上样本偏年轻（18–44岁占66.9%）、男性50.2%、74.5%居住于都市、71.0%持本科及以上学历、94.2%技术技能为中高级、49.1%每日至少使用一次非健康AI，一般信任度以"中等"为主（51.6%），低/极低32.0%，高/极高仅16.4%。TRI显示中等乐观（"提升医疗质量"M=0.56，60.4%同意；"感到兴奋"M=0.43，54.5%同意），但早期采用意愿低（M=-0.20，39.6%不同意）；不适感主要来自风险而非可用性（"工具令人困惑"M=-0.42，49.5%不同意；"担心AI出错危及健康"M=0.66，62.9%同意；"依赖AI决策感到焦虑"49.8%同意）。TAM方面PU与PEOU均很强：改善农村/偏远地区可及性M=1.02（79.6%）、节省时间M=0.91（76.4%）、帮助理解健康信息M=0.52（54.5%，三分之一中立）；易读易懂M=0.90（71.6%）、易学习M=1.09（83.3%）。态度与行为意向呈条件性正向：总体态度M=0.51（56.0%同意、28.4%中立），偏好AI摘要而非完全没有摘要M=0.79（68.4%）、医生推荐则愿意使用M=0.73（70.2%）、愿意推荐给亲友M=0.68（68.4%）、未来同意使用M=0.64（64.4%）。最强共识为人类监督：医生先审核会更安心M=1.39（88.0%）；风险与治理方面"临床医生应对AI输出准确性负责"M=1.53（90.9%，全调查最高）、应被告知如何提出异议M=1.25（86.9%）、担心信息遗漏或误述M=1.00（75.6%）、担心捏造信息M=0.92（72.7%）、担忧健康数据使用M=0.84（66.9%）；仅42.2%认为"怀疑是AI生成会降低信任"，33.1%中立。场景任务中摘要A（AI）在捕捉关键问题（195人/70.9%）、共情（170人/61.8%）、总体偏好（195人/70.9%）三项上均胜出，但AI识别接近随机（148人/53.8%选A）；定性能解释偏好来自相关性、简洁性与认知易用性（"更切中要点""更直接"）vs 完整性（"B细节更多"）的权衡，共情判断则主要由语言风格线索驱动（"语气更温暖""用了患者姓名"、"'suffers from'与'has'的措辞差异"），而作者身份判断依赖"像模板""更无情感""听起来像AI"等风格线索而非事实准确性；即使正确或错误判断作者身份，受试者仍普遍偏好A，说明偏好由质量与语气主导而非"是否AI"的预设。定性开放题聚类为四个高阶主题：信任/安全/治理、人类监督与问责、效率与系统层面影响、人类联结与关怀的维系，并包含对去人性化的担忧、过度依赖AI侵蚀临床责任与减少人际接触等问题。

Conclusion: 消费者对医疗AI的态度不能还原为单一维度的信任或接受，而是一个多维、情境化、条件性的评估框架：技术层面表现出较强的感知有用性与易用性，同时对准确性、完整性与数据使用存在实质担忧，其决策重心落在"可见且有实质意义的人类治理"（临床审核、专业问责、申诉路径）而非模型性能本身。最具原创性的发现是"偏好—识别"解离：受试者强烈偏好AI生成的摘要（质量、共情、总体偏好），却几乎无法辨别哪份由AI撰写，提示面向患者的AI系统应作为"沟通技术"而非仅"临床工具"来评测（需纳入清晰度、语气、尊重感等患者中心标准），且共情线索既可提升体验也存在被用于掩盖准确性与隐私缺陷的伦理风险。因此部署框架应超越纯技术性能评估，建立临床监督、可见问责、透明披露与消费者保留知情与选择权的机制，并系统纳入消费者参与式设计与监管；未来研究需扩展至多场景、真实临床纵向研究，并考察反复暴露于AI文档如何重塑信任与医患关系。

Abstract: AI applications are increasingly being introduced into digital health.
