However, these methods require storing independent parameters for each task, resulting in prohibitive storage overhead. To address this issue, we first experimentally demonstrate that the fine-tuned weight increments (referred to as task vectors) exhibit an impulse-like activation pattern and high robustness to low-bit representations. Driven by this insight, we propose T-Switch, which decomposes task vectors into three compact components: a binary sparse mask, a sign vector, and a scalar scaling factor, achieving high-fidelity approximation at high compression ratios. We then introduce Auto-Switch, a training-free merging scheme that automatically composes task vectors via feature similarity retrieval. Building on this, we develop Auto-Switch, a training-free merging scheme that automatically assembles task vectors through feature similarity retrieval. Furthermore, to transform task vector sparsification and quantization from static rules to adaptive learning, we propose FlexSwitch, a learnable framework which jointly optimizes the compression strategy for each model unit via Learnable Gating Sparsification (LGS) and Bit-width Adaptive Selection (BAS), while employing the Sparsity-Aware Storage Strategy (SASS) to select the optimal storage encoding structure. Finally, by incorporating a K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) inference scheme with a learnable low-rank metric, we present Auto-FlexSwitch, a dynamic model merging approach that supports highly efficient task vector compression.

</details>


### [273] [Do Sparse Autoencoders Capture Concept Manifolds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28119)
*Usha Bhalla,Thomas Fel,Can Rager,Sheridan Feucht,Tal Haklay,Daniel Wurgaft,Siddharth Boppana,Matthew Kowal,Vasudev Shyam,Jack Merullo,Atticus Geiger,Ekdeep Singh Lubana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper develops a theoretical framework addressing how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can capture low-dimensional manifolds in neural network representations. It identifies two mechanisms—global atom grouping and local feature tiling—and empirically discovers that SAEs operate suboptimally in a "dilution" regime, motivating post-hoc methods for finding coherent atom groups rather than isolated directions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to extract interpretable features, assuming concepts correspond to independent linear directions. However, evidence shows many concepts are organized along low-dimensional manifolds encoding continuous geometric relationships. This raises fundamental questions about when and how SAEs capture manifold structures.

Method: Theoretical framework development and empirical evaluation of how SAEs capture manifolds in two modes: (1) global mode - allocating a compact group of atoms whose linear span contains the entire manifold; (2) local mode - distributing across features that each selectively tile restricted regions of the geometry.

Result: Empirical findings reveal that SAEs suboptimally recover continuous structures, mixing global subspace and local tiling solutions in a fragmented "dilution" regime. This explains why manifold structure is rarely visible at the level of individual concepts.

Conclusion: SAEs operate in a suboptimal "dilution" regime when recovering continuous structures; post-hoc unsupervised methods discovering coherent atom groups are needed; future representation learning should treat geometric objects, not individual directions, as the basic units of interpretability.

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to extract interpretable features from neural network representations, often under the implicit assumption that concepts correspond to independent linear directions. However, a growing body of evidence suggests that many concepts are instead organized along low-dimensional manifolds encoding continuous geometric relationships. This raises three basic questions: what does it mean for an SAE to capture a manifold, when do existing SAE architectures do so, and how? We develop a theoretical framework that answers these questions and show that SAEs can capture manifolds in two fundamentally different ways: globally, by allocating a compact group of atoms whose linear span contains the entire manifold, or locally, by distributing it across features that each selectively tile a restricted region of the underlying geometry. Empirically, we find that SAEs suboptimally recover continuous structures, mixing the global subspace and local tiling solutions in a fragmented regime we call dilution. This explains why manifold structure is rarely visible at the level of individual concepts and motivates post-hoc unsupervised discovery methods that search for coherent groups of atoms rather than isolated directions. More broadly, our results suggest that future representation learning methods should treat geometric objects, not just individual directions, as the basic units of interpretability.

</details>


### [274] [Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28144)
*Florian Wolf,Ilyas Fatkhullin,Niao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对约束条件下的最大熵探索问题，提出了一种名为Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP)的单循环策略空间方法。该方法利用二次惩罚正则化处理凸占用度量约束，通过构造伪奖励利用策略梯度定理，在隐藏凸性和强对偶性的框架下，证明了全局收敛性，能够在非凸条件下实现ε-最优约束熵值和有界约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究源于实际应用中强化学习探索面临的约束挑战。最大熵探索虽已被较好理解，但真实场景通常存在安全、资源或模仿等约束条件。这一约束问题尤其具有挑战性，因为熵最大化缺乏加性结构，导致基于Bellman方程的方法不适用。此外，可扩展方法需要策略参数化，但这会在目标和约束中引入非凸性。现有唯一的无模型策略梯度方法（Ying et al., 2025）仅能保证弱遗憾和遍历平均，无法保证输出单一的、可部署的近优近可行策略。

Method: 本文提出Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP)方法，这是一种单循环策略空间方法。该方法通过二次惩罚正则化来强制执行凸的占用度量约束。PGP构建伪奖励来获得惩罚目标的梯度估计，进而利用经典的策略梯度定理。此外，作者建立了惩罚目标的正则性条件，提供了收敛性分析所需的光滑性性质。

Result: 理论分析表明，PGP能够实现全局最新迭代（last-iterate）收敛，在策略诱导的非凸性条件下，仍能达到ε-最优的约束熵值，同时保持ε有界的约束违反。实验方面，PGP在grid-world基准测试上通过消融实验验证了各组件的必要性，并在两个具有挑战性的连续控制任务上展示了良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 实验验证表明，PGP在grid-world基准测试中通过消融实验证明了各组件的有效性，并在两个连续控制任务上展示了可扩展性。这项工作为约束探索提供了一个理论完备且实际可行的解决方案。总体而言，该研究在约束强化学习探索领域取得了重要进展，特别是在处理实际应用中普遍存在的安全、资源和模仿约束方面具有显著价值。

Abstract: Efficient exploration is a central problem in reinforcement learning and is often formalized as maximizing the entropy of the state-action occupancy measure. While unconstrained maximum-entropy exploration is relatively well understood, real-world exploration is often constrained by safety, resource, or imitation requirements. This constrained setting is particularly challenging because entropy maximization lacks additive structure, rendering Bellman-equation-based methods inapplicable. Moreover, scalable approaches require policy parameterization, inducing non-convexity in both the objective and the constraints. To our knowledge, the only prior model-free policy-gradient approach for this setting under general policy parameterization is due to Ying et al. (2025). Unfortunately, their guarantees are limited to weak regret and ergodic averages, which do not imply that the final output is a single deployable policy that is near-optimal and nearly feasible. In this work we take a different approach to this problem, and propose Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP) method, a single-loop policy-space method that enforces general convex occupancy-measure constraints via quadratic-penalty regularization. PGP constructs pseudo-rewards that yield gradient estimates of the penalized objective, subsequently exploiting the classical Policy Gradient Theorem. We further establish the regularity of the penalized objective, providing the smoothness properties needed to justify the convergence of PGP. Leveraging hidden convexity and strong duality, we then establish global last-iterate convergence guarantees, attaining an $ε$-optimal constrained entropy value with $ε$ bounded constraint violation despite policy-induced non-convexity. We validate PGP through ablations on a grid-world benchmark and further demonstrate scalability on two challenging continuous-control tasks.

</details>


### [275] [Explainable Load Forecasting with Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28149)
*Matthias Hertel,Alexandra Nikoltchovska,Sebastian Pütz,Ralf Mikut,Benjamin Schäfer,Veit Hagenmeyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向协变量感知时间序列基础模型（Chronos-2、TabPFN-TS）的高效 SHAP 计算算法，通过时间维度与协变量维度的掩码策略，无需背景数据采样即可精确计算 SHAP 值；在德国 TransnetBW 电网日-ahead 负荷预测任务中，两种 TSFM 零样本精度可与用多年数据从头训练的 Transformer 竞争，且解释结果与电力领域先验知识一致，证明 TSFMs 可作为关键基础设施中透明可用的预测工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）已在能源系统中展现出通用预测潜力，但作为黑箱模型难以满足电网等关键基础设施对透明性、可信度与可解释性的要求（如 EU AI Act 等监管框架要求）。现有后验解释方法中，SHAP 理论性强、模型无关，但计算代价高昂：精确计算需遍历 2^n 个特征联盟，采样近似又引入方差且需数千次前向评估；TimeSHAP、WindowSHAP、ShapTime、SHAPformer 等改进要么仍依赖背景数据采样，要么绑定特定架构，难以迁移到通用 TSFM。已有对 TSFM 可解释性的探索（Pandey 等 2025、Boileau 等 2025、Rundel 等 2024）要么聚焦模型内部行为、要么关注静态表格任务，未覆盖真实负荷预测中同时涉及时间依赖与协变量效用的场景。

Method: 1) 提出面向 TSFM 的高效 SHAP 算法：利用 TSFM 对输入上下文长度与协变量集合的灵活性，将特征分组为 4 个时间组（最后一天 -24~-1、短期 -168~-25、中期 -672~-169、长期 <-672）与 |Z| 个协变量组（节假日、温度、辐照度），共 N=7 组，只需评估 2^7=128 个联盟即可精确求解 SHAP，避免了背景数据采样。2) 架构特定掩码：Chronos-2 通过缩短上下文长度或置 NaN（内部以零填充并用特殊 token 区分缺失与真实零值）实现时间掩码，TabPFN-TS 因目标变量不支持缺失值而直接丢弃对应行；两者均通过整体移除协变量实现协变量掩码，全掩码时以过去 48 周（Chronos-2 最大输入长度）平均负荷作为基线预测。3) 实验设置：数据为 ENTSO-E 平台 TransnetBW 2015.01–2025.09 小时级负荷，辅以 ERA5 再分析（DE1 区域）的太阳辐照度与气温及节假日指示变量；2024.10–2025.09 为测试集、2023.10–2024.09 为验证集、更早数据训练从零训练的 Transformer；评价指标为 MAE/RMSE/MAPE。4) 对比对象包括基线（去年同日负荷）、1 年与 8.75 年数据训练的 Transformer，以及 Chronos-2 与 TabPFN-TS 的单变量与协变量感知设置（TabPFN-TS 采用归一化目标与 Box-Cox 变换目标的双模型集成，并构造运行索引、循环日历特征与自动季节特征）。

Result: 精度：所有模型均优于基线（MAE 325.9 MW）。Chronos-2 协变量版本 MAE 156.2 MW、RMSE 229.1 MW、MAPE 2.44%；TabPFN-TS MAE 163.2 MW、RMSE 250.5 MW、MAPE 2.55%；8.75 年数据 Transformer 最优（MAE 150.2 MW），但仅小幅领先；相比 1 年数据 Transformer，两者 MAE 分别降低 26.8% 与 23.5%。加入协变量使 Chronos-2 与 TabPFN-TS 的 MAE 分别改善 27.0% 与 31.5%。TabPFN-TS 需至少两周上下文才超过基线，Chronos-2 一周即可；两者均从更长上下文获益。运行时间：Transformer 训练 19.2 min、预测 65.6 ms；Chronos-2 预测 65.6 ms、单次完整解释约 5 s；TabPFN-TS 预测 5.5 s、解释约 367 s。解释结果：历史负荷占绝对 SHAP 值的 89%（Chronos-2）/87%（TabPFN-TS）；协变量重要性排序两模型一致（节假日 > 气温 > 辐照度）；依赖图显示节假日降低负荷、节后恢复时升高负荷；气温低于 15 °C 时温度升高使预测下降（电采暖）、降低则升高；辐照度差呈近线性关系，辐照度下降（光伏出力下降）时净负荷上升。局部解释显示模型在长周末后恢复日仍存在低估；两模型在公共假日附近（如 10 月 4 日、12 月 23 日、1 月 7 日、6 月 20/23 日）表现不佳。

Conclusion: TSFM 兼具精度与可用性：零样本 Chronos-2 与 TabPFN-TS 在负荷预测上与针对领域数据从头训练的 Transformer 相当，且无需训练数据与训练算力，在数据稀缺场景尤具价值；配合所提出的高效 SHAP 适配方法，可生成精确（约 5 s/次，Chronos-2）的方向性归因解释，且解释与负荷—气温反向依赖、日历效应、节后反弹等既有领域知识一致，说明模型真正利用了协变量，因此 TSFM 可满足关键基础设施对准确性与可解释性的双重要求。未来方向：将方法推广至低压负荷、电价与可再生出力预测及更多 TSFM；用联盟子集采样替代穷举 2^N 以支持更细粒度的时间分组并加速 TabPFN-TS；扩展到概率预测与不确定性量化；分析微调对特征归因模式的影响。数据与代码开源于 github.com/KIT-IAI/SHAP4TSFMs。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have recently emerged as general-purpose forecasting models and show considerable potential for applications in energy systems. However, applications in critical infrastructure like power grids require transparency to ensure trust and reliability and cannot rely on pure black-box models. To enhance the transparency of TSFMs, we propose an efficient algorithm for computing Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) tailored to these models. The proposed approach leverages the flexibility of TSFMs with respect to input context length and provided covariates. This property enables efficient temporal and covariate masking (selectively withholding inputs), allowing for a scalable explanation of model predictions using SHAP. We evaluate two TSFMs - Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS - on a day-ahead load forecasting task for a transmission system operator (TSO). In a zero-shot setting, both models achieve predictive performance competitive with a Transformer model trained specifically on multiple years of TSO data. The explanations obtained through our proposed approach align with established domain knowledge, particularly as the TSFMs appropriately use weather and calendar information for load prediction. Overall, we demonstrate that TSFMs can serve as transparent and reliable tools for operational energy forecasting.

</details>


### [276] [Strait: Perceiving Priority and Interference in ML Inference Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28175)
*Haidong Zhao,Nikolaos Georgantas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Strait是一个面向高GPU利用率场景的DNN推理服务系统，通过自适应延迟预测模型和优先级感知调度策略，在保证低优先级任务公平性的前提下，显著提升高优先级任务的截止时间满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习推理服务系统在处理双优先级推理流量时存在局限：高GPU利用率场景下，对任务优先级的支持不足，且在并发执行条件下缺乏准确的延迟估计能力。

Method: Strait通过建模数据传输阶段的潜在争用，并利用自适应预测模型考虑内核执行干扰，以此改善延迟估计；基于预测结果执行优先级感知调度，实现差异化的请求处理。

Result: Strait在高负载工作条件下，将高优先级任务的截止时间违反率降低了1.02至11.18个百分点，同时对低优先级任务产生可接受的性能开销；相比软件定义的抢占方法，Strait展现出更公平的性能表现。

Conclusion: Strait通过优先级感知调度和自适应延迟预测模型，有效提升了高优先级任务的截止时间满足率，同时保持了对低优先级任务的公平性，在高GPU利用率场景下表现出优于软件定义抢占方案的性能。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) inference serving systems host deep neural network (DNN) models and schedule incoming inference requests across deployed GPUs. However, limited support for task prioritization and insufficient latency estimation under concurrent execution may restrict their applicability in on-premises scenarios. We present \emph{Strait}, a serving system designed to enhance deadline satisfaction for dual-priority inference traffic under high GPU utilization. To improve latency estimation, Strait models potential contention during data transfer and accounts for kernel execution interference through an adaptive prediction model. By drawing on these predictions, it performs priority-aware scheduling to deliver differentiated handling. Evaluation results under intense workloads suggest that Strait reduces deadline violations for high-priority tasks by 1.02 to 11.18 percentage points while incurring acceptable costs on low-priority tasks. Compared to software-defined preemption approaches, Strait also exhibits more equitable performance.

</details>


### [277] [An adaptive wavelet-based PINN for problems with localized high-magnitude source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28180)
*Himanshu Pandey,Ratikanta Behera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对"局部高幅值源项"导致的极端损失失衡（最高达10^10:1），本文提出自适应小波PINN（AW-PINN）：先以固定小波基做短时预训练并按相似度筛选"物理相关"的小波族，再把尺度与平移参数化为可训练量做自适应细化，解析求导免用自动微分，从而在避免全域高分辨率基铺开（省内存）的同时，显著优于基线PINN、W-PINN与MMPINN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN存在两个根本缺陷：神经网络的谱偏置（优先学习低频成分）以及多尺度现象引发的损失项量级失衡。当PDE含局部高幅值源项（如焊接/热处理中的局域热源、非均匀介质中的电磁传播、点电荷源、冲击力学、局部强迫流动）时，残差损失可比边界/初值损失大10个数量级（如瞬态热传导L_b:L_i:L_r=1:10:10^9，Poisson问题L_b:L_r=10^4:10^11），优化器只顾压低主导项而牺牲其余项，导致解无法同时刻画细节。现有补救各有不足：SA-PINN需可训练权重与掩码机制；MMPINN对各损失项做幂次正则化，需问题相关的整数指数p,q且训练代价高（可达数小时）；W-PINN在物理空间的谱方法思路有效，但对极高尺度特征需构造全域高分辨率小波矩阵，基函数数量指数增长、内存与优化代价大。作者由此动机：在保留W-PINN"小波空间学习+解析求导"优势的同时，让小波族本身自适应、按需加密。

Method: 框架分两阶段。阶段一（预训练与族选择）：按W-PINN构造固定多分辨率张量积小波族集合I（含尺度j与平移k的可分离基Ψ_{j,k}），用损失(2)（ω_r·L_res+ω_s·L_sup）预训练；对每个族i计算其诱导的残差响应向量R_i=P[c_iΨ_i]与边界响应向量B_i=B[c_iΨ_i]，以相似度Score_i^R=⟨R_i,f⟩/|⟨R_i,f⟩|_max、Score_i^B=⟨B_i,g⟩/|⟨B_i,g⟩|_max（源项恒零时改用归一化响应向量均值）判定物理相关性，并纳入系数幅值|c_i|最大的top-κ族，得到活跃族I_A。阶段二（自适应）：将每个选中族写成参数化小波单元W_i(x;θ_i)=∏_n ψ(w_{i,n}x_n+b_{i,n})，初值w=2^j、b=−k，尺度与平移成为可训练参数，与可训练线性系数c_i及偏置B组成网络û_Aψ=Σ c_i W_i+B；损失函数所需导数由基函数解析求导给出（不依赖自动微分），先ADAM后L-BFGS优化。理论方面：定理3.1证明在B=0、参数与系数独立同分布高斯初始化下，N_A→∞时û在有限维分布上收敛到零均值高斯过程，核K(x,x')=σ_c²E_θ[W(x;θ)W(x';θ)]；并由梯度分解导出NTK结构K=K_c+K_θ（分别来自线性系数与自适应参数）。实验采用一阶高斯小波（Gaussian wavelet）、Xavier初始化、相对L2误差指标，多次独立重复取平均，PyTorch 2.6.0+CU12.4/RTX A6000。

Result: 四类含局部高幅值源项的PDE上AW-PINN一致优于同类方法：①瞬态热传导（ε=0.10/0.11/0.12）：相对L2误差3.52e-6/8.15e-6/8.86e-6，优于W-PINN（4.05e-5、3.11e-5、3.10e-5）、MMPINN（1.71e-5、2.44e-5、8.46e-1）与基线PINN（8.1e-1~9.6e-1）；训练时间约24–25 min，远低于MMPINN的91–208 min，且无需随ε减小而增加配点；损失曲线方差小、误差曲线非振荡、收敛更快更稳定。②二维高局域Poisson（ε=0.05/0.02）：3.42e-5、2.68e-4，较MMPINN与W-PINN低1–2个量级（ε=0.02时W-PINN 9.81e-3、MMPINN 3.25e-3）；尺度自适应曲线显示仅在所需区域提升分辨率而非全域铺开高分辨率基。③强振荡源流动方程（A=100, T_s=0.05）：5.17e-4，优于W-PINN 1.27e-2与MMPINN 8.35e-2。④TEz形式Maxwell方程点电荷源：E_x 5.31e-3、E_y 6.54e-3、H_z 9.01e-3，较W-PINN/MMPINN（E_x 8.52e-2/4.33e-2，H_z 4.52e-1/2.31e-1）高一个量级，训练76.57 min vs MMPINN 182.16 min；W-PINN与MMPINN在该问题上均无法令人满意地收敛。

Conclusion: AW-PINN通过"预训练筛选物理相关小波族 + 尺度/平移自适应细化"的机制，在不将高分辨率基铺满全域的前提下捕捉局部细尺度特征，摆脱对自动微分的依赖并显著加速训练，在极端损失失衡（高达10^10:1）问题上取得同类方法中最佳的精度与有竞争力的训练时间；其无限族极限下具高斯过程极限，NTK可分解为系数项与自适应参数项，可用于训练动力学分析。局限与展望：基于相似度的族选择仍需部分人工调参（阈值IC/BC/PDE与top-κ%），且依赖预训练质量，需更自动化的选择方案；尚需系统比较不同小波基的影响，并在更广泛的多尺度问题上检验其通用性与性能。

Abstract: In recent years, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have gained significant attention for solving differential equations, although they suffer from two fundamental limitations, namely, spectral bias inherent in neural networks and loss imbalance arising from multiscale phenomena. This paper proposes an adaptive wavelet-based PINN (AW-PINN) to address the extreme loss imbalance characteristic of problems with localized high-magnitude source terms. Such problems frequently arise in various physical applications, such as thermal processing, electro-magnetics, impact mechanics, and fluid dynamics involving localized forcing. The proposed framework dynamically adjusts the wavelet basis function based on residual and supervised loss. This adaptive nature makes AW-PINN handle problems with high-scale features effectively without being memory-intensive. Additionally, AW-PINN does not rely on automatic differentiation to obtain derivatives involved in the loss function, which accelerates the training process. The method operates in two stages, an initial short pre-training phase with fixed bases to select physically relevant wavelet families, followed by an adaptive refinement that adapts scales and translations without populating high-resolution bases across entire domains. Theoretically, we show that under certain assumptions, AW-PINN admits a Gaussian process limit and derive its associated NTK structure. We evaluate AW-PINN on several challenging PDEs featuring localized high-magnitude source terms with extreme loss imbalances having ratios up to $10^{10}:1$. Across these PDEs, including transient heat conduction, highly localized Poisson problems, oscillatory flow equations, and Maxwell equations with a point charge source, AW-PINN consistently outperforms existing methods in its class.

</details>

### [278] [A Randomized Controlled Trial and Pilot of Scout: an LLM-Based EHR Search and Synthesis Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26953)
*Michael Gao,Suresh Balu,William Knechtle,Kartik Pejavara,William Jeck,Matthew Ellis,Jason Thieling,Blake Cameron,Jason Tatreau,Tareq Aljurf,Henry Foote,Michael Revoir,Marshall Nichols,Matthew Gardner,William Ratliff,Bradley Hintze,Angelo Milazzo,Sreekanth Vemulapalli*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究开发并验证了LLM驱动的EHR搜索平台Scout，通过随机对照试验证明其可将临床任务完成时间缩短约38%，同时维持输出质量，并在超过200名用户的试点中展示了广泛的应用场景。研究还强调了人类验证在评估AI输出中的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）中的临床文档和数据检索对临床医生造成显著的工作负担和职业倦怠，亟需解决方案。

Method: 开发了基于LLM的EHR搜索与综合平台Scout，采用自然语言查询并提供原文引用。进行前瞻性随机、评估者盲法的交叉试验，纳入7个临床专科的20名参与者完成200个结构化病例。同时进行超过200名用户、20余个专科的试点部署（3个月，6600+次交互）。

Result: Scout使任务完成时间减少37.6%，显著降低感知工作量（精神需求、努力程度、时间需求降幅最大）。非劣效性分析表明，Scout辅助任务在准确性、完整性和相关性方面与仅使用EHR相当。自动化评估的错误率较低，但人工复核显示许多被标记为错误的声明实际上在病历中有支持证据。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的EHR工具（如Scout）可以在保持输出质量的同时显著减轻临床和行政工作负担。研究强调了人类验证的重要性，因为自动化评估可能存在误判。

Abstract: Clinical documentation and data retrieval within Electronic Health Records (EHRs) contribute substantially to clinician workload and burnout. To address this, we developed Scout, an LLM-based EHR search and synthesis platform that enables clinicians to query EHR data using natural language. Each response includes citations linking each claim to the original data source, facilitating easy verification of generated content. We conducted a prospective randomized, evaluator-blinded crossover trial across seven clinical specialties (20 participants, 200 structured cases). Participants completed realistic clinical tasks using either Scout or the EHR alone, with outcomes including time to completion, NASA Task Load Index workload scores, and blinded expert adjudication of accuracy, completeness, and relevance. Scout reduced task completion time by 37.6% and significantly decreased perceived workload, with the largest reductions in mental demand, effort, and temporal demand. Non-inferiority analyses showed that tasks completed with Scout maintained accuracy, completeness, and relevance relative to tasks completed with the EHR-only. A concurrent pilot deployment across over 200 users and more than 20 specialties generated over 6,600 interactions in three months, revealing diverse clinical and administrative use cases. Automated evaluation using an LLM-as-judge framework identified errors at low rates. Subsequent manual review of a subset of outputs revealed that most claims flagged by the automated judge as errors were in fact supported by the patient chart, demonstrating the importance of human validation. These findings provide early trial-based evidence that LLM-powered EHR tools can meaningfully reduce clinical and administrative workloads while maintaining output quality.

</details>


### [279] [AgenticRecTune: Multi-Agent with Self-Evolving Skillhub for Recommendation System Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26969)
*Xidong Wu,Yue Zhuan,Ruoqiao Wei,Hangxin Chen,Di Bai,Jintao Liu,Xinyi Wang,Xue Wang,Luoshu Wang,Xinwu Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: AgenticRecTune是一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，通过五个专业智能体（Actor、Critic、Insight、Skill、Online）协作，实现推荐系统多阶段配置的全自动优化，并引入可自我进化的Skillhub进行知识积累，解决传统配置调优中迭代成本高、领域知识分散、指标平衡困难等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推荐系统采用多阶段pipeline（预排序、排序、重排序），现有研究仅关注单模型优化，忽视了系统级配置优化的重要性。配置优化面临三大挑战：模型修改后需重新寻找最优配置导致迭代成本高、多阶段模型优化目标各异需领域专业知识、以及多在线指标的平衡与业务目标对齐困难。

Method: 采用多智能体框架（Actor、Critic、Insight、Skill、Online五个专业智能体），利用LLM（Gemini）的强大推理能力探索最优配置空间，通过Skillhub实现自我进化和知识积累。

Result: 提出了一个完整的多智能体协作框架，能够自主完成配置优化全流程，包括候选生成、过滤、A/B测试执行和结果分析。

Conclusion: AgenticRecTune通过多智能体协作实现了推荐系统配置的端到端自动化优化，显著降低了人工调参成本，并通过Skillhub实现了知识的持续积累和任务迁移。

Abstract: Modern large-scale recommendation systems are typically constructed as multi-stage pipelines, encompassing pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking phases. While traditional recommendation research typically focuses on optimizing a specific model, such as improving the pre-ranking model structure or ranking models training algorithm, system-level configurations optimization play a crucial role, which integrates the output from each model head to get the final score in each stage. Due to the complexity of the system, the configuration optimization is highly important and challenging. Any model modification requires new optimal system-level configurations. But each experimental iteration requires significant tuning effort. Furthermore, models in different stage operates within a distinct context and optimizes for different targets, requiring specialized domain expertise. In addition, optimization success depends on balancing competing multiple online metrics and alignment with shifting production development objectives. To address these challenges, we propose AgenticRecTune, an agentic framework comprising five specialized agents, Actor, Critic, Insight, Skill, and Online, designed to manage the end-to-end configuration optimization workflow. By leveraging the advanced reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically Gemini, AgenticRecTune explore the optimal configuration spaces. The Actor Agent proposes multiple candidates and Critic Agent filters out suboptimal proposals.Then Online Agent autonomously prepares A/B tests based on the proposed configurations set from the Critic Agent and captures the subsequencet experimental results. We also introduce a self-evolving Skillhub, which utilizes a collaboration between the Insight Agent and Skill Agent to summarize the history results, extract underlying mechanics of each task in recommendation system and update skills.

</details>


### [280] [Not All Memories Age the Same: Autodiscovery of Adaptive Decay in Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26970)
*Mandar Karhade*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出用速度-波动率参数化的连续衰减曲面替代知识图谱中的统一衰减模型，通过生存分析自动学习领域级、上下文级和实体级三层遗忘参数，实验验证了该分层方法能有效捕捉不同知识类型的时序动态差异，性能显著优于统一衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识图谱检索系统将所有事实视为同等时效，但不同类型知识表现出不同的时序动态特性，统一衰减模型（单一遗忘曲线）存在根本性错误设定。

Method: 提出分层框架，核心是以速度（观测频率）和波动率（观测值间嵌入距离）两个正交信号参数化连续衰减曲面；采用生存分析方法建模边生命周期，事件为值替代而非简单重观测；框架包含领域级、上下文级和实体级三个可学习层级。

Result: 合成数据实验成功恢复植入的分层参数（HDBSCAN ARI=1.0）；107篇维基百科文章和1163条患者记录的验证表明速度-波动率聚类自然涌现并与可观察的持久性模式对齐，近乎普遍呈现Lindy效应（Weibull形状参数k<1）；均匀衰减性能比无时序加权差18倍。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一个可学习的分层遗忘框架，通过生存分析从数据中自动学习不同知识类型的时序动态，无需预定义分类体系。实验验证了方法的有效性，均质衰减相比无时序加权差18倍，分层方法在各层级均有可测量的改进。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs used for retrieval treat all facts as equally current. Existing temporal approaches apply uniform decay, using a single forgetting curve regardless of knowledge type. We show this is fundamentally misspecified: different knowledge types exhibit different temporal dynamics, and the core retrieval problem is not latency or throughput but identifying what is important at query time.
  We propose a hierarchical framework that replaces uniform decay with a continuous decay surface parameterized by two orthogonal signals: velocity (how frequently a concept is observed) and volatility (how much the value changes between observations, measured via embedding distance). The decay surface is decomposed into three learnable levels: domain-level parameters capture universal patterns (some predicates are inherently permanent, others inherently transient), context-level parameters capture setting-dependent variation, and entity-level adaptation personalizes decay to specific subjects. All parameters emerge from data through survival analysis on observed value lifetimes, requiring no predefined taxonomies or domain expertise.
  We formulate edge lifetime as a survival problem where the event is value supersession (a meaningfully different value replacing the current one), distinct from mere re-observation. Experiments on synthetic temporal knowledge graphs demonstrate recovery of planted hierarchical parameters (HDBSCAN ARI = 1.0).
  Validation on 107 Wikipedia articles and 1,163 patient records from the Synthea clinical EHR simulator shows that velocity-volatility clusters emerge naturally, align with observable persistence patterns, and near-universally exhibit the Lindy effect (Weibull shape k < 1). Uniform decay performs 18x worse than no temporal weighting. Heterogeneous decay recovers from this, with each hierarchy level contributing measurable improvement.

</details>


### [281] [T2S-Metrics: Unified Library for Evaluating SPARQL Queries Generated From Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26971)
*Yousouf Taghzouti,Tao Jiang,Camille Juigné,Benjamin Navet,Fabien Gandon,Franck Michel,Louis-Felix Nothias*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了t2s-metrics，一个用于SPARQL查询比较和执行评估的开源统一评估库，提供20多种涵盖词法、句法、语义、结构、执行和排序等维度的评估指标，旨在解决知识图谱问答系统评估中的碎片化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前知识图谱问答系统的评估存在碎片化、不一致和可复现性有限等问题。现有基准测试主要关注查询精确匹配或答案级F1分数，忽视了句法有效性、语义忠实性、执行正确性、结果排序质量和计算效率等重要维度。

Method: 提出了t2s-metrics，一个开源、可扩展的统一评估库，专门用于SPARQL查询比较和基于执行的评估。该库提供20多种评估指标，涵盖词法、句法、语义、结构、基于执行和基于排序的维度，包括Token级P/R/F1、BLEU、ROUGE、METEOR、CodeBLEU变体、变量归一化指标(SP-BLEU, SP-F1)、基于图和URI的精确匹配指标、答案集指标(F1-QALD, Jaccard)、排序指标(MRR, NDCG, P@k, Hit@k)及LLM-as-a-Judge指标。采用模块化抽象层设计，将指标规范与实现解耦。

Result: 该库提供了超过20种可扩展的评估指标，涵盖多个维度，能够实现SPARQL问答系统的一致、透明和可复现评估。

Conclusion: t2s-metrics represents a necessary step toward systematic, standardized evaluation of SPARQL-based QA systems, facilitating deeper diagnostic insights into system behavior beyond simple answer correctness.

Abstract: The evaluation of Question Answering (QA) systems over Knowledge Graphs has historically suffered from fragmentation, inconsistency, and limited reproducibility. While significant progress has been made in semantic parsing and SPARQL query generation, evaluation methodologies remain diverse, ad hoc, and often incomparable across studies. Existing benchmarks typically focus on a small subset of metrics, such as query exact match or answer-level F1, neglecting syntactic validity, semantic faithfulness, execution correctness, results ranking quality, and computational efficiency. In this paper, we present t2s-metrics, an open-source, extensible, and unified evaluation library designed specifically for SPARQL query comparison and execution-based assessment. t2s-metrics provides a broad and extensible set of over 20 evaluation metrics, collected from the literature and practical evaluation needs, spanning lexical, syntactic, semantic, structural, execution-based and ranking-based dimensions. These include query-based metrics such as token-level Precision, Recall, and F1; BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and CodeBLEU variants; variable-normalized metrics (SP-BLEU, SP-F1); graph-and URI-based exact match metrics; as well as answer set-based metrics such as F1-QALD and Jaccard similarity; ranking metrics including MRR, NDCG, P@k, and Hit@k; and LLM-as-a-Judge metrics. Taking inspiration from the ir-metrics library for Information Retrieval, t2s-metrics provides a modular abstraction layer that decouples metric specification from implementation, enabling consistent, transparent, and reproducible evaluation of SPARQLbased QA systems. We argue that t2s-metrics constitutes a necessary step toward systematic, standardized evaluation in question answering over knowledge graphs and facilitates deeper diagnostic insights into system behavior beyond answer correctness.

</details>


### [282] [Budget-Constrained Online Retrieval-Augmented Generation: The Chunk-as-a-Service Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26981)
*Shawqi Al-Maliki,Ammar Gharaibeh,Mohamed Rahouti,Mohammad Ruhul Amin,Mohamed Abdallah,Junaid Qadir,Ala Al-Fuqaha*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对RAG-as-a-Service (RaaS)中基于提示数量的不透明定价问题，提出Chunk-as-a-Service (CaaS)作为透明且具成本效益的替代方案，包含Open-Budget CaaS和Limited-Budget CaaS两种变体，通过UCOSA算法在线选择相关文本块来丰富提示。实验表明UCOSA相比随机选择提升约52%，达离线方法的75%性能；LB-CaaS和OB-CaaS的成本效益分别比RaaS高出140%和86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM存在幻觉和缺乏可解释性问题，RAG虽可缓解但RaaS定价模式不透明——按提示数量计费而非考虑检索文本块的相关性或质量，导致用户成本效益低下且付费模式不透明。

Method: 提出Chunk-as-a-Service (CaaS)框架，包含两种变体：(1) Open-Budget CaaS (OB-CaaS)：无预算约束地丰富提示；(2) Limited-Budget CaaS (LB-CaaS)：在预算约束下进行效用-成本权衡的在线选择。核心算法UCOSA通过在线方式，根据预算限制和效用-成本权衡，选择性地对提交提示的子集进行文本块丰富。

Result: 在NEP×AR指标上，UCOSA相比随机选择提升约52%，达离线方法的75%性能；在预算利用率方面，LB-CaaS和OB-CaaS相比RaaS分别提升140%和86%的性能-预算比。

Conclusion: CaaS框架及其UCOSA算法能有效提升检索增强生成的透明度和成本效益，在有限预算约束下仍能保持较高的性能表现，优于传统RaaS模式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized the field of natural language processing. However, they exhibit some limitations, including a lack of reliability and transparency: they may hallucinate and fail to provide sources that support the generated output. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) was introduced to address such limitations in LLMs. One popular implementation, RAG-as-a-Service (RaaS), has shortcomings that hinder its adoption and accessibility. For instance, RaaS pricing is based on the number of submitted prompts, without considering whether the prompts are enriched by relevant chunks, i.e., text segments retrieved from a vector database, or the quality of the utilized chunks (i.e., their degree of relevance). This results in an opaque and less cost-effective payment model. We propose Chunk-as-a-Service (CaaS) as a transparent and cost-effective alternative. CaaS includes two variants: Open-Budget CaaS (OB-CaaS) and Limited-Budget CaaS (LB-CaaS), which is enabled by our ``Utility-Cost Online Selection Algorithm (UCOSA)''. UCOSA further extends the cost-effectiveness and the accessibility of the OB-CaaS variant by enriching, in an online manner, a subset of the submitted prompts based on budget constraints and utility-cost tradeoff. Our experiments demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed UCOSA compared to both offline and relevance-greedy selection baselines. In terms of the performance metric-the number of enriched prompts (NEP) multiplied by the Average Relevance (AR)-UCOSA outperforms random selection by approximately 52% and achieves around 75% of the performance of offline selection methods. Additionally, in terms of budget utilization, LB-CaaS and OB-CaaS achieve higher performance-to-budget ratios of 140% and 86%, respectively, compared to RaaS, indicating their superior efficiency.

</details>


### [283] [Value-Aware Product Recommendation by Customer Segmentation using a suitable High-Dimensional Similarity Measure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26983)
*María Florencia Acosta,Rodrigo García Arancibia,Pamela Llop,Mariel Lovatto,Lucas Mansilla*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种价值感知的 product recommendation 方法，通过将收入贡献编码到用户-项目矩阵中，计算基于收入相似性的用户分段，提出三种盈利能力推荐策略，并验证了其在高维稀疏数据场景下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决用户-项目数据的高维性和稀疏性问题，同时显式考虑产品和用户对整体销售收入的贡献，以实现与盈利能力目标一致的推荐。

Method: 提出将收入贡献编码到用户-项目矩阵中，基于适当的距离度量直接计算客户相似性，根据购买篮子的收入相似性对用户进行细分，并提出三种基于收入份额、产品流行度和预期利润生成的推荐策略，同时比较了传统相似性度量与针对高维情境的新颖替代方案。

Result: 通过模拟实验和UCI在线零售数据集验证了方法的有效性，证明该方法能够支持盈利能力导向的推荐。

Conclusion: 该方法通过模拟实验和UCI在线零售数据集的真实应用得到验证，能够提供与盈利能力目标一致的推荐。

### 关键词：价值感知推荐、收入贡献、用户细分、高维稀疏数据、盈利能力优化

Abstract: This paper presents a novel value-aware approach to product recommendation that simultaneously addresses the high dimensionality and sparsity of user-item data while explicitly incorporating the contribution of each product and user to overall sales revenue. The proposed framework encodes revenue contributions in the user-item matrix and computes customer similarity directly on this basis using suitable distance measures. This enables the segmentation of users according to the revenue-based similarity of their purchase baskets and supports recommendations aligned with profitability objectives. We compare conventional similarity metrics with a novel alternative tailored to high-dimensional contexts and propose three recommendation strategies based on revenue share, product popularity, and expected profit generation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through simulation experiments and a real-world application using the UCI Online Retail dataset.

</details>


### [284] [LUCid: Redefining Relevance For Lifelong Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26996)
*Chimaobi Okite,Anika Misra,Joyce Chai,Rada Mihalcea*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LUCid基准揭示当前个性化系统在与用户查询语义距离较远时表现急剧恶化，表明现有系统对"相关性"的定义与实际情境需求存在根本性错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有终身个性化方法仅通过语义邻近性来操作化相关性概念，导致其遗漏来自主题不相关交互中的重要用户信息，存在显著的应用缺口。

Method: 构建LUCid基准，包含1,936个现实查询及来自多达500个会话的交互历史配对数据。基于该基准在多种架构模型上进行实验测试。

Result: 当相关上下文必须从语义遥远的的历史中检索时，性能显著下降：最难实例上的检索召回率降至接近零；Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5.4、Claude Haiku等最先进模型的响应对齐度也仅维持在约50%左右。

Conclusion: LUCid benchmark揭示了当前个性化系统与以用户为中心的情境相关性之间存在根本性不匹配，对系统在关键用户属性未被检测时的鲁棒性和安全性具有直接影响。该基准为系统性评估模型能否从历史交互中提取情境相关用户信息提供了方法支撑，是将个性化研究重新导向用户中心相关性方向的重要一步。

Abstract: Current approaches to lifelong personalization operationalize relevance through semantic proximity, causing them to miss essential user information from topically unrelated interactions. To address this gap, we introduce LUCid, a benchmark designed to measure situational user-centric relevance in personalization. The benchmark consists of 1,936 realistic queries paired with interaction histories from up to 500 sessions. Across multiple architectures, our experiments show significant performance collapse when relevant context must be surfaced from semantically distant history: retrieval recall drops to near zero on the hardest instances, and response alignment remains near 50% even for state-of-the-art models such as Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5.4, and Claude Haiku. These results expose a fundamental mismatch between the notion of relevance encoded by current systems and the situational relevance required for personalization, with direct implications for robustness and safety when critical user attributes remain undetected. LUCid enables the systematic evaluation of whether current models can surface situationally-relevant user information from previous interactions, and serves as a step toward realigning personalization with user-centered relevance.

</details>


### [285] [Hypencoder Revisited: Reproducibility and Analysis of Non-Linear Scoring for First-Stage Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27037)
*Arne Eichholtz,Yongkang Li,Jutte Vijverberg,Tobias Groot,Mohammad Aliannejadi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对Hypencoder检索框架进行了系统性复现与扩展评估。研究验证了该框架在标准检索任务上的有效性，同时揭示其在硬检索任务上的局限性，并发现标准双编码器在查询延迟上仍具优势，而替代编码器集成与对抗鲁棒性表现高度依赖具体配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对Killingback等人提出的Hypencoder检索框架进行系统性复现，并突破原始分析边界以全面评估其性能边界、实际部署效率及鲁棒性特性。

Method: 采用完全复现策略验证原始Hypencoder，并在三个方向进行扩展：(i) 集成替代预训练编码器；(ii) 与基于Faiss的双编码器管道进行查询延迟对比；(iii) 对抗鲁棒性评估。

Result: 复现结果支持Hypencoder在领域内和跨领域基准上优于双编码器基线，高效搜索算法显著降低延迟；硬检索任务上在DL-Hard和FollowIR领先但TREC TOT表现欠佳；替代编码器集成效果取决于编码器和微调策略；查询延迟方面标准双编码器仍更快；对抗鲁棒性上q-net非线性评分未显示持续劣势。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了Hypencoder的有效性，并通过三个扩展方向（替代编码器集成、延迟对比、对抗鲁棒性）深化了对其性能边界的理解。研究为Hypencoder框架的实用性和局限性提供了全面的实证依据。

Abstract: The Hypencoder, proposed by Killingback et al., is a retrieval framework that replaces the fixed inner-product scoring function used in standard bi-encoders with a query-specific neural network (the $q$-net), whose weights are generated by a hypernetwork from the contextualized query embeddings. This design enables more expressive relevance estimation while preserving independent query and document encoding. In this work, we conduct a reproducibility study of the Hypencoder and extend the original analysis in three directions. Our reproduction confirms that the Hypencoder outperforms a similarly trained bi-encoder baseline on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, and that the proposed efficient search algorithm substantially reduces query latency with minimal performance loss. On hard retrieval tasks, we find partial support: the Hypencoder outperforms the baseline on DL-Hard and FollowIR, but not on TREC TOT, where checkpoint incompatibility and fine-tuning sensitivity complicate full verification. Beyond reproduction, we investigate three extensions: (i)~integrating alternative pre-trained encoders into the Hypencoder framework, where we find that performance gains depend on the encoder and fine-tuning strategy; (ii)~comparing query latency against a Faiss-based bi-encoder pipeline, revealing that standard bi-encoder retrieval remains faster under both exhaustive and efficient search settings; and (iii)~evaluating adversarial robustness, where we find that the $q$-net's non-linear scoring does not provide a consistent robustness disadvantage over inner-product scoring. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/arneeichholtz/Hypencoder-reprod.

</details>


### [286] [A Gated Hybrid Contrastive Collaborative Filtering Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27117)
*Eduardo Ferreira da Silva,Mayki dos Santos Oliveira,Joel Machado Pires,Denis Dantas Boaventura,Maycon Maciel Peixoto,Cassio Serafim Prazeres,Gustavo Bittencourt Figueiredo,Miriam Capretz,Frederico Araujo Durão*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种门控混合协同过滤框架，通过自适应门控机制和对比学习将文本review信息融入自编码器协同过滤模型，并用成对BPR目标优化排名。实验证明受控语义融合对排名驱动推荐至关重要，在多个数据集上超越了先进基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数review-aware推荐模型针对评分预测进行优化，而非排名质量，这种不对齐限制了其在前N推荐场景（排名判别性至关重要）中的效果。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：（1）门控混合架构：将review-derived表示通过自适应门控机制逐层注入到基于自编码器的协同过滤模型中，动态平衡协同嵌入与基于主题的特征；（2）对比学习模块：对齐语义信号与协同信号以细化潜在空间；（3）训练目标：采用成对贝叶斯个性化排序（BPR）目标，明确优化排名行为，促进相关与非相关项目在潜在空间中的分离。在Amazon Movies & TV、IMDb和Rotten Tomatoes三个数据集上评估了五种配置变体。

Result: 在Hit Rate@10和NDCG@10指标上，该框架相比现有的review-aware基线模型取得了一致的改进。

Conclusion: 实验表明，受控的语义融合（controlled semantic fusion）对排名驱动的推荐任务至关重要。该框架通过结合自适应门控机制和对比学习目标，有效解决了传统review-aware模型在排名优化方面的不足，为top-N推荐场景提供了一种更有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Recommender systems increasingly incorporate textual reviews to enrich user and item representations. However, most review-aware models remain optimized for rating prediction rather than ranking quality. This misalignment limits their effectiveness in top-N recommendation scenarios, where discriminative ranking is essential. To address this gap, we propose a Gated Hybrid Collaborative Filtering framework that integrates review-derived representations into an autoencoder-based collaborative model. The architecture injects semantic signals layer-wise through an adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically balances collaborative embeddings and topic-based features during encoding. To further refine the latent space, we introduce a contrastive learning module that aligns semantic and collaborative signals. We evaluate the framework across five distinct configurations: Pure collaborative; Topic and Gated; Text and Gated; and the addition of contrastive objectives (Contrastive and Topic, and Contrastive and Text). To explicitly optimize ranking behavior, the model is trained with a pairwise Bayesian personalized ranking objective, which promotes separation between relevant and non-relevant items in the latent space. Experiments on Amazon Movies & TV, IMDb, and Rotten Tomatoes demonstrate consistent improvements in hit rate @10 and normalized discounted cumulative gain @10 over state-of-the-art review-aware baselines. Results highlight the importance of controlled semantic fusion for ranking-driven recommendation.

</details>


### [287] [LLM-Enhanced Topical Trend Detection at Snapchat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27131)
*Hangqi Zhao,Jay Li,Abhiruchi Bhattacharya,Cong Ni,Jason Yeung,Jinchao Ye,Kai Yang,Akshat Malu,Manish Malik*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Snapchat推出业界首个短视频平台生产级主题趋势检测系统，通过多模态主题提取、时序突发检测和LLM整合增强三阶段管线，实现新兴主题的精准实时识别，已在全球范围部署并驱动内容排名与搜索等下游应用优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频社交平台需在大规模场景下及时识别新兴主题趋势，以保持内容生态动态更新，但现有方法难以兼顾准确性、时效性与可扩展性。

Method: 融合多模态主题提取、时序突发检测与LLM驱动的整合增强三大模块，构建端到端自动化流水线。

Result: 连续6个月离线人工评估验证高精确率，生产环境全球部署有效提升内容新鲜度与用户体验。

Conclusion: 首个在短视频平台生产规模部署的端到端主题趋势检测系统，验证了多模态融合与LLM结合的技术路线在工业级应用中的可行性。

Abstract: Automatic detection of topical trends at scale is both challenging and essential for maintaining a dynamic content ecosystem on social media platforms. In this work, we present a large-scale system for identifying emerging topical trends on Snapchat, one of the world's largest short-video social platforms. Our system integrates multimodal topic extraction, time-series burst detection, and LLM-based consolidation and enrichment to enable accurate and timely trend discovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published end-to-end system for topical trend detection on short-video platforms at production scale. Continuous offline human evaluation over six months demonstrates high precision in identifying meaningful trends. The system has been deployed in production at global scale and applied to downstream surfaces including content ranking and search, driving measurable improvements in content freshness and user experience.

</details>


### [288] [RAQG-QPP: Query Performance Prediction with Retrieved Query Variants and Retrieval Augmented Query Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27244)
*Fangzheng Tian,Debasis Ganguly,Craig Macdonald*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RAQG方法，通过从历史查询日志中检索相似查询并利用LLM生成查询变体来改进查询性能预测(QPP)。该方法解决了传统词项扩展方法产生低质量查询变体的问题，在神经排序模型上相比现有最佳方法提升达30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于查询变体的预测方法依赖输入查询的词项扩展，容易产生不连贯、幻觉和偏离主题的查询变体；且现有无监督QPP方法对神经排序模型效果不佳。

Method: 提出RAQG方法：1) 从历史查询日志中检索相似查询作为查询变体(QVs)；2) 利用大语言模型(LLMs)基于检索到的QVs生成更多查询变体，缓解日志查询有限的局限性。

Result: RAQG方法在神经排序模型(如MonoT5)上的预测性能比最佳现有QV方法提升30%。

Conclusion: 实验表明，使用RAQG增强的QPP在TREC DL'19和DL'20数据集上，针对MonoT5等神经排序模型，相比现有最佳QV-based预测方法提升高达30%。

Abstract: Query Performance Prediction (QPP) estimates the retrieval quality of ranking models without the use of any human-assessed relevance judgements, and finds applications in query-specific selective decision making to improve overall retrieval effectiveness. Although unsupervised QPP approaches are effective for lexical retrieval models, they usually perform weaker for neural rankers. Recent work shows that leveraging query variants (QVs), i.e., queries with potentially similar information needs to a given query, can enhance unsupervised QPP accuracy. However, existing QV-based prediction methods rely on query variants generated by term expansion of the input query, which is likely to yield incoherent, hallucinatory and off-topic QVs. In this paper, we propose to make use of queries retrieved from a log of past queries as QVs to be subsequently used for QPP. In addition to directly applying retrieved QVs in QPP, we further propose to leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate QVs conditioned on the retrieved QVs, thus mitigating the limitation of relying only on existing queries in a log. Experiments on TREC DL'19 and DL'20 show that QPP enhanced with RAQG outperform the best-performing existing QV-based prediction approach by as much as 30% on neural ranking models such as MonoT5.

</details>


### [289] [NuggetIndex: Governed Atomic Retrieval for Maintainable RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27306)
*Saber Zerhoudi,Michael Granitzer,Jelena Mitrovic*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: NuggetIndex通过原子信息单元存储模式革新RAG系统评估，解决了传统方法中文本片段检索与事实级评估的单位不匹配问题，并有效管理知识时序性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统存在三大缺陷：(1)检索对象与评估对象单位不匹配；(2)语料库更新时难以维护；(3)无法捕获被取代的事实或源冲突。

Method: 提出NuggetIndex系统，将原子信息单元（nuggets）存储为托管记录，每条记录包含证据链接、时间有效性间隔和生命周期状态，通过在排序前过滤无效/废弃nuggets实现时序感知检索。

Result: 相比段落和 unmanaged proposition 检索基线：nugget召回率提升42%，时序正确性提高9个百分点（未出现时间过滤基线中的召回崩塌），冲突率降低55%，生成器输入长度减少64%。

Conclusion: NuggetIndex通过原子化信息单元存储模式，有效解决了RAG系统的时序知识管理和事实一致性难题，在多项指标上显著优于基线方法，同时支持轻量级部署。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are frequently evaluated via fact-based metrics, yet standard implementations retrieve passages or static propositions. This unit mismatch between evaluation and retrieval objects hinders maintenance when corpora evolve and fails to capture superseded facts or source disagreements. We propose NuggetIndex, a retrieval system that stores atomic information units as managed records, so called nuggets. Each record maintains links to evidence, a temporal validity interval, and a lifecycle state. By filtering invalid or deprecated nuggets prior to ranking, the system prevents the inclusion of outdated information. We evaluate the approach using a nuggetized MS MARCO subset, a temporal Wikipedia QA dataset, and a multi-hop QA task. Against passage and unmanaged proposition retrieval baselines, NuggetIndex improves nugget recall by 42%, increases temporal correctness by 9 percentage points without the recall collapse observed in time-filtered baselines, and reduces conflict rates by 55%. The compact nugget format reduces generator input length by 64% while enabling lightweight index structures suitable for browser-based and resource-constrained deployment. We release our implementation, datasets, and evaluation scripts

</details>


### [290] [From Unstructured to Structured: LLM-Guided Attribute Graphs for Entity Search and Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27410)
*Yilun Zhu,Nikhita Vedula,Shervin Malmasi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段方法，将大语言模型驱动的属性图构建与图感知的大语言模型排序相结合，用于电子商务中的实体搜索。该方法在离线阶段构建可重用的属性图，在线阶段通过在结构化表示上推理来排名候选项，在零样本场景下无需训练数据即可实现超过5%的平均精度提升，同时将每个产品的令牌使用量减少57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Traditional embedding-based approaches struggle to capture nuanced context-specific attribute relevance in e-commerce entity search, where product similarity varies across categories and contexts.

Method: The method consists of two stages: (1) An offline stage that extracts structured product attributes from unstructured text and constructs a reusable attribute graph with category-aware schemas; (2) An online stage that ranks retrieved candidates by reasoning over the structured graph representation rather than raw text.

Result: The approach reduces per-product token usage by 57% while improving ranking precision. Under zero-shot scenarios, it achieves over 5% improvement in average precision without requiring training data, and generalizes robustly across diverse product categories.

Conclusion: This approach demonstrates significant potential for real-world deployment, offering a practical solution for entity search in e-commerce that balances efficiency and accuracy.

Abstract: Entity search, i.e., finding the most similar entities to a query entity, faces unique challenges in e-commerce, where product similarity varies across categories and contexts. Traditional embedding-based approaches often struggle to capture nuanced context-specific attribute relevance. In this paper, we present a two-stage approach combining Large Language Model (LLM)-driven attribute graph construction with graph-aware LLM ranking. In the offline stage, we extract structured product attributes from unstructured text, and construct a reusable attribute graph with category-aware schemas. In the online stage, we rank retrieved candidates by reasoning over this structured representation rather than raw text, reducing per-product token usage by 57% while improving ranking precision. Experiments show that our approach outperforms multiple baselines under zero-shot scenarios, achieving a over 5% improvement in average precision without requiring training data, generalizes robustly across diverse product categories, and shows immense potential for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [291] [A Reproducibility Study of LLM-Based Query Reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27421)
*Amin Bigdeli,Radin Hamidi Rad,Hai Son Le,Mert Incesu,Negar Arabzadeh,Charles L. A. Clarke,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对10种LLM查询改写方法进行了系统性复现研究，发现改写效果强烈依赖于检索范式，词法检索的改进不能可靠地转移到神经检索器，且更大的模型并不必然带来更好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM查询改写研究在异构实验条件下进行，难以评估哪些发现可复现、哪些依赖于特定实现选择。需要系统性复现研究来澄清这一问题。

Method: 在统一且严格控制的实验框架下，对10种代表性LLM查询改写方法进行系统性复现和比较研究。评估覆盖两个LLM家族（两种参数规模）、三种检索范式（词法、稀疏学习、密集）以及九个基准数据集（TREC深度学习和BEIR）。

Result: 查询改写收益高度依赖于检索范式；词法检索下的改进不能一致地转移到神经检索器；更大的LLM并不总是带来更好的下游性能。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了先前LLM查询改写工作中报告的收益的稳定性和局限性。所有材料、代码和运行文件通过QueryGym工具包公开发布，以支持透明复现和持续比较。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now widely used for query reformulation and expansion in Information Retrieval, with many studies reporting substantial effectiveness gains. However, these results are typically obtained under heterogeneous experimental conditions, making it difficult to assess which findings are reproducible and which depend on specific implementation choices. In this work, we present a systematic reproducibility and comparative study of ten representative LLM-based query reformulation methods under a unified and strictly controlled experimental framework. We evaluate methods across two architectural LLM families at two parameter scales, three retrieval paradigms (lexical, learned sparse, and dense), and nine benchmark datasets spanning TREC Deep Learning and BEIR. Our results show that reformulation gains are strongly conditioned on the retrieval paradigm, that improvements observed under lexical retrieval do not consistently transfer to neural retrievers, and that larger LLMs do not uniformly yield better downstream performance. These findings clarify the stability and limits of reported gains in prior work. To enable transparent replication and ongoing comparison, we release all prompts, configurations, evaluation scripts, and run files through QueryGym, an open-source reformulation toolkit with a public leaderboard.\footnote{https://leaderboard.querygym.com}

</details>


### [292] [Reproducing Adaptive Reranking for Reasoning-Intensive IR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27577)
*Mandeep Rathee,V Venktesh,Sean MacAvaney,Avishek Anand*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This work replicates GAR on the BRIGHT benchmark to show that iterative graph-based reranking can effectively address bounded recall in reasoning-intensive retrieval at minimal computational cost.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The classical retrieve-then-rerank pipeline suffers from bounded recall due to first-stage retriever limitations; current approaches that improve the retriever incur substantial training and inference costs, especially for reasoning-intensive queries.

Method: Replicate GAR (Graph-based Adaptive Reranking) on the BRIGHT benchmark, which addresses bounded recall by iteratively exploring a corpus graph during reranking, testing with both reasoning and non-reasoning reranking models.

Result: The quality of the reranker's signal plays an important role in identifying additional relevant documents within the corpus graph; GAR boosts effectiveness of reasoning-intensive retrieval across various models while contributing minimally to computational overheads.

Conclusion: GAR enables more practical deployment of retrieval systems for reasoning-intensive queries by boosting effectiveness across various models while contributing minimally to computational overheads.

Abstract: The classical cascading pipeline of retrieve--rerank suffers from a bounded recall problem, stemming from limitations of the first-stage retriever. Most current approaches address the bounded recall problem by improving the first-stage retriever, but this incurs substantial training and inference costs, especially to handle queries that require substantial reasoning. To circumvent the computational costs of reasoning-based retrievers, we replicate the findings of GAR, Graph-based Adaptive Reranking, on the BRIGHT reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmark. GAR addresses the bounded recall problem by modifying the reranking process itself through iterative exploration of a corpus graph, but it was previously only tested on models designed for topical and question-answering-style queries. Hence, reproduce GAR in reasoning-intensive settings with reasoning and non-reasoning reranking models. We observe that the quality of the reranker's signal plays an important role in identifying additional relevant documents within the corpus graph. Overall, we find that GAR boosts the effectiveness of reasoning-intensive retrieval across a variety of models while contributing minimally to computational overheads. Ultimately, this work enables more practical deployment of retrieval systems that can address reasoning-intensive queries.

</details>


### [293] [One Pass, Any Order: Position-Invariant Listwise Reranking for LLM-Based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27599)
*Ethan Bito,Yongli Ren,Estrid He*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出了InvariRank框架，通过结构化注意力掩码和旋转位置编码(RoPE)实现排列不变性，解决大语言模型在推荐重排序中的位置偏差问题，实现单次前向传播完成评分，避免了传统方法需要多排列训练的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在推荐重排序中存在排列敏感性问题——同一候选集仅因呈现顺序不同就会产生不同的分数和排名。这与推荐的集合本质不匹配，限制了LLM重排序器的可靠性。

Method: InvariRank采用两大核心设计：(1) 结构化注意力掩码阻断跨候选者注意力，(2) 共享位置编码框架配合旋转位置嵌入(RoPE)抵消位置引起的评分偏差。模型在单一前向传播中评分所有候选者，无需传统排列不变性训练所需的多个排列组合。

Result: 在推荐基准数据集上的实验表明，InvariRank在保持竞争力的排序效果的同时，能够产生稳定的跨候选排列排名。

Conclusion: 架构层面的不变性设计是实现可靠、高效LLM推荐重排序的实用路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for recommendation reranking, but their listwise predictions can depend on the order in which candidates are presented. This creates a mismatch between the set-based nature of recommendation and the sequence-based computation of decoder-only LLMs, where permuting an otherwise identical candidate set can change item scores and final rankings. Such order sensitivity makes LLM-based rerankers difficult to rely on, since rankings may reflect prompt serialization rather than user preference. We propose InvariRank, a permutation-invariant listwise reranking framework that addresses this dependence at the architectural level. InvariRank blocks cross-candidate attention with a structured attention mask and negates position-induced scoring changes through shared positional framing under Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE). Combined with a listwise learning-to-rank objective, the model scores all candidates in a single forward pass, avoiding permutation-based invariance training objectives that require multiple permutations of a candidate set. Experiments on recommendation benchmarks show that InvariRank maintains competitive ranking effectiveness while producing stable rankings across candidate permutations. The results suggest that architectural invariance is a practical route to reliable and efficient LLM-based recommendation reranking. The source code is at https://github.com/ejbito/InvariRank.

</details>


### [294] [Purifying Multimodal Retrieval: Fragment-Level Evidence Selection for RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27600)
*Xihang Wang,Zihan Wang,Chengkai Huang,Cao Liu,Ke Zeng,Quan Z. Sheng,Lina Yao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: FES-RAG通过将MRAG重新定义为细粒度证据选择问题，从文档级选择转变为片段级选择，利用片段信息增益指标从高容量MLLM蒸馏出轻量级选择器，在减少上下文长度的同时显著提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MRAG框架将检索到的证据视为不可分割的文档，隐含假设文档内所有内容同等重要，但实际上只有一小部分与查询相关，剩余内容会引入大量噪声导致性能下降。

Method: 将多模态文档分解为句子级文本片段和区域级视觉片段；引入FIG（片段信息增益）指标来衡量每个片段对MLLM生成置信度的边际贡献；将片段级效用判断从高容量MLLM蒸馏到轻量级选择器中，以低推理开销实现精确的证据选择。

Result: 在M2RAG基准测试中，FES-RAG始终优于最先进的文档级MRAG方法，CIDER指标相对提升最高达27%，同时显著减少了上下文长度。

Conclusion: FES-RAG通过选择更少但信息量更高的片段，在减少上下文长度的同时提高了事实准确性和生成连贯性，在M2RAG基准测试中实现了最先进的文档级MRAG方法相对改进了27%的CIDEr分数。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) is widely adopted for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with external evidence to reduce hallucinations. Despite its success, most existing MRAG frameworks treat retrieved evidence as indivisible documents, implicitly assuming that all content within a document is equally informative. In practice, however, sometimes only a small fraction of a document is relevant to a given query, while the remaining content introduces substantial noise that may lead to performance degradation. We address this fundamental limitation by reframing MRAG as a fine-grained evidence selection problem. We propose Fragment-level Evidence Selection for RAG (FES-RAG), a framework that selects atomic multimodal fragments rather than entire documents as grounding evidence. FES-RAG decomposes retrieved multimodal documents into sentence-level textual fragments and region-level visual fragments, enabling precise identification of evidence that directly supports generation. To guide fragment selection, we introduce Fragment Information Gain (FIG), a principled metric that measures the marginal contribution of each fragment to the MLLM's generation confidence. Based on FIG, we distill fragment-level utility judgments from a high-capacity MLLM into a lightweight selector, achieving accurate evidence selection with low inference overhead. Experiments on the M2RAG benchmark show that FES-RAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art document-level MRAG methods, achieving up to 27 percent relative improvement in CIDEr. By selecting fewer yet more informative fragments, our approach substantially reduces context length while improving factual accuracy and generation coherence.

</details>


### [295] [Position-Aware Drafting for Inference Acceleration in LLM-Based Generative List-Wise Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27747)
*Jiaju Chen,Chongming Gao,Chenxiao Fan,Haoyan Liu,Qingpeng Cai,Peng Jiang,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出PAD-Rec，通过位置感知embedding和门控机制增强draft模型，解决了speculative decoding在生成式推荐中忽略item内token位置和深度相关不确定性的问题，实现最高3.1倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: speculative decoding在生成式推荐中存在两个被忽视的实际问题：(1) token的语义取决于其在item内的槽位；(2) 不确定性随推测深度增加而增加。现有方法将item的多个semantic-ID tokens统一处理，限制了SD的加速效果。

Method: 提出PAD-Rec，一种位置感知的drafting方法，通过两个互补信号增强draft模型：(1) Item position embeddings编码每个token在item内的槽位；(2) Step position embeddings编码draft步骤以适应深度相关的不确定性。使用简单的门控机制协调这些信号：item slots使用可学习系数，draft steps使用context-driven gate。

Result: 在4个真实数据集上，PAD-Rec最高实现3.1倍wall-clock加速，相比强SD baselines平均提升约5%的加速，同时基本保持推荐质量。

Conclusion: PAD-Rec是一个轻量级模块，可轻松集成到标准draft模型中，添加可忽略的推理开销。在4个真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法最高可实现3.1倍的wall-clock加速，相比强SD baselines平均提升约5%的加速，同时基本保持推荐质量。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based generative list-wise recommendation has advanced rapidly, but decoding remains sequential and thus latency-prone. To accelerate inference without changing the target distribution, speculative decoding (SD) uses a small draft model to propose several next tokens at once and a target LLM to verify and accept the longest prefix, skipping multiple steps per round. In generative recommendation, however, each item is represented by multiple semantic-ID tokens, often with separators, and current drafts typically treat these tokens uniformly. This overlooks two practical facts: (i) a token's semantics depend on its within-item slot, and (ii) uncertainty tends to increase with speculation depth. Without modeling these effects, SD's speedups can be limited. We introduce PAD-Rec, Position-Aware Drafting for generative Recommendation, a lightweight module that augments the draft model with two complementary signals. Item position embeddings explicitly encode the within-item slot of each token, strengthening structural awareness. Step position embeddings encode the draft step, allowing the model to adapt to depth-dependent uncertainty and improve proposal quality. To harmonize these signals with base features, we add simple gates: a learnable coefficient for item slots and a context-driven gate for draft steps. The module is trainable, easy to integrate with standard draft models, and adds negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show up to 3.1x wall-clock speedup and about 5% average wall-clock speedup gain over strong SD baselines, while largely preserving recommendation quality.

</details>


### [296] [How Generative AI Disrupts Search: An Empirical Study of Google Search, Gemini, and AI Overviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27790)
*Riley Grossman,Songjiang Liu,Michael K. Chen,Mike Smith,Cristian Borcea,Yi Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文以 11,500 条真实用户查询（另加政治与热点查询，合计 14,212 条）的公开基准数据集，对比 Google 传统搜索结果（SERP）、Google AI 概览（AIO）与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 三者所引用的来源，量化生成式搜索对网页检索与曝光的冲击。核心发现：AIO 在 51.5% 的代表性真实查询上出现且位于自然结果之上；三者来源重合度极低（Jaccard 0.11–0.18，RBO 0.15–0.23）；生成式搜索显著少引用热门站点、政府/教育机构与屏蔽 Google-Extended 爬虫的网站（AIO 尽管有权限），却更偏向 Google 自有内容；且 AIO/Gemini 在重复运行、跨设备、对微小查询改写上的一致性与稳健性均低于传统搜索；在争议性与高风险查询上 AIO 高频出现且常"站队"，来源可信度更低。作者据此呼吁建立内容授权与收益分成框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI 正在被集成进网页搜索（Google 将 AIO 默认置于 SERP 之上），用户逐渐通过生成式摘要而非原始链接获取信息，由此引发三方面问题：(1) 缺乏对生成式搜索与传统搜索在"检索来源"层面的系统性比较——既有研究多聚焦于摘要质量、引用支持度或离线小规模查询集，未评估真实线上系统的来源差异；(2) 生成式引擎优化（GEO）的有效性存在争议，出版商不清楚应优化哪些来源、是否应屏蔽 AI 爬虫；(3) 生态层面，出版商流量与广告收入下降、生成式搜索质量下降，形成负向循环。论文因此构建大规模公开基准，刻画生成式搜索的来源偏好、一致性与高风险场景表现，并提出政策与商业机制建议。

Method: 1）基准查询集 11,500 条，分 9 个子集：ORCAS（5,000，标注信息型/导航型/交易型意图）、Amazon Retail（500）、Retail-Comp（500）、Retail-Q（500）、Debate（1,000）、ELI5（1,000）、Localized（1,000，"near me" 本地化）、NQ（1,000）、NQ Keywords（1,000）；第 3/4/9 类由 Gemini 2.5 Flash 改写生成并人工抽检。另有时间敏感集：面向全部现任及上次选举亚军国会议员的政治查询，以及 Google Trends 863 个趋势主题（各含主查询与 1 个子查询）。
2）数据采集：通过 SerpAPI 以移动端 + Newark NJ 模拟用户采集 Google SERP 与 AIO（仅取首页，因 97%+ 点击发生在首页）；通过 Gemini API（2.5 Flash，开启 Google Search grounding，关闭 Thinking，无系统提示，默认推理参数）采集 Gemini 引用来源；采集时间统一为 2025 年 12 月 7–8 日。
3）指标：URL 级 Jaccard 相似度与 RBO（p=0.9）刻画集合与排名重叠；按意图/疑问句/长度分组并用卡方检验（Bonferroni 事后两两比较）分析 AIO 触发率；Tranco 排名分箱（Top1K/1M、Top1/3 分解）刻画流行度偏好；Cloudflare 17 类目 + .edu + 是否屏蔽 Google-Extended 构建线性概率模型（含查询固定效应与聚类稳健标准误）检验来源特征差异；McNemar 检验验证域名级差异；MBFC 可信度评级量化政治查询来源质量；词级 Jaccard 与 Pearson 相关检验"来源重叠→摘要文本重叠"；并做 SerpAPI 代表性、跨设备/城市、Bing 对比等稳健性检验。

Result: RQ1：AIO 总体触发率 65.6%（ORCAS 51.5%），ELI5 高达 94.6%、Amazon Retail 仅 17.4%、Retail-Comp 88.2%、Retail-Q 92%、Localized 48.8%、NQ 86.2% vs NQ Keywords 76.5%；信息型、疑问式、长查询更易触发（χ²(2,5000)=439.56，p<0.001；χ²(1,11500)=1685.7，p<0.001），触发率随长度单调上升。
RQ2：来源重叠极低——整体 Jaccard：AIO-SERP 0.18、AIO-Gemini 0.11、Gemini-SERP 0.16；RBO 分别为 0.23/0.15/0.21；商品与本地查询最低；AIO 与 Gemini（同源于 Gemini）反而最不相似；各引擎平均来源数相近（9.68/9.24/8.75），说明差异源于检索方法而非数量。
RQ3：受影响最大的是大型知名站点，且生成式引擎整体减少对其引用；SERP 前 1000 域名占来源 37.8%，AIO/Gemini 分别低 1.3 与 9.9 个百分点，仅看首位来源时 52.7% vs 40.0% vs 32.6%；生成式搜索显著少引用热门域名（Tranco 1k–10k 区间差异最大）、政府/教育机构与屏蔽 Google-Extended 的站点，同时显著更多引用 Google 自有域名（google.com、youtube.com），Gemini 亦偏好 YouTube/Fandom/Grokipedia；21 家热门出版商与多个社交/点评站点（如 NYTimes、Yelp、IMDb、Facebook）在 Gemini 中零引用，均因 robots.txt 屏蔽；并未显著增加"不安全"类网站，但 Gemini 显著更常引用受 CIPA 限制不适宜儿童的网站。
RQ4（一致性）：同设备同地点重复运行的 RBO 为 AIO 0.69、Gemini 0.52、SERP 0.86；跨设备 AIO 0.53、SERP 0.67，跨地点影响仅 0.01–0.02，说明设备差异主导（AIO 移动端来源更多，10.38 vs 9.42）；对 200 条微小改写查询（缩写/缩写展开、增删问号），AIO RBO 仅 0.49（较同查询重复运行降 28.99%），SERP 0.74（降 13.95%），Gemini 0.50（降 3.85%）；来源相似度与生成文本相似度强正相关（AIO r=0.62，Gemini r=0.55，p<0.001）。
RQ5（高风险查询）：政治类查询 AIO 触发率 93.8%，AIO 摘要 33.4%、Gemini 5.6% 明确表态；生成式引擎对政府资源（如 congress.gov）引用更少，来源可疑评级占比 AIO 11.4%、Gemini 15.0% vs SERP 10.6%；趋势类查询 AIO 仅 8.1%（5 天以上趋势 12.7%、5 天内 4.8%），案例显示其会因单一讽刺帖给出错误赛果。
稳健性：SerpAPI 采集与人工浏览器采集的 RBO（0.67/0.79）与两次 API 采集间（0.67/0.81）相当，可视为真实用户代理；桌面端结论一致（AIO 67.17%，ORCAS 52.2%）；Google 与 Bing 的 RBO 仅 0.14，低于 Google 内部生成式与传统搜索的差异，说明对出版商而言生成式曝光的重要性更高。

Conclusion: 生成式 AI 正在重构网页检索：①AIO 已覆盖过半真实查询并置于自然结果之上，成为事实上的默认检索层；②各系统来源差异巨大，用户在不同界面获得的信息显著不同，传统 SEO 与 GEO 均难以覆盖多引擎；③可见性从热门与机构站点（含政府/教育）转向 Google 自有资产与长尾站点，屏蔽 AI 爬虫的网站在 AIO 中亦被降权（"自我伤害"），出版商需重新权衡屏蔽策略与第三方评论/内容适配投入；④生成式搜索一致性与稳健性不足，对民主信息一致性、误信息风险构成挑战，尤其在争议与高风险查询上存在站队与低可信来源问题，建议提高重复运行一致性、改进对微小改写的稳健性、引入第三方可信度评估、参考 Yandex 依据头部结果生成摘要的做法，并对高风险领域制定监管政策；⑤生态可持续性方面，作者主张建立出版商与生成式搜索方之间的收益框架（协商授权、按次付费抓取、收益分成），使高质量内容仍可被检索与利用。局限：仅覆盖 Google 生态、依赖 API 无法模拟登录个性化与用户特征、单时点描述性研究；未来可扩展至 ChatGPT/Perplexity/Bing Copilot、开源生成式工具、纵向监测与用户研究，并量化引用对出版商流量与广告收入的影响。数据集与代码已开源以支持复现与长期追踪。

Abstract: Generative AI is being increasingly integrated into web search for the convenience it provides users. In this work, we aim to understand how generative AI disrupts web search by retrieving and presenting the information and sources differently from traditional search engines. We introduce a public benchmark dataset of 11,500 user queries to support our study and future research of generative search. We compare the search results returned by Google's search engine, the accompanying AI Overview (AIO), and Gemini Flash 2.5 for each query. We have made several key findings. First, we find that for 51.5\% of representative, real-user queries, AIOs are generated, and are displayed above the organic search results. Controversial questions frequently result in an AIO. Second, we show that the retrieved sources are substantially different for each search engine (<0.2 average Jaccard similarity). Traditional Google search is significantly more likely to retrieve information from popular or institutional websites in government or education, while generative search engines are significantly more likely to retrieve Google-owned content. Third, we observe that websites that block Google's AI crawler are significantly less likely to be retrieved by AIOs, despite having access to the content. Finally, AIOs are less consistent when processing two runs of the same query, and are less robust to minor query edits. Our findings have important implications for understanding how generative search impacts website visibility, the effectiveness of generative engine optimization techniques, and the information users receive. We call for revenue frameworks to foster a sustainable and mutually beneficial ecosystem for publishers and generative search providers.

</details>


### [297] [NeocorRAG: Less Irrelevant Information, More Explicit Evidence, and More Effective Recall via Evidence Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27852)
*Shiyao Peng,Qianhe Zheng,Zhuodi Hao,Zichen Tang,Rongjin Li,Qing Huang,Jiayu Huang,Jiacheng Liu,Yifan Zhu,Haihong E*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对RAG系统中检索改进与推理增益不匹配的问题，提出RCR评估指标，发现检索质量被忽视导致RCR近线性衰减。创新性提出NeocorRAG框架，通过激活搜索、约束解码和证据链引导三阶段实现综合检索质量优化，突破质量-召回率权衡困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统中检索性能提升未能有效转化为下游推理能力提升，存在关键评估缺口。

Method: 提出Recall Conversion Rate (RCR)指标量化检索对推理的贡献度；识别出现有方法的"质量-召回率"权衡困境。提出NeocorRAG框架：(1)激活搜索算法获取精细候选空间；(2)约束解码确保精确证据链生成；(3)证据链引导检索优化。

Result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、NQ等基准上，NeocorRAG在3B和70B参数模型上均达到SOTA性能，且token消耗不足可比方法的20%。

Conclusion: NeocorRAG提出了高效、无需训练的RAG增强范式，通过证据链实现综合检索质量优化，在多个基准数据集和模型规模上均达到SOTA性能，同时将token消耗降至可比方法的20%以下。

Abstract: Although precise recall is a core objective in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), a critical oversight persists in the field: improvements in retrieval performance do not consistently translate to commensurate gains in downstream reasoning. To diagnose this gap, we propose the Recall Conversion Rate (RCR), a novel evaluation metric to quantify the contribution of retrieval to reasoning accuracy. Our quantitative analysis of mainstream RAG methods reveals that as Recall@5 improves, the RCR exhibits a near-linear decay. We identify the neglect of retrieval quality in these methods as the underlying cause. In contrast, approaches that focus solely on quality optimization often suffer from inferior recall performance. Both categories lack a comprehensive understanding of retrieval quality optimization, resulting in a trade-off dilemma. To address these challenges, we propose comprehensive retrieval quality optimization criteria and introduce the NeocorRAG framework. This framework achieves holistic retrieval quality optimization by systematically mining and utilizing Evidence Chains. Specifically, NeocorRAG first employs an innovative activated search algorithm to obtain a refined candidate space. Then it ensures precise evidence chain generation through constrained decoding. Finally, the retrieved set of evidence chains guides the retrieval optimization process. Evaluated on benchmarks including HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and NQ, NeocorRAG achieves SOTA performance on both 3B and 70B parameter models, while consuming less than 20% of tokens used by comparable methods. This study presents an efficient, training-free paradigm for RAG enhancement that effectively optimizes retrieval quality while maintaining high recall. Our code is released at https://github.com/BUPT-Reasoning-Lab/NeocorRAG.

</details>


### [298] [SimEval-IR: A Unified Toolkit and Benchmark Suite for Evaluating User Simulators and Search Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27878)
*Saber Zerhoudi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SimEval-IR工具包用于评估用户模拟器，系统区分了行为真实性和测试器可靠性两个不同目标，发现常用的"类人性"检测方法对系统排序预测效果很差，而边际点击深度距离和Fréchet距离更具预测力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户模拟器在交互式信息检索中日益重要，但社区缺乏标准化评估工具。当前研究中，行为真实性（匹配真实用户行为）和测试器可靠性（产生有效系统排序）这两个目标常被混淆，尽管它们本质不同且有时相互冲突。

Method: 提出SimEval-IR工具包和基准测试套件，包含：（1）统一会话schema，适配器验证和显式损失计算；（2）三个可执行基准测试，分别评估行为真实性、基于RATE风格估计的测试器可靠性及两者关联分析；（3）在四个真实数据集（两种语言）和四个模拟器族上进行基线实验。

Result: 关键发现：文献中主导的"类人性"分类器-判别器检查对系统排序有效性几乎没有 pooled 预测能力（r=+0.09, n=48）；而边际点击深度距离和会话嵌入的Fréchet距离提供更强信号（|r|=0.43和0.40, p≤0.005）。

Conclusion: SimEval-IR提供了一个统一框架，区分行为真实性和测试器可靠性两个目标，使评估可测量。开源发布所有配置和脚本。

Abstract: User simulators are increasingly central to interactive information retrieval, yet the community lacks standardized evaluation tools. Simulators serve two objectives, behavioral realism (matching real user behavior) and tester reliability (producing valid system rankings), and these are often conflated despite being distinct and sometimes conflicting. We present SimEval-IR, an open-source toolkit and benchmark suite that makes this distinction measurable. SimEval-IR provides: (1) a canonical session schema unifying session search and conversational interactions, with validated dataset adapters and explicit loss accounting; (2) three executable benchmarks covering behavioral realism, tester reliability with RATE-style estimation, and an analysis linking the two; and (3) baseline results across four real datasets in two languages and four simulator families. Our key finding: the classifier-discriminator ''human-likeness'' check, the dominant realism test in the literature, has essentially no pooled predictive power for system-ranking validity ($r{=}{+}0.09$, $n{=}48$), while marginal click-depth distance and Fréchet distance over session embeddings give a much stronger signal ($|r|{=}0.43$ and $0.40$, $p{\leq}0.005$). SimEval-IR is released with all configurations and scripts to reproduce the reported analysis.

</details>


### [299] [Efficient Multivector Retrieval with Token-Aware Clustering and Hierarchical Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28142)
*Silvio Martinico,Franco Maria Nardini,Cosimo Rulli,Rossano Venturini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TACHIOM是一种利用令牌级结构的多向量检索系统，通过分布感知质心分配和图索引技术，实现了聚类和检索阶段的大幅加速（分别可达247倍和9.8倍），在保持高精度的同时显著降低了部署成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多向量检索模型虽然效果领先，但部署成本高昂。现有基于k-means的解决方案存在计算复杂度高、大规模扩展困难，且训练过程中高频令牌占优、稀有区分性令牌被低估的问题。

Method: TACHIOM利用令牌级结构，通过分布感知的质心分配实现可扩展至数百万质心规模；结合基于图的质心索引与优化的乘积量化布局，在仅使用质心进行文档评分时即可保证准确性。

Result: 在MS-MARCOv1和LoTTE数据集上的实验表明，TACHIOM相比k-means实现最高247倍聚类加速，相比现有最优系统实现最高9.8倍检索加速，同时保持相当或更优的检索效果。

Conclusion: TACHIOM在保持同等或更优检索效果的同时，显著降低了计算和内存开销，为大规模多向量检索系统的实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Multivector retrieval models achieve state-of-the-art effectiveness through fine-grained token-level representations, but their deployment incurs substantial computational and memory costs. Current solutions, based on the well-known k-means clustering algorithm, group similar vectors together to enable both effective compression and efficient retrieval. However, standard k-means scales poorly with the number of clusters and dataset size, and favours frequent tokens during training while underrepresenting rare, discriminative ones. In this work, we introduce TACHIOM, a multivector retrieval system that exploits token-level structure to significantly accelerate both clustering and retrieval. By accounting for tokens' distribution during centroid allocation, TACHIOM easily scales to millions of centroids, enabling highly accurate document scoring using only centroids, avoiding expensive token-level computation. TACHIOM combines a graph-based index over centroids with an optimized Product Quantization layout for efficient final scoring. Experiments on MS-MARCOv1 and LoTTE show that TACHIOM achieves up to $247\times$ faster clustering than k-means and up to $9.8\times$ retrieval speedup over state-of-the-art systems while maintaining comparable or superior effectiveness.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [300] [Static Program Slicing Using Language Models With Dataflow-Aware Pretraining and Constrained Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26961)
*Pengfei He,Shaowei Wang,Tse-Hsun,Chen,Muhammad Asaduzzaman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Sliceformer是一种基于小型语言模型（如CodeT5+）的程序切片新方法，通过数据流感知预训练和约束解码机制解决现有方法的数据依赖建模不准确和幻觉生成问题，实验表明其性能显著优于现有基线


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语言模型的程序切片方法存在两个关键缺陷：数据依赖建模不准确（无法捕获精确数据流关系）和无约束生成（产生幻觉性token和语句）

Method: 提出两大创新：1) 基于数据流图的预训练目标（数据流保留语句置换 + 数据流感知跨度损坏）；2) 约束解码机制（词汇约束 + 句法约束）

Result: 在Java和Python程序切片基准测试中，相较于基线方法取得一致改进，ExactMatch指标提升高达22%

Conclusion: Sliceformer在Java和Python程序切片基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，ExactMatch指标提升高达22%

Abstract: Static program slicing is a fundamental software engineering technique for isolating code relevant to specific variables. While recent learning-based approaches using language models (LMs) show promise in automating slice prediction, they suffer from inaccurate dependency modeling and unconstrained generation, where LMs fail to capture precise data flow relations and produce slices containing hallucinated tokens and statements. To address these challenges, we propose Sliceformer, a novel approach that reformulates static program slicing as a sequence-to-sequence task using small language models such as CodeT5+. Sliceformer introduces two key innovations that directly target the identified limitations. First, to improve dependency modeling, we design dataflow-aware pretraining objectives that leverage data flow graphs (DFG) to teach models data dependencies through dataflow-preserving statement permutation and dataflow-aware span corruption. Second, to eliminate hallucination, we develop a constrained decoding mechanism that enforces both lexical and syntactic constraints. We evaluate Sliceformer on Java and Python program slicing benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines with up to 22% gain in ExactMatch.

</details>


### [301] [UCSC-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Multi-View Generalization and Diagnostic Analysis of Machine-Generated Code Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26990)
*Kargi Chauhan,Sadiba Nusrat Nur*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是 UCSC-NLP 团队参加 SemEval-2026 Task 13（多语言机器生成代码检测）的系统报告。Subtask A（人写 vs. 机器生成二分类）采用 UniXcoder-base + 多视角一致性训练框架（结构前缀、去词法化 + 对称 KL 一致性、token dropout、混合内容增强），验证集宏 F1 0.993、测试集宏 F1 0.845（跨未见语言/领域）；Subtask B（11 类生成器归属）用 CodeBERT 诊断性实验揭示极端类别不平衡（221:1）下标准微调的"多数类坍塌"现象：准确率 88.4% 但宏 F1 仅 0.086（低于平凡基线 0.091），加逆频率类权重后宏 F1 提升至 0.345（相对 +301%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型生成代码的规模快速增长（如 GitHub Copilot 已被 180 万+ 开发者使用），使得区分人写代码与 AI 生成代码在学术诚信、招聘评估与软件安全审计等高利害场景中愈发重要。然而现有检测器普遍过拟合于特定生成器的表面伪影，在提示词变化、轻微编辑、跨语言/跨领域分布漂移下性能显著退化，且通用自然语言 AI 检测器在代码上接近随机水平（Pan et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024）；熵、重复度、似然等替代信号因源码语法规则性强而失效。此外在细粒度生成器归属任务中，极端类别不平衡会导致少数生成器类被系统性忽略。作者因此将任务刻画为词汇、结构与风格三重偏移下的领域泛化问题。

Method: Subtask A（域泛化框架）：骨干为 UniXcoder-base（125M，768 维），输入 512 token，采用首尾截断（前 256 + 后 256 拼接）。四项针对性改造：(1) 3-域结构前缀——依据语法行/自然语言行比例与循环、函数、类等结构特征，将片段标注为 clean/mixed/fragment；(2) 去词法化——标识符、字符串、数值统一替换为 ID/STR/NUM，并以对称 KL 散度强制原始视角与去词法化视角预测一致；(3) token dropout——随机将 15% 非特殊 token 替换为 [MASK]，抑制语言特有关键词这一伪特征；(4) 混合内容增强——以 40% 概率向训练片段注入通用文本片段，直接弥合测试集 33.4% 混合片段的训练空白。总损失 L = L_CE + λ·SymKL(p‖q_delex) + (λ/2)·SymKL(p‖q_mixed)，λ=0.5；推理阶段对原始/去词法化/混合三视角 logits 取平均，构成零成本测试时集成。超参：lr 2e-5，batch 16，训练 1 epoch，warmup 470，weight decay 0.01，label smoothing 0.1。Subtask B（诊断基线与类权重扩展）：骨干 microsoft/codebert-base，池化 [CLS]∈R^768 接线性 softmax 头（11 类），最大长度 512 token；刻意不使用重加权/焦点损失/过采样的"无权重诊断基线"用于隔离类别不平衡的影响，与之对比的是对交叉熵施加逆频率权重的竞争系统，两者均训练 3 epoch（lr 2e-5，batch 32，warmup 500）。分析手段包括 t-SNE 嵌入可视化（perplexity=30）、序列长度/KL/类权重消融、错误案例分析。

Result: 数据分布：Subtask A 训练集 Python 91%、C++ 5%、Java 4%（均为算法竞赛域），标签近似均衡（人写 47.7%/机器 52.3%），测试集含 5 种未见语言（JavaScript、C#、PHP、Go、C）、2 个未见领域（Research、Production）及 33.4% 未知类型混合片段，核心挑战是分布偏移而非不平衡。Subtask B 训练集 50 万样本：人写 442K（88.4%），OpenAI 10K，Meta-LLaMA/IBM-Granite/Qwen 各 8K，Phi 5K，DeepSeek-AI/Mistral 各 4K，01-ai 3K，BigCode/Gemma 各 2K，最大/最小类比 221:1。Subtask A 结果：验证集 Acc 0.993、宏 F1 0.993、AUC 0.999；测试集 Acc 0.892、宏 F1 0.845、AUC 0.851（跨语言/跨领域落差 14.8 点）；测试集分类别较均衡（Human P=0.920/R=0.760/F1=0.833，Machine P=0.794/R=0.938/F1=0.860）。训练动态显示验证损失紧密跟随训练损失，无过拟合。消融：序列长度 512→64 使宏 F1 降 4.7 点；去掉 KL 一致性降 0.5 点（预期在 OOD 上影响更大）；无 warmup 降 0.2 点。Subtask B 结果：无权重诊断基线 Acc 0.884、宏 F1 0.086、加权 F1 0.876，且验证与测试指标完全一致——说明模型近似常数多数类预测器、无真实逐样本判别，其宏 F1 甚至低于平凡多数类基线 0.091；t-SNE 显示 CodeBERT 预训练嵌入中 11 类高度重叠。类权重系统 Acc 降至 0.787，宏 F1 升至 0.345（+301% 相对，+25.9 绝对点），加权 F1 0.836。错误分析显示两类误判均源于"风格迁移"：极简人写代码被判为机器，带冗长教学式注释的 GPT-4 输出被判为人写。

Conclusion: 结论：机器生成代码检测存在两种截然不同的"区制"——人机二分类已高度可行，预训练代码模型能捕获基础分布差异，多视角正则化（结构前缀 + 去词法化一致性 + token dropout + 混合增强）在严重语言/领域漂移下仍保持较强泛化；而细粒度生成器归属仍是开放难题，其根源是嵌入空间类间重叠与极端类别不平衡的叠加，标准微调必然导致多数类坍塌，因此不平衡感知训练是必要前提（类权重即带来 +301% 相对宏 F1）。后续方向包括对比学习以拉大类间距离、引入 AST 模式与控制流图等 token 层面不可见的生成器结构签名、焦点损失、类别均衡采样与小样本元学习。局限：仅评估编码器架构；Subtask B 探索不完整；训练集 91% 为 Python，跨语言结论受限（Go 仅占测试集 0.5%）；数据多源自竞赛代码，向生产级/多文件项目的泛化未知。作者亦在伦理声明中强调人写类召回仅 0.760，任何高利害决策前必须引入人工复核，代码已开源以支持可复现与负责任部署。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of large language models for code generation, distinguishing between human-written and AI-generated code has become increasingly critical for academic integrity, hiring evaluations, and software security. We present our system for SemEval-2026 Task 13: Multilingual Machine-Generated Code Detection, participating in Subtask A (binary detection) and Subtask B (multi-class attribution across 10 LLM families). For Subtask A, we fine-tune UniXcoder-base with a multi-view training framework that promotes generator-invariant representations. The framework combines domain-specific structural prefixes, delexicalization with symmetric KL consistency loss, token dropout, and mixed-content augmentation.
