**DEFault++（诊断模型）**：核心思想是"每个故障在被破坏的组件内部仍留下独特模式"，因此测量组件级运行时行为，而非模型级指标。特征分为四大族：层内指标 C_int（注意力熵/padding 注意力质量/头间余弦相似度/头使用率/注意力秩/跨样本泄漏/解码器未来注意力质量、前 softmax 分数、FFN 输出范数、LayerNorm 参数、残差余弦相似度、CKA 层相似度、Q-K/Q-V/K-V 对齐）、优化梯度指标 C_opt（21 类）、行为指标 C_train（10/12 类，含缓存指标）、验证指标 C_eval（2 类）；按层(A_l=5)→epoch(A_e=3)→训练阶段(A_p=5)聚合，得到编码器 1,600 维、解码器 1,705 维特征，并用 CV<0.01 过滤近常量列。FPG 是由 Transformer 前向/反向方程推出的确定性有向图，节点为组件（残差与 LayerNorm 按注意力子层/FFN 子层分开，解码器额外含 KV Cache 节点），边对应 7 种依赖机制（M1 前向顺序传播、M2 同时传播、M3 残差旁路、M4 跨层传播、M5 反向传播、M6 架构级干预、M7 跨时间步缓存传播），并在边上标注 Softmax/LayerNorm/激活等"传播限制算子"。模型结构：每组特征用独立 MLP 编码（h=32），拼接后经可学习投影得 z_proj（e=64），再在 FPG 组级邻接矩阵上做 3 轮 GCN 式消息传递 H'=ReLU(ÂHW_msg)（行归一化带自环；表示漂移/训练动态/验证性能仅用自环；反向影响由梯度特征组承担）。三级预测头共享编码器：Level 1 二分类检测（z_proj→两层 MLP）；Level 2 类别分类（编码器 11 类/解码器 12 类）；Level 3 采用原型分类器（每根因原型为该根因训练样本组嵌入均值，按组可分解的平方欧氏距离在预测类别内选最近原型）。训练目标 L = L_detect(BCE) + α·L_cat(类加权CE，仅故障样本) + λ·L_rc(按类别的根因交叉熵头) + L_sep，其中 L_sep = β·L_ctr(类别内监督对比学习，τ=0.1) + γ·L_pm(原型匹配)，超参 α=λ=1.0、β=0.5、γ=0.3。解释机制：对预测根因与最近竞争根因计算组级距离差 Δ_g，归一化为重要性权重 w_g，指示哪些特征组（进而哪些 Transformer 子系统）支撑该诊断。

**实验设置**：4 个编码器模型（BERT-base/RoBERTa-base/DistilBERT/DistilRoBERTa，66M–125M，6/12 层）+ 3 个解码器模型（GPT-2/GPT-Neo-125M/DistilGPT-2）；5 个 GLUE 任务（SST-2/QNLI/RTE/MRPC/QQP，accuracy）+ 4 个语言建模语料（LAMBADA/PTB/WikiText-2/OpenWebText，log-perplexity）；统一 AdamW + 线性 warmup + 混合精度，5 个固定种子；嵌套分组交叉验证（外层 k=5，分组单位为"模型–任务"对：编码器 20 对、解码器 12 对），内层用 StratifiedGroupKFold 调参，种子内测量取均值；基线为 AutoTrainer、DeepDiagnosis、DeepFD、DEFault（因标签体系不同，仅在检测层比较）。

Result: 检测（Level 1）：编码器 F1 0.8259（P 0.8014/R 0.8520），解码器 F1 0.9094（P 0.9125/R 0.9064）。分类（Level 2）：编码器 F1 0.8497、解码器 0.8679；Residual（0.961/0.995）与 Positional 最强，编码器 Variant(0.741)、Kernel(0.771) 与解码器 FFN(0.718)、KV Cache(0.758) 最弱。根因（Level 3）：编码器 F1 0.8512（P 0.9407/R 0.7932）、解码器 0.8670（P 0.9475/R 0.8225）；QKV 根因最难（0.765/0.646），Residual、Positional 最易。与基线比较（检测 F1）：DEFault++ 0.826/0.909 > DEFault 0.566/0.702 > DeepFD 0.514/0.655 > DeepDiagnosis 0.338/0.482 > AutoTrainer 0.284/0.427。消融：去 FPG 消息传递对 Level 2 影响最大（编码器 0.850→0.742）；去分离损失对 Level 3 影响最大（0.851→0.756）；同时去除降至 0.701/0.734；拓扑消融显示 Rewired/Random 变体均劣于原始 FPG（Level 2 编码器 0.770/0.754 vs 0.850）。基准统计：结构有效配置 4,096 个（编码器 1,955、解码器 2,141），被杀比例编码器 81.7%、解码器 55.1%，共 5,556 实例、约 27,000 GPU 小时（54,850 次微调）。真实缺陷：20 个开源 issue 中复现 11 个，FD 8/11、FC 8/11、RC 4/11；Diffusers #11903 正确诊断为 QKV/动态参数注册，QKV 对齐与优化两组占 73% 权重。开发者研究（21 人，被试内反平衡设计）：修复正确率 57.1%→83.3%，自评信心 3.38→4.00，最大提升出现在根因预测错误但类别正确的 S2/S3 场景。

Conclusion: 结论与启示：Transformer 故障诊断的收益来自"组件级测量 + 沿传播结构组织证据"，而非仅依赖模型级训练信号——这一组织方式使那些在损失曲线与数值层面无法区分的故障变得可分离。技术上，FPG 结构先验主要服务于故障分类，类内分离损失（监督对比 + 原型匹配）主要服务于根因诊断，两者互补；解释应内生于预测机制（原型距离可按特征组分解），并随训练与监督分类器逐步对齐。边界与不足：目前每次运行仅注入单一故障，未覆盖多故障共存；FPG 仅标记"可能的传播路径"，不含依赖强度与机制类型，边权未经真实故障标定，故只能视为合理传播路径而非已验证的因果链路；解释忠实性仅针对模型自身决策（内部忠实性），缺乏独立的特征组标注真值；评测仅覆盖 4 编码器 + 3 解码器、66M–125M、6–12 层，不含编码器-解码器、视觉/多模态、MoE 与更大模型，且分类器权重模型相关需重训；开发者研究规模较小（21 人）、为情境式而非真实调试，自报时间仅为努力程度估计。后续方向包括扩展多故障配置、给 FPG 边加入依赖强度与类型标注并学习边权、补充经验证的特征组标注、扩大模型与任务覆盖及开展更大规模真实调试研究。

附注：arXiv 摘要版与全文在基准规模上不一致——摘要称 3,739 条实例、全文为 5,556 条；摘要的 AUROC>0.96 / Macro-F1 0.85 表述与全文以 F1 为主的报告口径亦不统一，引用时建议以正文表格为准。

Abstract: Transformer models are widely deployed in critical AI applications, yet faults in their attention mechanisms, projections, and other internal components often degrade behavior silently without raising runtime errors. Existing fault diagnosis techniques often target generic deep neural networks and cannot identify which transformer component is responsible for an observed symptom. In this article, we present DEFault++, a hierarchical learning-based diagnostic technique that operates at three level of abstraction: it detects whether a fault is present, classifies it into one of 12 transformer-specific fault categories (covering both attention-internal mechanisms and surrounding architectural components), and identifies the underlying root cause from up to 45 mechanisms. To facilitate both training and evaluation, we construct DEFault-bench, a benchmark of 3,739 labeled instances obtained through systematic mutation testing. These instances are created across seven transformer models and nine downstream tasks using DEForm, a transformer-specific mutation technique we developed for this purpose. DEFault++ measures runtime behavior at the level of individual transformer components. It organizes these measurements through a Fault Propagation Graph (FPG) derived from the transformer architecture. It then produces an interpretable diagnosis using prototype matching combined with supervised contrastive learning. On DEFault-bench, DEFault++ exceeds an AUROC of 0.96 for detection and a Macro-F1 of 0.85 for both categorization and root-cause diagnosis on encoder and decoder architectures. In a developer study with 21 practitioners, the accuracy of choosing correct repair actions increased from 57.1% without support to 83.3% when using DEFault++.

</details>


### [330] [Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28139)
*Chenxin Li,Zhengyang Tang,Huangxin Lin,Yunlong Lin,Shijue Huang,Shengyuan Liu,Bowen Ye,Rang Li,Lei Li,Benyou Wang,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Claw-Eval-Live，一个用于工作流智能体的动态基准测试，通过将公共需求信号驱动的信号层与可复现的发布快照分离，实现持续评估。评测105个任务和13个前沿模型后发现，当前工作流自动化可靠性仍远未解决，领先模型通过率仅66.7%，且排行榜排名不足以反映真实能力差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准测试在发布时冻结任务集，主要对最终响应评分，难以根据演变的工作流需求评估智能体，也难以验证任务是否被正确执行。

Method: 将可刷新的信号层（从公共工作流需求信号更新）与可复现的时间戳发布快照分离；使用ClawHub Top-500技能构建任务；记录执行轨迹、审计日志、服务状态和运行后工作区工件；采用确定性检查与结构化LLM评判相结合的方式进行评估。

Result: 领先模型仅通过66.7%的任务，无模型达到70%；HR、管理和多系统业务工作流是持续瓶颈；本地工作区修复相对更容易但尚未饱和；相似通过率可能掩盖整体完成度的差异。

Conclusion: 工作流智能体评估应该进行双重落地：新鲜的外部需求信号，以及可验证的智能体行动。

Abstract: LLM agents are expected to complete end-to-end units of work across software tools, business services, and local workspaces. Yet many agent benchmarks freeze a curated task set at release time and grade mainly the final response, making it difficult to evaluate agents against evolving workflow demand or verify whether a task was executed. We introduce Claw-Eval-Live, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-demand signals, from a reproducible, time-stamped release snapshot. Each release is constructed from public workflow-demand signals, with ClawHub Top-500 skills used in the current release, and materialized as controlled tasks with fixed fixtures, services, workspaces, and graders. For grading, Claw-Eval-Live records execution traces, audit logs, service state, and post-run workspace artifacts, using deterministic checks when evidence is sufficient and structured LLM judging only for semantic dimensions. The release contains 105 tasks spanning controlled business services and local workspace repair, and evaluates 13 frontier models under a shared public pass rule. Experiments reveal that reliable workflow automation remains far from solved: the leading model passes only 66.7% of tasks and no model reaches 70%. Failures are structured by task family and execution surface, with HR, management, and multi-system business workflows as persistent bottlenecks and local workspace repair comparatively easier but unsaturated. Leaderboard rank alone is insufficient because models with similar pass rates can diverge in overall completion, and task-level discrimination concentrates in a middle band of tasks. Claw-Eval-Live suggests that workflow-agent evaluation should be grounded twice, in fresh external demand and in verifiable agent action.

</details>


### [331] [Unsafe and Unused? A History of Utility Code in Mature Open Source Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28146)
*Brandon Keller,Kaitlin Yandik,Angela Ngo,Andy Meneely*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对7个大型开源项目的纵向分析，发现util文件（通常用于存放通用工具代码）实际上比普通文件更容易包含安全漏洞，风险高出约2.75倍。研究建议开发者应重新审视util命名约定的使用，避免创建名义上通用但实际未被复用且存在安全隐患的工具文件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前软件开发中，util命名约定被广泛使用以表示代码的通用性和可复用性。然而，论文探究了一个关键问题：这些util代码在实际项目中究竟会如何发展？是否存在滥用util命名的情况，导致util文件变得不安全或未被实际使用？研究的核心目标是帮助开发者避免创建不安全且未被使用的util文件。

Method: 采用纵向挖掘方法，对7个开源项目（Linux kernel、Django、FFmpeg、httpd、Struts、systemd、Tomcat）的Git仓库进行分析。研究以30天为间隔对整个项目历史进行快照，共计1773个快照，覆盖147个项目年。同时在每个快照点进行重命名跟踪，以追踪util文件在整个代码库生命周期中的变化。

Result: 研究发现util文件涉及漏洞的可能性最高可达非util文件的2.75倍。此外，分析揭示了util使用率、复杂度、开发者协作与安全性之间存在潜在关联。研究还追踪了util文件在整个生命周期中的重命名情况，发现这些文件在项目中具有较长的存活期。

Conclusion: 尽管util命名约定旨在促进代码复用和减少工作量，但研究揭示util文件实际上更容易涉及安全漏洞（风险是非util文件的2.75倍）。这一发现表明，当前的util使用实践可能适得其反，研究的目标是帮助开发者避免创建不安全且未被使用的util文件。此外，util文件的普遍性和长期存在性为理解软件开发的socio-technical特性提供了有价值的视角。

Abstract: Filenames are a concise means of conveying information about source code to fellow developers. One such convention is util. Commonly understood to stand for "utility", filenames with the letters util are often an indication that the file contains code that may be broadly useful or reusable. Some projects use this convention heavily, for example, the Apache Tomcat server contains 925 files with util in the path name, which is 17.9% of all source code files in the tree. While the intent of the name may be to prevent duplicate code and reduce workload, what actually happens to util code over time? Do projects move away from util code as they mature? Are util files being used by fellow colleagues, or maintained and used by their author? The goal of our work is to help developers avoid creating unsafe and unused util files when developing their projects. We conducted a longitudinal mining study of the Git repositories of seven open source projects that have a long development history (Linux kernel, Django, FFmpeg, httpd, Struts, systemd, Tomcat). We analyzed how util usage, complexity, developer collaboration, and security are potentially correlated within these projects. Our longitudinal analysis was measured at 30-day intervals throughout the entire history of each project, resulting in 1773 snapshots over 147 project-years of development. We conducted rename tracking at every 30-day snapshot to examine util files over their entire lifetime in a codebase. For example, we found that a util file can be as much as 2.75 times more likely to be involved in a vulnerability than non-util files. While every project can adopt their own naming conventions, the ubiquity and longevity of util files shows a broader developer intent that is useful for understanding the socio-technical nature of software development.

</details>

### [332] [Efficient Training on Multiple Consumer GPUs with RoundPipe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27085)
*Yibin Luo,Shiwei Gao,Huichuan Zheng,Youyou Lu,Jiwu Shu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RoundPipe通过打破权重绑定约束的轮询调度策略，在消费级GPU服务器上实现近零气泡的流水线并行，显著加速大模型微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级GPU服务器进行LLM微调受限于有限显存和缓慢的PCIe互连；现有流水线并行结合CPU卸载方案虽能缓解通信开销，但受"权重绑定问题"约束——不均衡模型阶段绑定导致最繁忙GPU成为瓶颈，产生严重流水线气泡。

Method: 提出RoundPipe方法：将GPU视为无状态执行工作池，采用轮询调度动态分发计算阶段；集成优先级感知的传输调度引擎、细粒度分布式事件同步协议及自动化层划分算法。

Result: 实验结果表明，RoundPipe在8×RTX 4090服务器上对1.7B至32B模型微调实现1.48-2.16×加速，并首次支持单服务器上Qwen3-235B模型31K序列长度的LoRA微调。

Conclusion: RoundPipe在8×RTX 4090服务器上将1.7B至32B模型的微调速度提升1.48-2.16倍，并首次实现单服务器环境下Qwen3-235B模型31K序列长度的LoRA微调。代码已开源。

Abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on consumer-grade GPUs is highly cost-effective, yet constrained by limited GPU memory and slow PCIe interconnects. Pipeline parallelism combined with CPU offloading mitigates these hardware bottlenecks by reducing communication overhead. However, existing PP schedules suffer from an inherent limitation termed the weight binding issue. Binding uneven model stages (e.g., the LM head is large) to GPUs limits the pipeline's throughput to that of the GPU with the heaviest load, leading to severe pipeline bubbles.
  In this paper, we propose RoundPipe, a novel pipeline schedule that breaks the weight binding constraint on consumer GPU servers. RoundPipe treats GPUs as a pool of stateless execution workers and dynamically dispatches computation stages across devices in a round-robin manner, achieving a near-zero-bubble pipeline. To ensure training correctness and system efficiency, RoundPipe integrates a priority-aware transfer scheduling engine, a fine-grained distributed event-based synchronization protocol, and an automated layer partitioning algorithm. Evaluations on an 8$\times$ RTX 4090 server demonstrate that RoundPipe achieves 1.48--2.16$\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art baselines when fine-tuning 1.7B to 32B models. Remarkably, RoundPipe enables LoRA fine-tuning of the Qwen3-235B model with 31K sequence length on a single server.
  RoundPipe is publicly available as an open-source Python library with comprehensive documentation.

</details>


### [333] [End-to-End and Phase-Level Performance Optimization for Hyperledger Fabric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27174)
*Pavan Sollu,Aniruddha Mukherjee,Divya Pulivarthi,S. R. Eshwar,Gugan Thoppe,Kshitij Pratihast,Tittu Varghese,Hrishikesh Nashikkar,Yogesh Simmhan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究对 Hyperledger Fabric 进行了系统性、分阶段、端到端的优化研究。通过引入区块级流水线和策略性等待两种新技术（分别提升吞吐量 1.9 倍和 1.2 倍），以及对私有数据传播、区块大小、背书节点选择等配置参数进行微基准测试，揭示了优化决策的跨阶段影响规律，为企业级区块链部署提供了相位感知和协议级别的优化指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hyperledger Fabric 作为企业级模块化许可区块链，优化其吞吐量和延迟面临挑战，因为交易生命周期中一个阶段的优化决策可能对其他阶段产生负面影响，缺乏系统性的跨阶段优化研究。

Method: 采用生产级测试平台实验与 SimPy 仿真校准相结合的方式，从三个维度进行系统性研究：1）提出两种优化技术——区块级流水线（重叠验证与私有数据获取）和策略性等待（协调提交进度）；2）对三个配置参数进行微基准测试——私有数据传播、区块大小选择、背书节点选择；3）分析私有数据传播、VSCC 并行化与流水线提交之间的交互作用。

Result: 1）区块级流水线可将提交吞吐量提升最多 1.9 倍；2）策略性等待可提升吞吐量最多 1.2 倍；3）宽松的私有数据传播法定人数显著降低背书和提交阶段延迟；4）轻负载下小区块降低端到端延迟，重负载下大区块提升吞吐量并降低延迟；5）宽松的领导节点选择大幅减少交易丢弃并提升背书吞吐量，但 MVCC 冲突略有增加；6）并行化的吞吐量增益在适度并行化水平下达到最大化。

Conclusion: 提供相位感知和协议级别的优化建议，用于改进 Hyperledger Fabric 的性能表现。

Abstract: Hyperledger Fabric (HLF) is a modular, permissioned blockchain widely adopted in enterprise settings. Enhancing its throughput and latency remains challenging, as optimization decisions made in one phase of the transaction lifecycle can adversely affect other phases. In this work, we present a systematic, phase-level and end-to-end study of HLF optimizations along three fronts, combining production-grade testbed experiments with calibrated SimPy simulations. First, we introduce two novel optimization techniques that target commit-phase bottlenecks: block-level pipelining and strategic waiting. In pipelining, we overlap validation and private-data acquisition of successive blocks with state-consistency checks and ledger updates improving commit throughput by up to 1.9x. Strategic waiting coordinates commit progress by temporarily pausing fast leaders and boosting laggers to sustain endorsement parallelism, yielding up to a 1.2x higher throughput. Second, we conduct micro-benchmarking of three configuration levers: private-data dissemination, block-size selection, and endorsement peer selection. Our results reveal that: (i) Relaxed quorums for private-data dissemination significantly reduce latency in both endorsement and commit phases; (ii) Under light workloads, smaller blocks yield lower end-to-end latency, whereas, under heavy workloads, larger blocks are necessary to improve throughput and reduce latency; and (iii) Relaxed leader selection dramatically reduces dropped transactions and boosts endorsement throughput, with a modest increase in MVCC invalidations. Finally, we analyze the interplay among private-data dissemination, VSCC parallelization, and pipelined commits. Interestingly, the throughput gains over a serial commit path are maximized at a moderate level of parallelization. Together, our findings provide phase-aware and protocol-level refinements for optimizing HLF.

</details>


### [334] [Towards the Democratization and Standardization of Dynamic Resources with MPI Spawning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27430)
*Sergio Iserte,Iker Martín-Alvarez,Krzystof Rojek,José I. Aliaga,Maribel Castillo,Antonio J. Peña*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在生产级HPC环境中管理动态资源的高效工具，通过统一API和增强的DMR框架（集成Proteo重构引擎）解决传统动态资源管理的局限性，实现灵活、适应性强的资源管理，并验证了MPDATA应用的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高性能计算生产环境中，动态资源管理需要更高的灵活性、适应性和用户友好性。传统方法在支持多样化重构策略时存在局限性，需要重新生成所有进程或缺乏资源管理系统支持。

Method: 提出了统一动态资源管理API，集成DMRlib框架与Proteo重构引擎，支持多种动态资源管理器，实现无需直接交互DMR即可完成应用集成，提供模块化的重构策略选择。

Result: 增强了模块化的DMR框架支持不同的重构管理器；升级DMRlib集成Proteo重构引擎提供广泛的重构策略；开发了MPDATA求解器的可延展版本，并在性能和编程效率上展示了有效性。

Conclusion: 该解决方案成功解决了先前动态资源管理中的局限性，实现了HPC环境中灵活、适应性强的资源管理，显著提升了编程效率并为MPDATA等应用提供了可延展的求解器实现。

Abstract: This paper presents an efficient tool for managing dynamic resources in production high-performance computing (HPC) settings, focusing on flexibility, adaptability, and user-friendliness. We introduce a unified dynamic resource management application programming interface (API) that supports a wide range of HPC applications, allowing seamless integration without direct interaction with Dynamic Management of Resources (DMR). The DMR framework, evolved from the DMRlib structure, now supports various dynamic resource managers and includes the Proteo reconfiguration engine to enhance malleability strategies. This integration addresses previous limitations by allowing diverse reconfiguration methods without respawning all processes or lacking RMS support. The paper also showcases the solution's performance and coding productivity with the MPDATA (Multidimensional Positive Definite Advection Transport Algorithm) application. Key contributions include an enhanced modular DMR framework supporting different reconfiguration managers, upgraded DMRlib with the Proteo reconfiguration engine, offering extensive reconfiguration strategies, and a malleable version of the MPDATA solver.

</details>


### [335] [A Study on the Performance of Distributed Training of Data-driven CFD Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27431)
*Sergio Iserte,Alejandro González-Barberá,Paloma Barreda,Krzysztof Rojek*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究针对流体仿真场景，比较CPU、多GPU及分布式三种训练方案在时间序列预测深度学习模型上的性能差异，证明分布式GPU训练能够在保持预测精度的同时显著加速模型训练和推理过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于偏微分方程(PDE)的计算流体动力学(CFD)模拟存在计算成本高、耗时长的问题，尽管数据驱动方法可加速推理过程，但其前期训练成本仍不可忽视。

Method: 使用时间序列预测深度学习模型，通过对比CPU单机、多GPU及分布式训练三种实现方案，评估不同硬件配置下的训练性能表现。

Result: 通过少量代码适配，分布式GPU训练方案能够在极短时间内完成高精度流体状态预测，相比传统CFD求解器大幅缩短计算时间。

Conclusion: 分布式GPU训练方法能够在极短时间内实现高精度的流体状态预测，显著优于传统CFD求解器的计算效率，证明了分布式训练在科学计算场景中的实用价值。

Abstract: Data-driven methods for computer simulations are blooming in many scientific areas. The traditional approach to simulating physical behaviors relies on solving partial differential equations (PDE). Since calculating these iterative equations is highly both computationally demanding and time-consuming, data-driven methods leverage artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to alleviate that workload. Data-driven methods have to be trained in advance to provide their subsequent fast predictions, however, the cost of the training stage is non-negligible. This paper presents a predictive model for inferencing future states of a specific fluid simulation that serves as a use case for evaluating different training alternatives. Particularly, this study compares the performance of only CPU, multiGPU, and distributed approaches for training a time series forecasting deep learning (DL) model. With some slight code adaptations, results show and compare, in different implementations, the benefits of distributed GPU-enabled training for predicting high-accuracy states in a fraction of the time needed by the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver.

</details>


### [336] [Back to the Future: Rethinking Endorsement in Order-Execute Blockchains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27659)
*Rongji Huang,Yifeng Ye,Gerui Wang,Mingchao Wan,Yuxing Duan,Jingjing Zhang,Guangtao Xue,Shengyun Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了FlexTender框架，将灵活背书机制集成到传统的order-execute架构中，基于Tendermint BFT协议，通过将背书嵌入共识过程消除了高中止率问题，在DeFi场景下实现了10.6倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代许可区块链需要针对每个合约或状态对象定义独立背书策略。现有execute-order-validate (EOV)范式（如Hyperledger Fabric）在高竞争工作负载（如DeFi应用）中存在高中止率问题。而大多数区块链系统（包括ChainMaker）仍采用order-execute框架，无法直接支持灵活背书。

Method: 提出了FlexTender框架，将灵活背书机制优雅地嵌入Tendermint共识协议中。该框架能够从已排序的交易列表中确定性移除有问题的交易，同时保留剩余交易的 censorship resistance 和去中心化特性。在正常情况下不产生额外消息开销。

Result: 使用以太坊USDT工作负载进行实验评估，FlexTender在相同平台上相比EOV模拟实现了高达10.6倍的吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: FlexTender通过将背书嵌入共识过程，在不增加额外消息开销的情况下，成功将灵活背书机制引入order-execute架构，在保持去中心化和抗审查性的同时，显著提升了系统性能，为DeFi应用提供了更适用的区块链解决方案。

Abstract: Due to regulatory compliance and governance management, modern (permissioned) blockchains require flexible endorsement, which allows the endorsement policy for each contract or state object to be individually defined. To enable flexible endorsement, Hyperledger Fabric employs an execute-order-validate (EOV) paradigm, in which transactions first undergo speculative execution and endorsement, and are only then ordered and validated. Meanwhile, most blockchain systems, including the platform targeted in this work (i.e., ChainMaker), still follow a conflict-free order-execute framework. We argue that the EOV paradigm still faces several limitations, notably high abort rates in high-contention workloads such as those in Decentralized Finance (DeFi).
  To avoid refactoring our system and better suit DeFi applications, we try to integrate flexible endorsement into the classical order-execute architecture and accordingly propose a new framework. The key challenge is to deterministically remove problematic transactions from an ordered list, while preserving censorship resistance and decentralization for the remaining ones. We instantiate this framework on top of Tendermint, a seminal Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) protocol adopted in our system, and thereby propose FlexTender. By elegantly embedding endorsements into consensus, FlexTender incurs no additional messaging overhead in the normal case. Empirical evaluation using an Ethereum USDT workload demonstrates that FlexTender achieves up to $10.6\times$ speedup in throughput over an EOV simulation on the same platform.

</details>


### [337] [Monadic Presburger Predicates have Robust Population Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27767)
*Philipp Czerner,Javier Esparza,Vincent Fischer,Roland Guttenberg,Julian Pins,Simon Reilich*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了人口协议(population protocols)的抗崩溃故障稳健性(robustness)问题，证明了所有一元 Presburger 算术可表达谓词都存在稳健协议，并分析了稳健性的状态复杂度代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lossin 等人引入了协议抗对抗性崩溃故障的稳健性概念，证明了所有原子 Presburger 谓词都存在稳健协议，但未确定所有 Presburger 谓词是否都具有稳健协议。本文旨在推进这一开放问题的研究。

Method: 证明了 monadic Presburger arithmetic 中所有谓词都存在稳健协议。

Result: 成功证明了 monadic Presburger arithmetic 谓词的稳健协议存在性；分析了稳健性的状态复杂度代价，证明稳健协议与最小协议的状态数之比至少是双指数级的；证明了 Lossin 等人针对阈值谓词 x ≥ k 设计的稳健协议具有最优状态复杂度。

Conclusion: 在推进 Presburger 谓词稳健协议问题方面取得进展，证明了 monadic Presburger arithmetic 谓词可稳健决定，同时揭示了稳健性具有双指数状态复杂度代价。

Abstract: Population protocols are a model of distributed computation in which a collection of indistinguishable finite-state agents interact randomly in pairs to decide a predicate of their initial configuration. The agents decide by achieving a stable consensus on whether the predicate holds or not. It is known that population protocols can decide exactly the predicates expressible in Presburger arithmetic.
  Recently, Lossin et al. have introduced a notion of protocol robustness against adversarial crash failures. They show that all atomic Presburger predicates can be decided by robust protocols, and ask whether the same holds for every Presburger predicate. We make progress towards settling this question by proving that all predicates expressible in monadic Presburger arithmetic have robust protocols. In addition, we analyze the cost of robustness in terms of state complexity. We study the ratio between the number of states of the smallest robust protocol for a given predicate and the smallest protocol for it. We show that the cost of robustness is at least double exponential in the size of the predicate, and prove that the robust protocols by Lossin et al. for threshold predicates x >= k have optimal state complexity.

</details>


### [338] [ZipCCL: Efficient Lossless Data Compression of Communication Collectives for Accelerating LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27844)
*Wenxiang Lin,Xinglin Pan,Ruibo Fan,Shaohuai Shi,Xiaowen Chu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ZipCCL，一个面向LLM训练的无损压缩通信库。通过利用通信数据的高斯分布特性、GPU优化内核和自适应通信策略，有效突破了LLM分布式训练中的通信瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)分布式训练中通信已成为关键瓶颈。虽然已提出多种减少通信开销的方法，但无损压缩的潜力仍未被充分探索，主要因为压缩/解压缩的额外开销通常超过减少通信流量带来的收益。

Method: (1) 理论支撑的指数编码技术，利用LLM张量的高斯分布特性加速压缩，无需昂贵的在线统计；(2) GPU优化的高效压缩/解压缩内核，设计了通信感知的数据布局和流水线优化内存访问模式；(3) 自适应通信策略，根据工作负载模式和系统特性动态切换集合操作。

Result: 在64-GPU集群上使用MoE和密集Transformer模型评估，ZipCCL将通信时间减少最高1.35倍，实现端到端训练加速最高1.18倍，且对模型质量没有任何影响。

Conclusion: ZipCCL在64-GPU集群上验证了其有效性，使用MoE和密集Transformer模型进行测试，最多可减少35%的通信时间，端到端训练加速达到1.18倍，且不影响模型质量。

Abstract: Communication has emerged as a critical bottleneck in the distributed training of large language models (LLMs). While numerous approaches have been proposed to reduce communication overhead, the potential of lossless compression has remained largely underexplored since compression and decompression typically consume larger overheads than the benefits of reduced communication traffic. We observe that the communication data, including activations, gradients and parameters, during training often follows a near-Gaussian distribution, which is a key feature for data compression. Thus, we introduce ZipCCL, a lossless compressed communication library of collectives for LLM training. ZipCCL is equipped with our novel techniques: (1) theoretically grounded exponent coding that exploits the Gaussian distribution of LLM tensors to accelerate compression without expensive online statistics, (2) GPU-optimized compression and decompression kernels that carefully design memory access patterns and pipeline using communication-aware data layout, and (3) adaptive communication strategies that dynamically switch collective operations based on workload patterns and system characteristics. Evaluated on a 64-GPU cluster using both mixture-of-experts and dense transformer models, ZipCCL reduces communication time by up to 1.35$\times$ and achieves end-to-end training speedups of up to 1.18$\times$ without any impact on model quality.

</details>


### [339] [AI Inference as Relocatable Electricity Demand: A Latency-Constrained Energy-Geography Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27855)
*Xubin Luo,Yang Cheng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"能源地理"框架，把地理分布的 AI 推理视为"受延迟约束的可搬迁电力需求"：推理请求可被路由到电价更低/碳强度更低的远端算力节点，从而把用电消耗从用户侧城市转移到能源有利地区。核心对象是"能源—延迟前沿"（放宽延迟预算所解锁的边际成本与碳收益），并用一个部分锚定的风格化仿真说明不同延迟容忍度的工作负载会自排序为本地层、区域层与能源导向层三层结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 能耗讨论正从训练转向持续、分布式、地理分散的推理负载。与传统电负荷不同，推理的工作负载执行位置在一定条件下可被数字搬迁（只搬迁"耗电计算的位置"，而非传输电力本身）。已有研究多只问"如何把请求路由得更好"（碳感知路由、地理负载均衡 GLB、节能 LLM 服务栈），缺少一个更高层的问题：延迟预算如何调节对地理能源多样性的可达性，即何时路由决策在运营意义上等价于电力消费地点的重新分配。因此作者希望建立可检验的形式化框架与可复现的参考评估规范，明确其适用边界与失效条件。

Method: 构建三层架构（客户端 → 服务节点 → 计算节点）的形式化模型：任务元组 k=(u_k,s_k,τ_k,E_k,D_k,m_k)；节点属性含时变电价 P_i(t)、边际排放 MOER_i(t)、PUE_i(t)、容量 Cap_i(t)；端到端时延 L_k(i)=L^cs+m_k·L^sc+L^q+L^inf，硬 SLO 约束 L_k(i)≤τ_k；迁移摩擦 MigrationCost 分解为状态传输、KV-cache 丢失、跨区出口费、模型/检索副本复制四项；引入 legal/system 可行性掩码 F_k；求解以 α、β、γ、η 加权最小化（电费+碳成本+延迟惩罚+迁移摩擦）的二元指派问题，约束含唯一指派、容量上限与可行集屏蔽。定义运营指标：可搬迁推理需求 RID、延迟松弛的能源/碳回报 ERL/CRL、净收益判据 NB_{k,i}>0。仿真为"部分锚定风格化仿真"：10 个全球计算节点（弗吉尼亚、俄勒冈、法兰克福、伦敦、新加坡、东京、迪拜、悉尼、北京、圣保罗），跨区时延锚定 Azure 区域 RTT（缺失对用大圆距离/200 km/ms+20 ms 回退）、出口成本锚定 Azure 定价，电价部分锚定、碳强度小时级风格化；小时粒度；四类任务 A 交互/B 标准在线/C 弱实时后台/D 离线批处理；设 Local-only、Nearest-region、Price-only、Carbon-only 与 Joint 五种基线，三阶段实验（延迟扫描、任务类分层、敏感性/消融）。

Result: （i）出现非线性能源—延迟前沿：中等负载、1.4× WAN 膨胀下 Joint 策略相对 Local-only 电费降低约 8–10%，可搬迁需求从最紧约束下约 23% 升至中等约 38%、宽松时略高于 51%，但继续松弛时成本与碳收益趋于平坦甚至回落（呈两阶段机制：先解锁邻近高净收益远端，再进入高摩擦、边际收益递减区）。（ii）任务类自发分层：Class A 98.6% 留在本地、1.4% 区域、几乎无能源导向；Class B 约 77.7%/9.1%/13.2%；Class C 与 D 分别把 68.7%、79.1% 置于能源导向层——说明这种分层并非预先设定而是模型涌现。（iii）摩擦显著削弱实际搬迁：Price-only 基线 RID 50.8%、成本降低 10.7%、碳降低 11.1%；仅加出口费降至 43.6%/10.2%/8.4%；再加状态/cache 摩擦为 37.8%/9.9%/7.4%；高摩擦情形 28.9%/7.8%/5.9%。（iv）Joint 在中负载、延迟乘子 1.5 下并不全面优于单目标：其平均服务—计算时延约 61.1 ms 低于 Price-only 的 87.5 ms，迁移成本占比 2.6% 低于 4.3%，但成本/碳降幅略低，符合多目标折衷直觉。（v）主要搬迁走廊包括弗吉尼亚→俄勒冈（5.91%）、俄勒冈→弗吉尼亚（3.07%）、法兰克福→伦敦（2.39%）、新加坡→迪拜（2.02%）、弗吉尼亚→圣保罗（1.97%）。

Conclusion: 核心论断是"数字搬迁"而非"物理输电"的受约束替代：电力传输受电网物理与资本成本约束，计算搬迁主要受服务级延迟与系统/法律可行性约束，因此 AI 推理构成对电力需求地理的"部分可搬迁"机制。延迟容忍度异质性将把 AI 基础设施塑造成本地层（严格 SLO 交互）、区域层（中等 SLO 在线服务）、能源导向层（延迟容忍批量/后台）的分层地理结构，且该分层也可作为长期选址设计原则。工作负载分类因此成为与模型规模同等重要的基础设施杠杆；但框架脆弱：高度有状态负载、出口成本压过电价差、严格法律掩码、低碳区域容量不足均会削弱收益。局限包括：时延用距离近似而非真实拥塞/队列内生性，碳与负载多为风格化设定，未纳入真实部署轨迹，结果仅为结构性洞见而非生产规模预测；作者把与真实 RTT 矩阵、时变碳信号、状态局部性、法律约束及长期容量选址的连接列为未来工作。

Abstract: AI inference is becoming a persistent and geographically distributed source of electricity demand. Unlike many traditional electrical loads, inference workloads can sometimes be executed away from the user-facing service location, provided that latency, state locality, capacity, and regulatory constraints remain acceptable. This paper studies when such digital relocation of computation can be interpreted as latency-constrained relocation of electricity demand.
  We develop an energy-geography framework for geo-distributed AI inference. The framework models a three-layer architecture of clients, service nodes, and compute nodes, and formulates inference placement as a constrained optimization problem over electricity prices, marginal carbon intensity, power usage effectiveness, compute capacity, network latency, and migration frictions. The key object is the energy-latency frontier: the marginal cost and carbon benefit unlocked by relaxing inference latency budgets.
  The paper makes four contributions. First, it distinguishes physical electricity transmission from digital relocation of electricity-consuming computation. Second, it formulates a geo-distributed inference placement model with feasibility masks and migration frictions. Third, it introduces operational metrics, including relocatable inference demand, energy return on latency, carbon return on latency, and a relocation break-even condition. Fourth, it provides a transparent stylized simulation over representative global compute regions to show how heterogeneous latency tolerance separates workloads into local, regional, and energy-oriented execution layers.
  The results show that latency relaxation expands feasible geography, while migration frictions, egress costs, state locality, legal constraints, and capacity limits can sharply reduce realized benefits.

</details>


### [340] [AnTi-MiCS: Analytical Framework for Bounding Time in Embedded Mixed-Criticality Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27862)
*Behnaz Ranjbar,Akash Kumar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对混合关键级系统中低WCET确定困难的问题，提出两种方法：AnTi-MiCS通过设计时分析确定单一低WCET；MulTi-MiCS通过时间相关性分析计算多个低WCET以处理双峰分布等复杂场景。实验表明两种方法均可显著提升QoS并降低利用率浪费。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高可信度系统中，低WCET对提升处理器利用率和QoS至关重要，但确定合适的低WCET值面临挑战——过低的值会增加利用率但可能导致过多模式切换，过高则相反。此外，单个低WCET可能无法捕捉执行时间分布中的大变异（如双峰分布）。

Method: AnTi-MiCS通过设计时分析任务执行来确定合适的低WCET；MulTi-MiCS则利用后续输入之间的时间相关性，计算多个合适的低WCET以处理双峰分布等大变异场景。

Result: 在真实平台上使用嵌入式实时基准测试验证表明：相较于现有方法，AnTi-MiCS平均提升QoS达30.27%，减少利用率浪费35.89%。MulTi-MiCS相比AnTi-MiCS进一步提升QoS 6.41%，减少利用率浪费8.23%。

Conclusion: MulTi-MiCS相比AnTi-MiCS在QoS和利用率浪费方面分别提升6.41%和8.23%，验证了多WCET方法的有效性。

Abstract: In Mixed-Criticality (MC) systems, although the high Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) serves as a conservative upper bound representing the task's maximum execution time under all conditions, obtaining a low WCET is essential for representing realistic executions and improving utilization and Quality-of-Service (QoS). Nevertheless, determining appropriate low WCET(s) for lower-criticality (LO) modes poses a significant challenge. Opting for a very low value of this WCET enhances processor utilization by scheduling more tasks in LO mode. Conversely, employing a larger WCET ensures fewer mode switches, thereby enhancing QoS, albeit at the cost of processor utilization. This paper proposes an analytical approach, AnTi-MiCS, to determine the appropriate low WCET through design-time analysis of task executions. In some cases, a single low WCET may not be adequate to capture large variations in the execution time distribution, for example, in scenarios like bimodal distributions. Therefore, we further propose a scalable approach, MulTi-MiCS, to compute multiple appropriate low WCETs. This approach exploits the temporal correlation between subsequent inputs presented to the application. Experimental results, conducted on a real platform with embedded real-time benchmarks, demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed scheme, in which QoS is improved by 30.27% on average while reducing utilization waste by 35.89%, compared to existing approaches. Besides, MulTi-MiCS improves QoS by 6.41% compared to AnTi-MiCS while reducing utilization waste by 8.23%.

</details>


### [341] [The Origins of MEV: Systematic Attribution of Arbitrage Opportunity Creation at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27979)
*Andrei Seoev,Dmitry Belousov,Anastasiia Smirnova,Ksenia Kurinova,Aleksei Smirnov,Denis Fedyanin,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出MEV机会归因问题及系统框架，通过四种方法（数据驱动、模拟、系数、Shapley）识别创造套利机会的交易。在Polygon百万级区块分析中验证了机会集中于少数源交易的核心假设，揭示MEV创建的高度不均衡分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MEV代表数十亿美元的提取价值，但缺乏系统性的方法将MEV机会归因于其链上来源，导致无法量化各交易对MEV机会的贡献。

Method: 设计并评估了四种归因方法：机器人数据驱动、模拟驱动、系数驱动和Shapley值驱动方法。对Polygon超过100万块进行了大规模回顾性分析。

Result: 大多数原子套利机会可追溯到单一源交易，验证了竞争性MEV市场假设。MEV创建呈高度集中分布，少量协议产生大部分机会。

Conclusion: 研究验证了竞争性MEV市场中机会高度集中的现象，少数协议创造了大部分机会。提供了准确度、成本和可扩展性之间的方法权衡分析，为协议设计者、验证者和分析师提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) represents billions of dollars in extracted value that fundamentally shapes blockchain network dynamics and participant incentives. While research has focused on MEV extraction and mitigation, we lack systematic methods to attribute MEV opportunities to their on-chain origins. This paper formalizes the MEV opportunity attribution problem and introduces a systems framework for identifying which transactions create arbitrage opportunities and quantifying their contributions. We design and evaluate four attribution methods for atomic arbitrage on EVM-compatible networks: bot-data-driven, simulation-based, coefficient-based, and Shapley-based approaches. Through large-scale retrospective analysis spanning over one million blocks on Polygon, we demonstrate that the majority of atomic arbitrage opportunities can be traced to single source transactions, validating our central hypothesis about competitive MEV markets. We quantify a highly concentrated distribution of MEV creation, where a small subset of protocols generates most opportunities, and provide comparative analysis of method trade-offs in accuracy, cost, and scalability. Our findings offer insights for protocol designers reducing MEV leakage, validators optimizing transaction ordering, and analysts measuring ecosystem health through opportunity creation.

</details>


### [342] [Exploring Sparse Matrix Multiplication Kernels on the Cerebras CS-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27985)
*Milan Shah,Sheng Di,Michela Becchi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文探索了Cerebras CS-3加速器上的稀疏线性代数内核（SpMM和SDDMM），提出低层内核设计并优化I/O、内存和可扩展性。结果显示CS-3在90%稀疏度下可相比CPU获得20-100×加速，但在极端稀疏度（>99%）下性能会下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cerebras CS-3作为新兴AI加速器，在密集计算方面已有充分探索，但稀疏工作负载的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。GNN、线性求解器和推荐系统等应用需要稀疏线性代数内核，具备在数据流加速器上实现良好性能的潜力。

Method: 提出了针对CS-3的低层内核设计，实现SpMM和SDDMM操作，并通过优化I/O性能、内存占用和大规模矩阵的可扩展性来提升性能。

Result: SpMM：90%稀疏度矩阵相比CPU最高加速100×，且随矩阵维度增大性能提升；SDDMM：90%稀疏度矩阵相比CPU最高加速20×；但在稀疏度超过99%时，CS-3性能出现退化，反而慢于CPU。

Conclusion: CS-3在适度稀疏度（90%）的矩阵上可获得显著加速，但在极端稀疏度（>99%）下性能会下降，甚至慢于CPU。需要进一步优化以应对超高稀疏场景。

Abstract: In recent years, novel AI accelerators have emerged as promising alternatives to GPU for AI model training and inference tasks. One such accelerator, the Cerebras CS-3, achieves strong performance on large model training as well as scientific applications like molecular dynamics simulations. While dense compute workloads have been thoroughly explored for the CS-3, its potential for sparse workloads has not been fully examined. Applications requiring sparse linear algebra kernels, such as GNNs, linear solvers, and recommendation systems, could achieve good performance on a dataflow accelerator like the CS-3.
  In this work, we explore two key sparse linear algebra kernels, sparse-dense matrix multiplication (SpMM) and sampled dense-dense matrix multiplication (SDDMM), on the Cerebras CS-3. We propose low-level CS-3 kernel designs for these operations and optimize our designs to improve I/O performance, memory footprint, and scalability to large matrices. Our evaluation examines memory footprint and SpMM/SDDMM speedup relative to CPU. The evaluation suggests that the CS-3 can outperform CPU by 100$\times$ for SpMM with 90\% sparse matrices with performance improving as sparse matrix dimensionality increases. SDDMM on CS-3 can outperform CPU 20$\times$ for 90\% sparse matrices. We additionally find that as sparsity increases to beyond 99\%, the CS-3 suffers from performance degradation that makes it slower than CPU for SpMM.

</details>


### [343] [From Impermanent Loss to Sustainable Gain: Quantifying Profitability Zones for Liquidity Providers on DEX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28014)
*Ignat Melnikov,Roman Vlasov,Vladimir Gorgadze,Andrey Seoev,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对AMM型DEX swap协议，建立数学模型分析套利者与流动性池的交互，推导LP-套利者联合收益边界、IL发生时间估计方法及IG区间保持的最低费率要求，为LP风险评估和DeFi协议费用设计提供量化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeFi的DEX swap协议虽提供灵活的代币兑换，但新机制引入的市场非效率性可被套利者系统性利用。现有LP风险评估方法缺乏对AMM流动性池与套利者共生关系的系统性量化理解，尤其在无常损（IL）预测和费用选择缺乏原则性依据。

Method: 1) 基于AMM不变量（储备金乘积守恒）建立数学模型；2) 采用实证池配置数据 grounding the model；3) 量化分析套利者与流动性池的交互动态；4) 推导LP-套利者联合收益边界、IL发生区块期望数量、IG区间保持概率与手续费的定量关系。

Result: 1) 推导出LP与套利者联合收益的边界条件；2) 建立了估计IL发生期望区块数的方法；3) 确定了在单区块内保持IG（无常利）区间所需的最低费率下界。

Conclusion: 该框架通过量化共生盈利区间，为费用选择提供了原则性依据，可协调LP与套利者的激励相容性，并增强市场稳定性。核心贡献在于将LP风险评估从定性描述推进到定量建模层面，为DeFi协议设计和流动性激励机制提供了理论工具。

Abstract: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) is a rapidly evolving segment of blockchain technology that enables a transformative approach to financial services through Web3 applications. By leveraging smart contracts, DeFi allows developers to build flexible and innovative financial instruments. Among the most prominent DeFi primitives by liquidity are decentralized exchange~(DEX) swap protocols~(such as Uniswap, Curve, and Balancer) that facilitate fast token-to-token exchanges. However, new exchange mechanisms also introduce new market inefficiencies that can be systematically exploited by arbitrageurs. This paper focuses on swap protocols based on the Automated Market Maker~(AMM), where the product of reserves is preserved as an invariant. We analyze the interaction between arbitrageurs and AMM liquidity pools and develop a mathematical model grounded in empirical pool configurations. Using this model, we derive bounds on the joint revenue of liquidity providers~(LPs) and arbitrageurs, propose a method to estimate the expected number of blocks until the occurrence of Impermanent Loss~(IL), and obtain a lower bound on the pool fee required to achieve a fixed target probability of staying in the Impermanent Gain (IG) zone within a block. The proposed framework extends existing LP risk-assessment methodologies by quantifying symbiotic profitability zones, providing a principled basis for fee selection that aligns LP-arbitrageur incentives and enhances market stability.

</details>


### [344] [Characterizing Path-Independent Fees: A Route to Zero Impermanent Loss in CPMMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28017)
*Andrey Voronin,Roman Vlasov,Vladimir Gorgadze,Andrey Seoev,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文研究了常数乘积做市商（CPMM）中费用结构对交易路径依赖性的影响，证明了路径无关性的充要条件是组合费用因子仅依赖池不变量k=xy，并在此条件下推导了动态方程和封闭交换公式，同时构造了可消除特定初始状态无常损失的参数化费用函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Uniswap V2及Uniswap V4等自动复利型设计中，交易费用自动再投资导致最终池状态取决于拆分为小交易的路径，产生了路径依赖性。这一特性使流动性提供者风险评估复杂化，并影响组合性保证，需要从原理上理解和解决该问题。

Method: 通过定义组合费用因子仅依赖于当前池不变量k=xy的函数类，刻画了确保路径无关性的费用结构条件；在此类上推导了描述池动态的常微分方程组，获得了封闭形式的积分交换公式；通过受控仿真验证理论。

Result: 证明组合费用因子仅依赖当前池不变量k=xy是确保路径无关的充要条件；推导出池动态的常微分方程系统和封闭形式积分交换公式；构造了可对给定初始池状态消除无常损失的参数化费用函数族；证明不存在能消除所有初始状态无常损失的通用费用函数。

Conclusion: 研究者构建了一族可消除初始池状态无常损失的参数化费用函数，并严格证明了不存在能同时消除所有初始状态无常损失的通用费用函数。该框架为协议设计者提供了费用优化的原则性方法，可协调流动性提供者与交易者激励并保持组合性。

Abstract: Constant Product Market Makers use fees that are typically fixed proportions of trade size. When these fees are automatically reinvested into the pool, as in Uniswap~V2 and some designs of Uniswap V4, the final state after a trade can depend on how the trade is split into smaller transactions. This path dependence complicates the risk assessment for liquidity providers and affects composability guarantees. We characterize the functional class of fee structures that ensure path independence: the combined fee factor must depend only on the current pool invariant k=xy. For this class, we derive a system of ordinary differential equations governing pool dynamics and obtain a closed-form integral exchange formula. Within this class, we construct a parametric family of fee functions that achieve zero Impermanent Loss for a given initial pool state, and prove that no universal fee function can eliminate Impermanent Loss for all initial states simultaneously. We analyze implications for arbitrage windows and slippage, and validate our theory through controlled simulations. Our framework provides protocol designers with a principled approach to fee optimization that aligns liquidity provider and trader incentives while preserving composability.

</details>


### [345] [Akita: A High Usability Simulation Framework for Computer Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28073)
*Sabila Al Jannat,Ying Li,Mengyang He,Xuzhong Wang,Huizhi Zhao,Jingxiang Sun,Daoxuan Xu,Enze Xu,Yifan Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Akita模拟引擎，通过将技术基础设施与硬件模型解耦，解决了现有模拟器在接口规范、部署、性能优化和可视化方面的局限。核心创新包括Smart Ticking、Availability Backpropagation和透明并行化，最终通过DNN和RISC-V模拟器案例验证了优先考虑开发者体验的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前计算机架构模拟器存在四大核心问题：组件接口不规范、部署要求严格、性能优化负担重、监控可视化能力弱。这些问题的根本原因是过度关注技术功能而忽视用户和开发者体验。

Method: Akita作为专用的模拟引擎，实现了基础设施与硬件模型的解耦。关键技术包括：Smart Ticking和Availability Backpropagation实现事件驱动性能；透明并行化处理让开发者无需关心多核执行细节；统一的追踪支持实现实时监控和可视化。

Result: 通过两个案例研究验证了Akita的灵活性：开发了基于追踪的DNN模拟器以及RISC-V CPU模拟器，证明了优先考虑开发者体验能够加速架构研究。

Conclusion: 通过将技术问题与用户体验分离，专门的模拟引擎能够显著提升计算机架构研究的效率。Akita展示了这种设计理念的可行性，通过简化开发流程和透明并行化，使研究者能够更快速地进行架构探索。

Abstract: Computer architecture simulation is essential for evaluating new designs without the need for costly tapeout. The community has developed dozens of valuable simulators that have enabled significant architectural advances. However, using and developing simulators remains a major barrier due to ad-hoc component interfaces, strict deployment requirements, the burden of managing performance optimizations like parallelization at the component level, and limited monitoring and visualization capabilities. The root cause of these limitations is the systematic neglect of user and developer experience in favor of technical functionality. We believe that only by separating technical concerns from user and developer experience concerns -- through a dedicated simulation engine decoupled from hardware models -- can the community overcome these fundamental obstacles and enable more productive architectural research.
  Akita embodies this philosophy as a dedicated simulation engine that cleanly separates infrastructure from architectural models. Smart Ticking and Availability Backpropagation let developers write simple cycle-based code while achieving event-driven performance. Parallel simulation happens transparently -- developers write single-threaded code while Akita handles multi-core execution. Akita's simple, uniform, yet powerful simulation tracing support enables real-time monitoring and post-simulation visualization. We demonstrate the flexibility of Akita through case studies, including the development of a trace-based DNN simulation and a RISC-V CPU simulation, showing how prioritizing developer experience accelerates architectural research.

</details>


### [346] [Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09718)
*Jagadeesh Chundru*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文提出「编译-执行（Compile-and-Execute）」架构解决连续推理式 Web Agent 的「Rerun Crisis（重跑危机）」：在重复性结构化任务中，把 LLM 推理从执行循环中剥离，仅用一次 LLM 调用把用户意图 + 清洗后的 DOM 骨架编译成确定性的 JSON 工作流蓝图，再由轻量运行时零推理地驱动浏览器。推理成本从 O(M×N) 降为摊销 O(1)，5 步工作流跑 500 次由约 $150（激进缓存后约 $15）降至 $0.002–$0.092。5 个前沿模型上零样本编译成功率 80–94%，配合人机协同（HITL）补丁后可靠性接近 100%。局限：依赖语义化 DOM，不适用于 canvas/WebGL 视觉渲染界面；评测基于企业内网私有页面，缺公共基准对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流 Web 智能体（ReAct、CoT 等连续推理循环）在每一步都要调用 LLM 观察 DOM 并选择动作，对"逻辑结构固定、仅重复执行"的确定性工作流而言是把概率性推理反复用于已解问题，属于结构性低效。作者将其命名为 Rerun Crisis：token 消耗与 API 延迟随执行频次线性增长（O(M×N)，M 为重跑次数，N 为串行动作数），使企业级高频自动化在经济上不可行。社区开源连续 Agent 单任务成本 $1.00–$3.20，批量场景动辄上千美元，而传统 RPA 只需几分钱。作者主张这不是"定价问题"而是架构缺陷，因此不提出新学习算法，而是做系统级架构转变：把 LLM 当作编译器而非持续决策者，将关注点从提示词优化转向结构性高效执行范式。

Method: 三阶段管线：(1) 上下文优化——DOM Sanitization Module (DSM)，单次 DOM 遍历完成噪声清除（script/style/svg/base64）、信号提取（剔除 display:none / visibility:hidden 节点）、属性清洗（剥离易变工具类 CSS，保留 ARIA 角色、data-* 等语义标识），token 压缩最高 85%；(2) 一次性 LLM 编译——将净化骨架、页面 URL、用户意图在单次调用中转为确定性 JSON 蓝图，系统提示强制"语义选择器优先级"（优先 ARIA/data-*/稳定类，避免 nth-child 位置路径），并在同一次推理中完成分页识别、循环构造与抽取映射；(3) 监督式确定性执行——轻量运行时按蓝图调用原生浏览器 API，零推理；采用 DOM 变更事件与网络空闲等动态等待启发式替代固定 sleep。编译与执行之间插入 HITL 验证门（可接受/拒绝/手动修补），并支持 Lazy Replanning：仅当选择器失效、执行中断或抽取结果违反 schema 时，捕获变异 DOM 触发定向选择器修复，LLM 只作异常处理器而不接管控制流，因此推理成本为 O(R)（R 为 UI 结构波动次数）而非 O(M×N)。作者用编译器理论做映射：自然语言意图=源代码，LLM=编译器，JSON 蓝图=字节码/IR，运行时=执行环境。

Result: 成本模型：连续式 Cost_cont = M×Σ(S_i×C_t)，编译式 Cost_oneshot = 1×(S_compile×C_t)+C_exec。以 5 字段×500 条目、每页 20k token DOM 估算：无优化连续基线约 $150，90% 缓存优化基线约 $15，一次性编译 $0.002–$0.10，相对连续 Agent 最高约 1500× 降本。五个模型单次编译成本：Claude Opus 4.6 $0.0916（11,628→1,340 tok, 96.9 TPS）、Claude Sonnet 4.5 $0.0599、GPT-5.2-Codex $0.0377、Qwen3.5 397B $0.0172、Qwen3 Coder Next $0.0020，均生成语法有效可执行 JSON；Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 Claude 3.5 Haiku 因系统性编译失败被排除（源于推理深度不足而非成本）。任务评测：T1 分页高量抽取 50 次编译成功 46（92%）、执行准确率 98%；T2 表单填充 10 次成功 8（80%）、准确率 95%；T3 技术栈指纹识别 50 次成功 47（94%）、准确率 96%。失败被归为三类：Schema 违规、语义错配（选到醒目但不可交互节点）、推理深度耗尽（复杂表单多步条件依赖），说明瓶颈在 LLM 空间推理而非确定性执行引擎。经 HITL 局部修补后整体可靠性接近 100%，且不破坏 O(1) 成本性质。

Conclusion: 论文主张：确定性编译是解决重复性、结构化、DOM 友好型企业工作流经济性瓶颈的合适范式，可将大规模自动化从"不可行"变为"可行"，且 O(1) 成本保证属架构性、永久性，精度将随基座模型能力提升自然改善；架构在编译层与模型无关，不主张取代连续式 Agent 在易变或视觉渲染场景的优势（此类仍应使用多模态探索型 Agent，如 Explorer）。同时提出该范式可推广到任何"规划可与执行解耦"的确定性可重复工作流。局限与展望：依赖语义化 HTML 结构，不适用于 canvas/WebGL 等视口驱动界面（约 80% 企业工作流适用）；因使用私有企业 DOM 而无法独立复现，故未与 WebArena/Mind2Web 等公共基准直接对比；未来方向为自动重编译、引入轻量 DOM 变更检测以减少不必要重编译、以及在易变 UI 上做成本-可靠性权衡的公共基准评测。

Abstract: LLM-driven web agents operating through continuous inference loops -- repeatedly querying a model to evaluate browser state and select actions -- exhibit a fundamental scalability constraint for repetitive tasks. We characterize this as the Rerun Crisis: the linear growth of token expenditure and API latency relative to execution frequency. For a 5-step workflow over 500 iterations, a continuous agent incurs approximately 150.00 USD in inference costs; even with aggressive caching, this remains near 15.00 USD. We propose a Compile-and-Execute architecture that decouples LLM reasoning from browser execution, reducing per-workflow inference cost to under 0.10 USD. A one-shot LLM invocation processes a token-efficient semantic representation from a DOM Sanitization Module (DSM) and emits a deterministic JSON workflow blueprint. A lightweight runtime then drives the browser without further model queries. We formalize this cost reduction from O(M x N) to amortized O(1) inference scaling, where M is the number of reruns and N is the sequential actions. Empirical evaluation across data extraction, form filling, and fingerprinting tasks yields zero-shot compilation success rates of 80-94%. Crucially, the modularity of the JSON intermediate representation allows minimal Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) patching to elevate execution reliability to near-100%. At per-compilation costs between 0.002 USD and 0.092 USD across five frontier models, these results establish deterministic compilation as a paradigm enabling economically viable automation at scales previously infeasible under continuous architectures.

</details>

### [347] [Graphify: Automated Synthesis of Type-Safe Graph Backends via $O(S)$ GraphQL-to-Gremlin Transpilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27223)
*Johannes Graf*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Graphify是一个端到端框架，通过可视化的方式建模图数据模式，并自动生成完全可用、类型安全的图数据库后端。该系统提出GraphQL到Gremlin遍历的正式映射，采用递归状态机算法（时间复杂度O(S)）将复杂GraphQL查询转译为单一优化的Gremlin查询，支持嵌套谓词、多键排序和分页等功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Graph databases offer flexibility for managing interconnected data but lack strict schema enforcement, leading to runtime uncertainties and complex query development.

Method: The paper proposes a formal mapping from GraphQL artifacts to Gremlin traversal machine, using a recursive state machine algorithm that processes GraphQL ASTs with O(S) linear complexity relative to selected fields. The system generates a transpiler that converts complex GraphQL requests into optimized single Gremlin queries with features like nested predicates, multi-key sorting, and pagination.

Result: Empirical evaluation using MovieLens 100k dataset and formal complexity analysis demonstrate practical efficiency and theoretical robustness of the approach.

Conclusion: Graphify bridges the gap between flexible graph storage and type-safe API consumption, enabling graph interface generation in minutes.

Abstract: Graph databases offer unparalleled flexibility for managing interconnected data, yet the lack of strict schema enforcement often leads to runtime uncertainties and complex query development. This paper introduces Graphify, an end-to-end framework that enables developers to visually model graph data schemas and automatically synthesize a fully functional, type-safe backend. This paper proposes a formal mapping of GraphQL artifacts to the Gremlin traversal machine, supporting complete CRUD operations and arbitrarily nested queries. The system generates a transpiler capable of converting complex GraphQL requests into a single, optimized Gremlin query, including advanced features such as nested logical predicates, multi-key sorting, and pagination. At the core of the framework is a recursive state machine algorithm that processes GraphQL Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) with linear time complexity $O(S)$ relative to the number of selected fields. This paper demonstrates the practical efficiency and theoretical robustness of the approach through formal complexity analysis and empirical evaluation using the MovieLens 100k dataset. The result is a system that enables the generation of graph interfaces in minutes, bridging the gap between flexible graph storage and type-safe API consumption.

</details>


### [348] [Unified Data Discovery across Query Modalities and User Intents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27252)
*Tingting Wang,Shixun Huang,Zhifeng Bao,J. Shane Culpepper,Shazia Sadiq,Volkan Dedeoglu,Reza Arablouei*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: UniDisc是一个统一的数据发现框架，通过异构图和双视图邻居聚合学习跨模态统一表示，支持自然语言和表格两种查询模态，并在有限标注数据条件下利用数据湖中的上下文信号实现泛化的相关性评估，在7个数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据发现方法仅针对单一查询模态（自然语言或表格）或特定用户意图设计，泛化能力受限。而实际应用需要同时支持多种查询模态和多样化意图（如开放域 enrichment、任务驱动推理、表问答和事实验证）。

Method: UniDisc构建异构图将自然语言语句和表格建模为节点，通过双视图邻居聚合（dual-view neighbor aggregation）和联合优化学习鲁棒的上下文感知表示。该表示支持检索阶段的灵活相关性估计，无需意图特定的表示或建模。

Result: 在7个数据集上的实验表明，UniDisc在自然语言查询和表格查询两种数据发现任务上均一致性地优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: UniDisc通过统一表示学习解决跨模态、跨意图的数据发现问题，在无需特定意图建模的情况下实现灵活的相关性估计，证明了基于上下文信号的表示学习在数据发现任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Data discovery - retrieving relevant tables from a data lake in response to user queries - is a fundamental building block for downstream analytics. In practice, data discovery must support different query modalities, including natural language (NL) statements and tables, and accommodate diverse user intents, ranging from open-ended enrichment to task-driven inference for applications such as table question answering and fact verification. However, most existing methods are designed for a single query modality or a specific user intent, limiting their generalizability. We propose UniDisc, a unified data discovery framework that supports both NL statements and tables as queries and generalizes across diverse user intents without intent-specific representations or relevance modeling. UniDisc learns a common cross-modal representation model that produces unified representations for queries of different modalities and candidate tables, enabling uniform relevance assessment across discovery scenarios. Since learning such a model typically requires large labeled collections of query-table pairs, which are expensive to obtain, UniDisc instead exploits contextual signals naturally available in data lakes. Specifically, it models NL statements and tables as nodes in a heterogeneous graph with multiple edge types, and applies dual-view neighbor aggregation and joint optimization to learn robust, context-aware representations under limited supervision. These representations support flexible relevance estimation during retrieval. Experiments on seven datasets show that UniDisc consistently outperforms strong baselines on both NL- and table-based discovery.

</details>


### [349] [SynSQL: Synthesizing Relational Databases for Robust Evaluation of Text-to-SQL Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27261)
*Mohammadamin Habibollah,Davood Rafiei*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出SynSQL框架，通过问题-模式对齐条件合成测试数据库来评估文本到SQL系统。框架包含模式选择、问题引导数据合成、约束感知批判三阶段。在10个模型和3个基准测试上的实验表明，合成数据库能揭示3-14%的额外错误，证明了现有评估方法的局限性，并为研究LLM在结构化环境中的能力提供了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文本到SQL系统的评估存在根本性缺陷：仅在单一静态数据库上执行预测SQL与金标准SQL进行正确性判断，但相同SQL在不同数据库实例下可能表现出不同的行为。这导致评估无法发现被基准测试人工产物（artifact）所掩盖的错误。核心问题是LLM能否直接从自然语言问题合成语义一致、模式一致的关联数据。

Method: SynSQL采用三阶段结构化生成框架：(1) 模式选择，从候选模式中选择相关表和字段；(2) 问题引导的数据合成，根据选定模式和自然语言问题生成数据库内容；(3) 约束感知批判与迭代细化，通过语义和关联约束验证生成数据的质量，确保schema一致性和问题相关性。整个过程将数据库构建形式化为结构化生成任务。

Result: 实验覆盖10个文本到SQL模型（Spider、BIRD、Spider 2.0），SynSQL生成的数据库揭示了相对于静态评估3-14%的性能下降，成功暴露了被基准测试伪影掩盖的错误。研究还分析了生成质量、约束遵守情况和失败模式。

Conclusion: SynSQL框架通过问题-模式对齐而非金标准SQL来合成测试数据库，在Spider、BIRD和Spider 2.0三个基准上揭示了10个文本到SQL模型3-14%的性能下降，有效暴露了基准测试伪影掩盖的错误。该工作将合成数据库生成定位为研究LLM在结构化环境中推理能力、可控性和鲁棒性的新视角。

Abstract: Evaluating text-to-SQL systems remains largely fragile: correctness is typically judged by executing predicted and gold SQL queries on a single static database, even though the same queries may behave differently under alternative database instances. This raises a broader language modeling question: Can large language models synthesize semantically meaningful, schema-consistent relational data directly from a natural language question? If so, such generation can serve as a controlled mechanism for stress-testing text-to-SQL systems beyond fixed benchmark databases. We introduce SynSQL, a framework that synthesizes test databases conditioned on question-schema alignment rather than gold SQL queries. SynSQL decomposes the task into three stages: (1) schema selection, (2) question-guided data synthesis, and (3) constraint-aware critique with iterative refinement, framing database construction as structured generation under semantic and relational constraints. Across ten text-to-SQL models on Spider, BIRD, and Spider 2.0, SynSQL-generated databases reveal performance drops of 3-14% compared to static evaluation, exposing errors masked by benchmark artifacts. We further analyze generation quality, constraint adherence, and failure modes, highlighting both the promise and limitations of LLMs in structured data synthesis. Our findings position synthetic database generation as a new lens for studying LLM reasoning, controllability, and robustness in structured environments.

</details>


### [350] [Tailwind: A Practical Framework for Query Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28079)
*Geoffrey X. Yu,Ryan Marcus,Tim Kraska*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Tailwind 是一个"外挂式"的查询规划器/执行框架：只要 RDBMS 支持数据导入导出（Redshift、DuckDB 等），即可在不修改数据库内核的前提下自动把用户自定义的"查询加速器"（query accelerator，如领域取反、CDF 累积聚合、已知分组硬编码、有序索引、top-k 下推、稀疏物化视图等）插入查询计划，并在预测有收益时使用、否则回退原数据库。核心抽象是抽象逻辑计划 ALP（基于带参数的正规树表达式），统一承担三件事：描述加速器可替换的逻辑子计划、向加速器实现暴露查询特定参数、为性能建模提供特征结构。三个案例研究中几何平均加速比分别达 1.38×、1.76×、1.28×，单查询最高 29×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用 RDBMS 以通用性换取性能，在特定工作负载上往往慢于专用实现；研究者称这类针对特定查询模式的专用化技术为"查询加速器"。其落地困难在于：集成代价（需改动优化器、代价模型、执行引擎、内存与存储层）带来的"爆炸半径"大、可能引入 bug、难以上游与维护，且收益往往局限于单条查询；而数据库扩展（extension）与 UDF/UDO 机制要么几乎无优化器支持、需要用户自行判断并手写查询改写，要么仍需改动引擎内核，并且把加速器耦合到特定 RDBMS，跨库复用困难。缺失的是一种可移植、非侵入、且能自动判断"何时/何处"使用加速器的机制。此外，现有的查询计划模式抽象（如抽象算子树、Calcite 规则）表达能力不足：前者只能表达一元算子的可变长重复，无法匹配左深连接等二元算子嵌套；后者规则深度固定，无法匹配任意深度的过滤链。

Method: 系统整体为"离线学习 + 在线代理"两阶段。\n\n1) ALP 抽象：每个 ALP 由（a）模板——带参数的正规树表达式（RTE）加上三类新增构造：类型化变量 Var(x;τ)（含列引用、表引用、表表达式、列表达式、布尔表达式五类）、带标识符的分支 Alt、以及重复 Rep（内部实现为 RTE 的 Kleene 星与拼接）；（b）校验器 is_valid(match_inst, schema)->bool，用于表达非正则/语义约束（如主外键连接）。同一变量多次出现必须解析为同值，重复的每次实例开新作用域；每个变量/分支/重复须标明"实例化时解析"或"在线解析"。ALP 可表达任意可判定的逻辑子计划模式。\n\n2) 与实现接口：加速器需实现 alp()、build(match_inst, ctx)->State（做预计算，如计算未过滤聚合）、run(state, match_inst, input, ctx)->Output，数据交换使用 Arrow 格式；匹配结果 match_inst 给出变量取值、分支选项、重复次数及各次重复内的变量/分支取值。\n\n3) 性能建模：把 ALP 模板编码为树结构神经网络——每个参数化构造、重复、分支各配一个编码 MLP，内部节点做平均池化后过内部 MLP，分支拼接 one-hot，重复做逐元素求和并拼接重复次数，根部接输出 MLP 预测运行时间。推理沿模板自底向上构造嵌入。\n\n4) 匹配与解析：ALP 编译为非确定有限树自动机（NFTA），在查询计划转换成的 e-graph（等饱和）上做自顶向下匹配；两项关键扩展：遍历 e-class 内所有 e-node 寻找可匹配根；拒绝同时含状态环与 e-class 环的匹配路径（仅拒其一均不正确）。变量解析取其 e-class 中最小树表达式，分支由匹配到的输出状态判定，重复用发现/完成逻辑时间戳定位嵌套归属。匹配成功即向对应 e-class 插入加速器 e-node，随后按 e-class 递归取子选项笛卡尔积枚举执行方案。\n\n5) 离线规划（实例选择）：从用户提供的查询日志中匹配 ALP 枚举候选实例，再以"预测运行时间下降/空间占用"为归一化收益做贪心选择，受空间预算约束（复杂度 O(n²)）；同时利用 ALP 反向生成加速器实例以采集训练数据（先定重复次数与分支选项，再自底向上按可用列/表达式策略采样变量值，过校验器），每加速器约 1 万样本，训练/验证/测试 80/10/10。\n\n6) 在线规划与执行：Tailwind 作为数据库代理接收查询，匹配已实例化的加速器 ALP，枚举所有使用方案，分别预测加速器运行时间（学习模型）、数据传输时间（线性模型 max(S/k_i+S/k_e, C)，常数离线标定，Redshift 经 S3、DuckDB 进程内可忽略）、剩余查询时间（按算子与基数之比对裸查询时间缩放），求和取最快方案；不划算则回退原 RDBMS。整体基于 Rust 实现约 6.5 万行代码。写入处理：批量写入后先回退 RDBMS，后台重建加速器状态，增量维护留作未来工作。

Result: 三个案例研究（基线为"匹配即用"的朴素策略）：\n\n• TPC-H（SF=100，10%/1% 空间预算）：Redshift 1.32×/1.21×，DuckDB 1.38×/1.33×（几何平均）；加速来自 CDF(Q1、Q4)、有序索引(Q18、Q19)、领域取反(Q13)；Q1 中已知分组加速器虽可用但 CDF 收益更大，模型选择正确；DuckDB Q18 的小幅回退源于剩余查询运行时间误预测，可缓存错误决策修正。\n• TPC-H-Plus（20 个由 TPC-H 片段合并的模板，含大量"匹配但会变慢"的查询）：Redshift 1.37×/1.49×，DuckDB 1.76×/1.78×；多加速器协同的查询平均达 Redshift 5.62×、DuckDB 4.60×；DuckDB 上因传输开销低更敢于使用"已知分组"加速器，Redshift 上会主动规避，体现出对底层引擎的适配。\n• SQLStorm Stack Overflow（240GB 真实数据，约 18k 查询中采样并筛出 356 条在两引擎 60s 内完成的查询，10GB 预算≈4.5%）：Redshift 1.28×、DuckDB 1.27×，收益主要来自 top-k 下推（利用 schema 领域知识保证正确性）与徽章物化视图（稀疏表优化降低倾斜分布下的空间占用）。\n\n对照实验显示朴素"匹配即用"策略最低仅 0.46×，且随预算增大持续恶化（Redshift 上数据传输常超过整查询耗时，DuckDB 上误用领域取反导致处理更多数据）。\n\n模型评估：ALP 神经网络在所有加速器上取得最低 p90 Q-error（如领域取反-Redshift p50/p90 = 1.43/3.36，优于 MLP 的 2.25/6.96 与回归森林的 1.99/8.50），且一种特征化方式通用全部加速器；端到端上非平凡学习模型取得最高加速比，ALP NN 在 4 个"引擎×负载"组合中的 3 个最优。空间预算敏感性：加速比随预算增大而上升，0.01% 预算即有收益。鲁棒性：对查询运行时间预测误差在 Q-error ≤ 3.0 内保持大部分收益（Redshift 上 TPC-H+ 约 1.6），与现有运行时间预测器精度相当。规划开销：除一个案例外均低于 5%（Redshift p50 65–75ms、p90 109–202ms；DuckDB p50 4–5ms、p90 14ms–528ms），短查询场景可通过后台优化+缓存计划缓解。写入影响：重建耗时为 Redshift TPC-H 47 秒、DuckDB TPC-H 25 分钟、Redshift TPC-H-Plus 2 分钟、DuckDB TPC-H-Plus 约 1 小时，故每日批量 ETL 写入影响可忽略，分钟级高频写入则收益趋近 1.0×。附录还证明 ALP 严格强于抽象算子树（任意深左深内连接可由重复表达，抽象算子树不可），并给出 ALP 网络跨数据集规模泛化优于 MLP 的证据。

Conclusion: ALP 与 Tailwind 提供了一套"既保持 RDBMS 通用性、又获得专用化性能"的实用路径：ALP 作为统一抽象，同时充当加速器的适用性声明、与实现的接口（参数绑定）与性能建模的特征来源，避免了为每个加速器手写匹配代码与手工设计特征；Tailwind 则以代理层实现非侵入式集成，在有收益时"外科手术式"地把加速器插入计划并在必要时透明回退，从而把加速器集成的爆炸半径限制在框架之外。实验证明该框架在开源与闭源引擎（Redshift、DuckDB）、合成与真实负载上均能带来稳定几何平均加速（TPC-H 1.38×、TPC-H-Plus 1.76×、SQLStorm 1.28×），且性能模型能有效规避加速器引入的退化、适配不同引擎的传输特性。局限与未来方向：加速器选择采用贪心且复杂度 O(n²)（自动物化视图/索引选择问题本身 NP-hard）；未处理加速器之间复杂的交互效应；假设已有可用的基数估计器与查询运行时间预测器；批量写入后需整体重建（增量状态维护未实现）；每加速器约 1 万训练样本的开销可调；与查询引擎自动合成、LLM 生成加速器等方向互补且可结合；由于加速器是可能的带状态组件并需在数据库外运行，其语义正确性责任由加速器构建者承担。

Abstract: Relational database management systems (RDBMSes) can process general-purpose queries, but often have lower performance compared to custom-built solutions for specific queries. For example, consider a group-by query over a few known groups (e.g., grouping by country). While an RDBMS would likely use a hash map to do the grouping, a faster method could hard-code the expected groups into the query executor. But such workload-specific techniques, which we call query accelerators, are not widely used in practice because the engineering effort (optimizer and engine changes, potential bugs) does not justify the isolated performance gains (speedup on a single specific query). We propose Tailwind: an external query planner that brings accelerators into any RDBMS that supports data import/export. Users define their accelerators using abstract logical plans (ALPs): a new mostly-declarative abstraction over relational operators built on regular tree expressions. ALPs allow Tailwind to automatically build customized neural network models to estimate when using a particular accelerator is beneficial. At runtime, Tailwind sits atop an RDBMS and transparently rewrites queries to run across one or more accelerators when predicted to be beneficial, falling back to the underlying RDBMS when not. On Redshift and DuckDB with a library of four diverse accelerators, Tailwind accelerates TPC-H queries by 1.38x on average (up to 29x).

</details>


### [351] [Index-Assisted Stratified Sampling for Online Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28141)
*Yunnan Yu,Zhuoyue Zhao*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了用于在线聚合的索引辅助分层采样方法，通过两阶段采样框架解决近似查询处理中高方差数据导致的高采样成本问题。该方法在第一阶段同时执行在线聚合和优化未来采样成本，第二阶段使用优化后的分层继续聚合。实验表明该方法相比均匀采样最高提升3倍，相比基于扫描的分层采样最高提升98708倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时数据分析中对频繁更新数据的即席查询需要极低延迟。现有索引辅助S-AQP系统虽然支持在线聚合，但当数据分布方差大或选择性强时，为达到目标置信区间所需的采样成本过高，导致查询延迟增加。经典Neyman分层采样虽理论上可最小化样本量，但在索引辅助S-AQP系统中面临三个挑战：需要先验统计、优化成本高、以及基于样本量的采样成本模型不准确。

Method: 设计了索引辅助分层采样框架，采用两阶段采样策略。第一阶段样本同时用于在线聚合和优化未来采样成本；第二阶段使用优化后的分层继续在线聚合。针对索引采样成本模型，证明了最优分层和样本量分配策略。设计了贪心算法和动态规划算法以平衡优化成本与成本降低效果。

Result: 在多个真实和合成数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法持续获得良好加速效果。在极端情况下，相比索引辅助均匀采样实现最高3倍加速，相比基于扫描的分层采样实现最高98708倍加速。

Conclusion: 两阶段采样框架结合针对索引采样成本模型的最优分层策略，能够有效降低近似查询的采样成本，在保持置信区间保证的同时显著提升查询响应速度。

Abstract: Ad-hoc queries over frequently updated data in a flat schema are common in real-time data analysis applications and often require very low latency. Online aggregation can achieve so by providing approximate aggregation answers with confidence bound guarantees. It relies on the ability to draw samples online in a linear time to sample size rather than database size, which can be supported by index-assisted Sampling-based Approximate Query Processing (S-AQP) systems. However, the query latencies of approximate queries in these systems can still suffer from excessive sampling cost required to achieve a desired confidence bound, due to increased sample size for data with high variance in value distribution and selectivity. Classic stratified sampling methods with Neyman allocation can minimize sample size in theory, but several challenges prevent it from being applicable in index-assisted S-AQP systems, including requiring apriori statistics, high optimization cost, and inaccurate sampling cost model based on sample size. Towards that, we design index-assisted stratified sampling for online aggregation, which features a two-phase sampling framework. Samples drawn from first phase are used for both online aggregation and optimizing future sampling cost, while the second phase continues the online aggregation using the optimized strata. We prove optimal stratification and sample size allocation strategies for index-based sampling cost model, and design several greedy and dynamic programming based optimization methods to balance optimization cost and effectiveness in cost reduction. We evaluate our methods on several real-world and synthetic datasets and queries, and the results show ours consistently achieve good speedup and, in extreme cases, up to 3x speedup and 98708x speedup, when compared to index-assisted uniform sampling and classic scan-based stratified sampling respectively.

</details>
